title: ChestPheNoT: Deployable, Auditable Label-Status-Evidence Extraction from Radiology Reports
summary: Structured phenotype extraction from radiology reports supports cohort construction, quality auditing, and clinical analytics, but practical deployment requires local inference and auditable predictions, while expert annotations remain scarce. Conventional labelers provide structured findings and assertion states but no supporting evidence, while API-hosted large language models may be unsuitable when clinical text cannot leave institutional infrastructure. We present CHESTPHENOT, a compact 0.5-3B language model that jointly extracts finding labels, three-class status (present/absent/uncertain), and verbatim supporting evidence spans. CHESTPHENOT is trained using hybrid CheXbert+72B silver supervision followed by supervised fine-tuning and lightweight GRPO refinement. Across three human-annotated gold sets spanning in-distribution, cross-taxonomy, and cross-institution evaluation, the 3B model remains below its CheXbert silver teacher in distribution but is competitive under distribution shift, significantly surpassing CheXbert on cross-institution detection (+2.0 F1). Task-specific training also enables the 3B model to match or exceed substantially larger prompted models on most detection and status comparisons. For evidence-grounded extraction, over 99% of final evidence spans are locatable in the source report, and the 3B model achieves 47.5 auditable-F1, outperforming Qwen2.5-7B one-shot prompting by 7.6 points and approaching Qwen2.5-72B. These results demonstrate that locally deployable models can provide competitive and directly auditable radiology-report extraction without relying on external inference APIs. Code and the full extraction/judge prompts will be made available at https://github.com/yukkai/ChestPheNoT.

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑模型 CHESTPHENOT（0.5-3B），可本地部署，联合抽取放射报告中的发现标签、三分类状态（存在/缺失/不确定）和逐字证据片段，通过混合银监督+微调+GRPO 精炼训练，在跨机构场景下性能具竞争力且证据可审计。
AI.motivation: 放射报告结构化表型抽取支持队列构建、质量审计和临床分析，但实际部署需要本地推理和可审计预测，而专家标注稀缺。传统标注器只提供结构化的发现和断言状态，不提供支撑证据；API 托管的大语言模型在临床文本不能离开机构基础设施的场景下可能不适用。
AI.method: CHESTPHENOT 为 0.5-3B 紧凑语言模型，联合抽取发现标签、三分类状态（present/absent/uncertain）和逐字支持证据片段。训练采用混合 CheXbert+72B 银监督，随后进行监督微调与轻量 GRPO 精炼。
AI.result: 在三个涵盖分布内、跨分类体系和跨机构评估的人工标注金标准集上：3B 模型在分布内低于其 CheXbert 银教师，但在分布偏移下具竞争力，跨机构检测显著超过 CheXbert（+2.0 F1）。任务特定训练使 3B 模型在多数检测和状态比较上匹配或超过显著更大的提示模型。证据扎根抽取中，超过 99% 的最终证据片段可在源报告中定位，3B 模型取得 47.5 auditable-F1，比 Qwen2.5-7B 单样本提示高 7.6 分，接近 Qwen2.5-72B。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明本地可部署模型能够提供具竞争力且可直接审计的放射报告抽取，无需依赖外部推理 API。代码和完整的抽取/评判提示将在指定 GitHub 仓库公开。

title: An Efficient and Effective Agentic Group Shilling Attack on Recommender Systems
summary: Recommender systems have become core infrastructure for modern online platforms, personalizing content at scale and strongly influencing what users see, click on, and purchase. However, this dependence on user interaction also exposes them to shilling attacks, where malicious actors can inject fake profiles to distort item rankings and control visibility. Existing attacks often rely on target-specific fine-tuning or fixed profile templates, making them either difficult to adapt to different victims or easier to detect. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Agentic Group Attack System (AGAS), a coordinated shilling framework where a central Coordinator directs a group of role-switching worker agents to adaptively promote a target item across different victim families. The Coordinator dynamically adjusts the strategy when progress stalls or suppression signals increase, while workers pursue a shared objective and switch between active and inactive roles to avoid repetitive patterns. Under the same attack budgets and evaluation protocols, AGAS consistently surpasses strong baselines in target promotion while better preserving benign recommendation quality, weakening representative detectors, and achieving higher efficiency than prior attacks. These findings also emphasize that defending recommender systems may require mechanisms that can handle adaptive shilling campaigns, not just isolated fake-profile injections. Our code is available at https://github.com/phkhanhtrinh23/AGAS.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Agentic Group Attack System (AGAS)，一种协同式 shilling 攻击框架，通过中心 Coordinator 指挥可切换角色的 worker agents，自适应地跨不同 victim 模型族推广目标物品。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统广泛影响用户行为，因而成为 shilling 攻击目标；现有攻击多依赖目标特定的微调或固定画像模板，适应性差且易被检测，需要更具通用性和隐蔽性的攻击方式。
AI.method: AGAS 采用协调式群体攻击架构：Coordinator 负责动态调整攻击策略，在进展停滞或抑制信号增强时切换方案；多个 worker agents 共享同一目标，并在活跃/非活跃角色之间切换以规避重复行为模式。
AI.result: 在相同攻击预算和评测协议下，AGAS 在目标物品推广效果上持续优于强基线，同时更好地保持良性推荐质量，削弱代表性检测器，并比既有攻击具有更高效率。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，防御推荐系统需要能够应对自适应式 shilling 攻击的机制，而非仅处理孤立的假画像注入；代码已开源。

title: TEFM: Token-Efficient Faithful Modeling for Structured Data
summary: In this paper, we solve two fundamental obstacles in applying LLMs to critical domains: token efficiency and faithfulness. To address both constraints jointly, we present TEFM (Token-Efficient Faithful Modeling), a framework designed for structured data analysis in critical domains. TEFM achieves token efficiency by compressing lengthy structured observations into compact Behavioral Code tokens, dramatically reducing token consumption with minimal information loss. Moreover, TEFM enables faithful rationalization through a dual-fidelity objective that jointly optimizes code-level reconstruction and prediction-level fidelity, identifying minimal sufficient feature subsets grounded in input data. Comprehensive experiments across various domain datasets and model backbones (Qwen3, Gemma-2, Phi-4) show that TEFM achieves competitive classification accuracy with dramatic token reduction (approximately 1\% token retention in clinical and 2\% in security domains) while producing faithful rationales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TEFM框架，通过将结构化观测压缩为"行为代码"令牌并结合双保真度目标，同时解决LLM在关键领域中的令牌效率与忠实性问题。
AI.motivation: 将LLM应用于关键领域时存在两大基本障碍：令牌效率低（长结构化观测消耗大量令牌）与推理忠实性不足（模型合理化过程未必基于真实输入）。二者需协同解决。
AI.method: TEFM（Token-Efficient Faithful Modeling）框架：1）将冗长的结构化观测压缩为紧凑的Behavioral Code令牌，以最小信息损失大幅降低令牌消耗；2）采用双保真度目标，联合优化代码级重构与预测级保真度，从而识别以输入数据为依据的最小充分特征子集。
AI.result: 在多领域数据集与多种模型骨干（Qwen3、Gemma-2、Phi-4）上，TEFM在临床领域实现约1%、安全领域约2%的令牌保留率，同时保持有竞争力的分类准确率，并生成忠实的推理依据。
AI.conclusion: TEFM能够同时满足关键领域对令牌效率与忠实性的双重需求，在显著压缩令牌的同时维持分类性能并提升推理可信度。

title: BuzzASR: A Swarm of 100+ Monolingual Speech Recognition Models
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. Models: https://huggingface.co/BuzzASR ; Project page: https://lemn-lab.github.io/buzz-asr
summary: We introduce BuzzASR, a collection of language-specialized fine-tuned Whisper models adapted for automatic speech recognition (ASR) in 102 languages. Large end-to-end Transformer-based ASR models such as Whisper have revolutionized ASR, but most prominent models are highly multilingual. As a result, these models often perform poorly on languages less well-represented in their training set. While it has long been known that effective language adaptation can be achieved through simple fine-tuning on monolingual data, this strategy has only been applied to a small number of languages. We massively scale up this simple approach to 102 languages covered in the FLEURS dataset, while also implementing a more complex language adaptation strategy that integrates monolingual tokenizer replacement and data augmentation using text-only fine-tuning. BuzzASR models outperform Whisper-large-v3 on 77 out of 102 languages, reducing character error rates (CER) by a factor of over 2.8 on average. Our models achieve state-of-the-art CER among open-source systems on 27 of 102 languages on the combined FLEURS and Common Voice test set. Our tokenizer replacement strategy yields an average 3.3x improvement in compression rate (characters per token) over Whisper's multilingual BPE, with gains of up to 21.7x. We release all models, code, and detailed results: https://lemn-lab.github.io/buzz-asr

AI.tldr: BuzzASR 是一套覆盖 102 种语言的 Whisper 语言专用微调模型集合，通过单语微调、单语分词器替换及仅文本微调数据增强实现语言适配，在 77/102 种语言上超越 Whisper-large-v3，平均 CER 降低 2.8 倍以上。
AI.motivation: 主流端到端 Transformer ASR 模型（如 Whisper）高度多语言化，在训练集中代表性不足的语言上表现较差。虽然单语数据微调可有效实现语言适配，但此前仅应用于少数语言，因此需要大规模扩展这一策略。
AI.method: 将简单的单语微调方法大规模扩展到 FLEURS 数据集覆盖的 102 种语言，并引入更复杂的语言适配策略：单语分词器替换（monolingual tokenizer replacement）以及基于仅文本微调的数据增强。同时基于单语分词器替换，将压缩率（每 token 字符数）相比 Whisper 的多语言 BPE 平均提升 3.3 倍，最高达 21.7 倍。
AI.result: BuzzASR 在 102 种语言中的 77 种上优于 Whisper-large-v3，字符错误率（CER）平均降低 2.8 倍以上；在 FLEURS 与 Common Voice 联合测试集上，于 102 种语言中的 27 种取得开源系统的最先进 CER。作者公开了全部模型、代码与详细结果。
AI.conclusion: 大规模语言专用微调结合分词器替换与仅文本微调数据增强，能显著提升低资源语言的 ASR 性能，并大幅改善分词压缩效率；相关模型与资源已公开发布。

title: Towards Automatic Evolution Tree Generation from Citation Graphs
summary: Surveys remain the primary way researchers grasp the lineage of methods within an AI subfield, but they scale poorly against the current rate of publication. Existing taxonomy-induction methods are largely leaf-bound and time-agnostic; they tend to force transitional papers into mature leaves and can create topological inversions between ancestors and descendants. We propose EvoTree, a staged framework that decouples conceptual backbone learning from temporal refinement: a graph-aware encoder with distribution-based hierarchical clustering yields a stable taxonomy backbone; temporal fine-tuning then re-attaches marginal papers to internal nodes under monotonic-path constraints; a final LLM pass labels concepts without altering the topology. We release the first annotated benchmark for this task across 11 AI subfields. EvoTree attains the highest NMI and citation-direction accuracy among all baselines and the best concept purity on the annotated benchmark, and is the only method with non-trivial marginal-paper detection on the annotated set.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoTree，一个分阶段框架，将概念骨架学习与时间细化解耦，用于自动归纳 AI 子领域的方法演化树，并发布首个跨 11 个 AI 子领域的标注基准。方法在 NMI、引用方向准确率和概念纯度上优于所有基线，且是唯一在标注集上实现有效边缘论文检测的方法。
AI.motivation: 综述是研究者了解 AI 子领域方法谱系的主要途径，但面对当前论文发表速度，人工综述难以规模化。现有分类体系归纳方法多为叶节点绑定且忽略时间信息，倾向于把过渡性论文强行塞入成熟叶节点，并可能在祖先与后代之间产生拓扑倒置。
AI.method: EvoTree 采用分阶段框架，将概念骨架学习与时间细化解耦：先用图感知编码器结合基于分布的分层聚类生成稳定的分类骨架；再通过时间微调，在单调路径约束下把边缘论文重新挂接到内部节点；最后用一次 LLM 处理为概念打标签，且不改变拓扑结构。
AI.result: 发布首个面向该任务的标注基准，覆盖 11 个 AI 子领域。EvoTree 在所有基线中取得最高 NMI 和引用方向准确率，并在标注基准上取得最佳概念纯度，同时是唯一在标注集上具备非平凡边缘论文检测能力的方法。
AI.conclusion: EvoTree 通过解耦概念骨架学习与时间细化，有效提升了 AI 子领域方法演化树归纳的质量，缓解了传统方法叶节点绑定与时间无关的局限，并为该任务提供了首个标注基准。

title: Reproducing Omitted Temporal Expressions in Japanese News for Retrieval-Augmented Applications
summary: News articles often contain omitted temporal expressions, such as day-only or month-only mentions, which must be interpreted with reference to the publication date. When such articles are indexed or processed as standalone text in search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, these omissions can cause temporal mismatches and unstable interpretation by large language models. We focus on reproducing omitted temporal expressions as concrete dates or intervals using the publication date as external context before the articles are indexed for search and RAG applications. Specifically, building on established temporal-expression extraction and normalization techniques and informed by a manual analysis of Japanese news articles, we propose jaROTE, a rule-based pipeline for Japanese news. Experiments on two news corpora demonstrate that jaROTE achieves high performance, and remains competitive with LLMs while providing a fast, low-cost pipeline. We further show that temporal reproduction improves time-constrained lexical retrieval, demonstrating the practical value of publication-date-grounded normalization for Japanese news retrieval.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出jaROTE，一个基于规则的日文新闻省略时间表达式还原流水线，利用发布日期将“仅日”“仅月”等模糊表达还原为具体日期或区间，实验表明其性能高、成本低，并能改善时间约束检索。
AI.motivation: 新闻文章常包含被省略的时间表达式（如仅给出日或月），需参照发布日期才能正确解释。当文章作为独立文本被索引或用于搜索与RAG系统时，这种省略会导致时间错配以及大语言模型解释不稳定。因此，需要在索引前以发布日期为外部上下文进行时间还原。
AI.method: 基于已有的时间表达式抽取与规范化技术，并结合对日文新闻的人工分析，提出jaROTE：面向日文新闻的基于规则的流水线，用于将省略的时间表达式还原为具体日期或区间。
AI.result: 在两个新闻语料上的实验显示，jaROTE取得较高性能，可与LLM竞争，同时具备快速、低成本的优势；进一步表明时间还原能改善时间约束的词法检索。
AI.conclusion: 以发布日期为基准的时间规范化对日文新闻检索具有实际价值，jaROTE为搜索与RAG场景提供了高效、低成本的时间还原方案。

title: Beyond Top Words: MonoTM for Topic Modeling with Interpretable Monosemantic Features
comment: Accepted to appear in the Proceedings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026
summary: Topic models summarize large text corpora, but top-ranked words often provide only a limited representation of topic semantics. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) offer a way to move beyond word-level descriptors by extracting interpretable features from dense representations, yet how feature interpretability relates to topic-inference quality remains unclear. We introduce \textbf{MonoTM}, an interpretable topic modeling framework that decouples these roles. Across three benchmark corpora, we show that document--topic mixture estimation and semantic interpretation favor different SAE configurations and feature subsets. MonoTM estimates mixtures from the full SAE bag-of-features representation and, with them fixed, learns topic descriptors over a separate vocabulary of corpus-grounded semantic features. This design preserves global topic structure while representing topics with semantic units more meaningful than individual words, making them more useful for downstream corpus analysis.

AI.tldr: MonoTM：解耦主题推断与语义解释的可解释主题建模框架
AI.motivation: 传统主题模型以高权重词作为主题描述，语义表征能力有限；稀疏自编码器（SAE）虽可从稠密表示中提取可解释特征，但特征可解释性与主题推断质量之间的关系尚不明确。
AI.method: MonoTM将文档-主题混合估计与语义解释解耦：先从完整SAE特征袋表示估计文档-主题混合，再在固定该混合的前提下，基于另一套语料锚定的语义特征词汇表学习主题描述子。
AI.result: 在三个基准语料上，文档-主题混合估计与语义解释偏好不同的SAE配置和特征子集，说明二者并非由同一套特征最优支撑。
AI.conclusion: 该设计在保留全局主题结构的同时，以比单词更具语义意义的语义单元刻画主题，提升了面向下游语料分析的实用性。

title: Myocardial Strain Drift Correction in Deep Learning Based Ultrasound Tracking
summary: Myocardial strain from echocardiography is a key biomarker for cardiac function. Recent deep learning methods show strong performance for myocardial motion tracking but often lack physiological constraints, leading to temporal drift across the cardiac cycle. Consequently, tracked points may not return to their relative initial positions at the end of each cardiac cycle, producing inaccurate strain estimates and even divergence in some cases. We propose a deep learning framework that compensates for drift during myocardial tracking. We extend a state-of-the-art echocardiographic tracking method (TAS-Net) with persistent memory tokens that share information across sliding windows over full cardiac cycles. A teacher-student fine-tuning strategy on real echocardiographic data then enforces physiologically consistent cyclic motion while preserving tracking accuracy. Experiments show reduced global and regional strain drift, improved agreement with clinical references, and better test-retest reproducibility, supporting more reliable myocardial strain estimation in clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 提出在TAS-Net基础上引入持久记忆token与师生微调的深度学习框架，抑制心肌追踪的周期漂移，提升应变估计可靠性。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图心肌应变是心功能关键生物标志物。现有深度学习心肌运动追踪方法虽性能强，但缺乏生理约束，导致心动周期内时间漂移：追踪点在周期结束时无法回到相对初始位置，造成应变估计不准甚至发散。
AI.method: 扩展SOTA超声追踪方法TAS-Net，加入持久记忆token（persistent memory tokens），在覆盖完整心动周期的滑动窗口间共享信息；再在真实超声心动图数据上采用教师-学生微调（teacher-student fine-tuning）策略，强制生理一致的周期性运动，同时保持追踪精度。
AI.result: 实验显示全局与区域应变漂移降低，与临床参考值一致性提高，重测信度（test-retest reproducibility）更好。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可支撑临床实践中更可靠的心肌应变估计。

title: CityPlanner: A Sandbox Agent for Executable Urban Planning
summary: Urban planning is a real-world spatial optimization problem that requires selecting feasible actions from large candidate spaces under practical objectives such as cost and service quality. Existing optimization and reinforcement learning methods are effective for fixed formulations, but often depend on task-specific representations and constraint handling. We propose \emph{CityPlanner}, a sandbox-agent framework for executable urban planning. CityPlanner introduces \emph{UrbanSandbox}, a unified file-based environment where agents inspect task files, generate plans, run evaluators, and revise decisions based on executable feedback. To make learning tractable, we further propose atomic-task reinforcement learning, which decomposes long sandbox trajectories into \emph{BuildPlan} for initial construction and \emph{ImprovePlan} for feedback-based refinement. Experiments on a real-world benchmark show that CityPlanner consistently outperforms heuristic, task-specific RL, and general LLM-agent baselines. Ablations verify the contributions of UrbanSandbox, atomic-task RL, and iterative deployment. We release the code and dataset at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/co-agent-C1C8

AI.tldr: 本文提出CityPlanner——面向可执行城市规划的沙箱智能体框架，包含统一文件式环境UrbanSandbox与原子任务强化学习（BuildPlan/ImprovePlan），在真实基准上优于启发式、任务特定RL及通用LLM智能体基线。
AI.motivation: 城市规划是真实世界的空间优化问题，需在成本与服务质量的实践目标下，从庞大候选空间中选取可行方案。现有优化与强化学习方法虽对固定建模有效，但往往依赖任务特定的表示与约束处理方式，难以泛化。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：一是UrbanSandbox，统一的基于文件的环境，智能体可检查任务文件、生成方案、运行评估器，并依据可执行反馈修正决策；二是原子任务强化学习，将长沙箱轨迹分解为负责初始构建的BuildPlan与负责基于反馈细化的ImprovePlan两个原子任务，使学习更易处理。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准上的实验表明，CityPlanner持续优于启发式方法、任务特定强化学习方法以及通用LLM智能体基线。消融实验验证了UrbanSandbox、原子任务强化学习与迭代部署各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: CityPlanner通过沙箱化可执行环境与原子任务分解，为城市空间规划提供了一种通用且有效的智能体学习范式，代码与数据集已开源。

title: RouteBridge: Reliability-Routed Bidirectional Distillation Between Neural Radiance Fields and 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Neural radiance fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) encode a scene with complementary inductive biases, but existing cross-representation distillation typically fixes one representation as teacher for the entire scene. A globally fixed teacher can propagate local reconstruction errors. We present RouteBridge, a bidirectional framework that selects the teaching direction for each ray. Its reliability estimator combines photometric residuals with representation-specific geometric evidence and routes supervision from NeRF to 3DGS, from 3DGS to NeRF, or abstains. A renderer-independent interface transfers color, opacity, and normalized depth without shared features or point correspondence. On mip-NeRF 360, the NeRF and 3DGS exports reach 28.56 and 28.77 dB, respectively. The 3DGS export improves over 3DGS by 1.56 dB and over NeRF-GS by 0.45 dB while reducing LPIPS to 0.207. On static three-view DTU, RouteBridge obtains 21.12 dB. Ablations show that both adaptive routing and geometric ray targets contribute to the improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出RouteBridge，一种双向跨表示蒸馏框架，逐光线自适应选择NeRF与3DGS之间的监督方向，在mip-NeRF 360上3DGS输出达28.77 dB。
AI.motivation: NeRF与3DGS具有互补的归纳偏置，但现有跨表示蒸馏通常将某一表示固定为全场景的教师，这种全局固定的教师会把局部重建误差传播到学生表示中。因此需要一种按局部可靠性动态决定蒸馏方向的方法。
AI.method: RouteBridge采用逐光线的双向蒸馏：可靠性估计器结合光度残差与表示特有的几何证据，决定监督方向为NeRF→3DGS、3DGS→NeRF或弃权（不进行监督）。通过渲染器无关的接口传输颜色、不透明度和归一化深度，无需共享特征或点对应关系。
AI.result: 在mip-NeRF 360上，NeRF与3DGS导出分别达到28.56 dB和28.77 dB；3DGS导出较3DGS提升1.56 dB，较NeRF-GS提升0.45 dB，LPIPS降至0.207。在静态三视图DTU上达到21.12 dB。消融实验表明自适应路由与几何光线目标均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 逐光线自适应选择教学方向优于全局固定教师的跨表示蒸馏，可同时提升NeRF与3DGS两种导出质量，且渲染器无关接口保证了通用性。

title: Marker-free eye-gaze estimation using a single image and depth from defocus
summary: This paper presents a marker-free eye-gaze estimation approach using a single 2D camera, such as an integrated laptop webcam. The gaze-related features are estimated from iris localization and head pose estimated by using depth from defocus. A variational Bayesian multinomial logistic regression framework is used as mapping from the estimated features to the position of regard, based on an 8-dimensional feature vector of head-pose and iris-displacement parameters. No external marker is needed. Experiments were conducted by estimating the gaze of people watching a computer screen at different distances and compared against five existing methods. The obtained scores demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需标记的眼动估计方法，仅用单个2D摄像头（如笔记本内置摄像头），通过虹膜定位与基于离焦深度的头部姿态估计提取注视特征，并用变分贝叶斯多项逻辑回归建立从8维特征向量到注视位置的映射。
AI.motivation: 现有眼动估计常依赖外部标记或专用设备，限制了自然场景下的适用性；本文旨在仅用普通2D摄像头实现无标记注视估计。
AI.method: 从虹膜定位中提取虹膜位移参数，通过离焦深度（depth from defocus）估计头部姿态，构造包含头部姿态与虹膜位移的8维特征向量；采用变分贝叶斯多项逻辑回归（variational Bayesian multinomial logistic regression）作为特征到注视位置（position of regard）的映射模型，全程无需外部标记。
AI.result: 在不同距离下让被试观看计算机屏幕进行注视估计实验，并与五种现有方法对比，所获评分证明了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在单目2D摄像头条件下实现无标记眼动估计，性能优于五种对比方法，验证了特征构造与变分贝叶斯映射框架的有效性。

title: Hyperbolic Geometry for Open-World Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Open-world object detection (OWOD) extends closed-set detection by requiring models to identify unknown objects and incrementally learn them once annotations become available. In remote sensing imagery, object categories often exhibit latent hierarchical relationships that may be inadequately represented in the Euclidean spaces commonly adopted by existing methods, limiting unknown-object recall and incremental-learning performance. To address this issue, we investigate hyperbolic geometry for OWOD in remote sensing imagery and propose HyRS-OWOD. To improve unknown object recall, we design a two-step unknown-object discovery mechanism: a Decoupled Objectness Learning (DOL) module that disentangles foreground perception from semantic information to separate foreground proposals from background regions, followed by a Hyperbolic Uncertainty Learning (HUL) component that leverages the radius of hyperbolic embeddings as an uncertainty-aware cue for known-unknown discrimination. For incremental learning, we develop a Hyperbolic Metric Learning (HML) strategy that enhances inter-class separability, facilitating the incorporation of novel categories while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Experiments on three remote sensing benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in unknown recall and incremental learning over state-of-the-art OWOD methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyRS-OWOD，将双曲几何引入遥感图像的开放世界目标检测（OWOD），通过双步骤未知目标发现机制与双曲度量学习策略，提升未知目标召回率并缓解增量学习中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像中目标类别常存在潜在的层次关系，而现有OWOD方法普遍采用欧氏空间表示，难以充分刻画这种层次结构，从而限制了未知目标召回与增量学习性能。作者据此探索双曲几何在遥感OWOD中的适用性。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 解耦目标性学习（DOL）模块，将前景感知与语义信息解耦，从而把前景提议与背景区域分离；(2) 双曲不确定性学习（HUL）组件，利用双曲嵌入的半径作为不确定性线索进行已知-未知判别，二者构成两步未知目标发现机制；(3) 双曲度量学习（HML）策略，增强类间可分性，以支持新类融入并缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在三个遥感基准数据集上的实验表明，相较当前最先进的OWOD方法，该方法在未知目标召回率和增量学习性能上均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 双曲几何为遥感开放世界目标检测提供了一种有效表示范式，能够在提升未知目标召回的同时改善增量学习效果，验证了层次化嵌入空间在该任务中的价值。

title: Who Are They to Each Other? Multi-Agent Reasoning for Speaker Relationship Inference
summary: Inferring speaker relationships from spoken conversations is an important step towards socially aware speech understanding. However, this task remains underexplored, and supervised modeling is costly to train and scale. At the same time, existing inference-time LLM approaches provide limited structure for handling subtle, distributed, and multimodal relational cues that may support multiple plausible interpretations. To address these limitations, we introduce a training-free multi-agent reasoning framework that organizes inference through structured interaction among LLM agents, allowing relationship judgments to be proposed, challenged, and adjudicated without task-specific training. We instantiate this framework with two complementary designs. We propose Multi-Role Multi-Agent Debate as a task-specific adaptation of standard multi-agent debate for speaker relationship inference, assigning agents complementary roles or social-theory-grounded perspectives rather than a single undifferentiated viewpoint. In contrast, we introduce Multi-Agent Compete, a competition-based protocol that compares agent judgments through pairwise adjudication, eliminates weaker candidates, and retains the most defensible one. We evaluate these methods on the Seamless Interaction dataset across different modality settings, covering both binary classification and fine-grained relationship-detail prediction. Results suggest that they improve over zero-shot and existing multi-agent baselines in most cases. Human evaluation further suggests that this task is challenging even for people. LLM methods can sometimes outperform human annotators in text-included settings but are less competitive in the audio setting. Together, these findings suggest that relationship inference benefits from structured inference-time interaction among agents, while acoustic cues are not yet fully captured by current models.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的多智能体推理框架，通过结构化交互推断说话人关系，在多模态设置下多数场景优于零样本与现有多智能体基线，但音频模态仍待提升。
AI.motivation: 从对话中推断说话人关系是实现社会感知语音理解的重要一步，但该任务研究不足；有监督建模训练与扩展成本高，而现有推理期LLM方法缺乏处理细微、分布式、多模态关系线索的结构，而这些线索常存在多种合理解释。
AI.method: 提出免训练的多智能体推理框架，以LLM智能体间的结构化交互组织推断，无需任务特定训练即可提出、质疑与裁定关系判断。实例化为两种互补设计：1）Multi-Role Multi-Agent Debate，将标准多智能体辩论适配到该任务，为智能体赋予互补角色或社会理论视角；2）Multi-Agent Compete，基于竞争的协议，通过成对裁定比较判断、淘汰较弱候选、保留最可辩护者。
AI.result: 在Seamless Interaction数据集上跨不同模态设置评估，覆盖二分类与细粒度关系细节预测。多数情况下优于零样本与现有多智能体基线。人工评估显示该任务对人类亦具挑战性：含文本设置下LLM有时可超过人类标注者，但纯音频设置下竞争力较弱。
AI.conclusion: 关系推断受益于智能体间结构化的推理期交互，但当前模型尚未充分捕捉声学线索。

title: LightMedSeg-ISLES: Stroke Lesion Segmentation with 81x Fewer Parameters than nnU-Net
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to ISLES 2026 challenge. To be published in Nature Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
summary: Large networks and ensembles often lead medical image segmentation challenges, but their storage and inference demands complicate deployment. We present LightMedSeg-ISLES, a 1.26-million-parameter pipeline for T1-weighted stroke lesion segmentation in ISLES'26. On a 146-case held-out cohort, flip test-time augmentation produces 0.618 mean Dice and 0.599 lesion-wise F1. A 102.35-million-parameter nnU-Net ResEnc-L produces 0.634 Dice and 0.544 lesion-wise F1 after size filtering. LightMedSeg therefore retains 97.5\% of nnU-Net's Dice with 81.4$\times$ fewer parameters while improving lesion-wise F1 by 0.055. Its four-pass TTA operating point requires 4.7$\times$ fewer FLOPs per standardized patch than nnU-Net. It also slightly exceeds filtered UNETR++ and nnFormer. Longer training and stronger augmentation add 0.0358 Dice without increasing capacity, establishing a strong single-checkpoint alternative to much larger models.

AI.tldr: 提出仅1.26M参数的LightMedSeg-ISLES流水线，用于T1加权卒中病灶分割，在Dice接近百倍大模型的同时提升病灶级F1并大幅降低计算量。
AI.motivation: 大型网络和集成模型在医学图像分割中表现优异，但存储与推理开销大，制约临床部署；本文旨在探索以极小参数量实现与大模型相当的分割性能。
AI.method: 构建1.26M参数的轻量流水线LightMedSeg-ISLES，针对ISLES'26的T1加权卒中病灶分割；采用翻转测试时增强（flip TTA）四通道推理；与102.35M参数的nnU-Net ResEnc-L（含尺寸过滤）对照，并比较UNETR++、nnFormer；分析延长训练与增强策略的影响。
AI.result: 在146例留出队列上，翻转TTA取得平均Dice 0.618、病灶级F1 0.599；nnU-Net为0.634 Dice、0.544病灶级F1。LightMedSeg保留nnU-Net 97.5%的Dice，参数量少81.4倍，病灶级F1高0.055，四通道TTA每标准化patch的FLOPs少4.7倍，并略优于经过滤的UNETR++与nnFormer；更长训练与更强增强在不增加容量的前提下额外提升0.0358 Dice。
AI.conclusion: LightMedSeg-ISLES以极低参数量与计算开销达到接近巨型模型的分割精度并改善病灶级检测，是替代大模型的强单检查点方案，有利于实际部署。

title: PELM: Power Efficient On-Device LLM Inference with Speculative Decoding and Dynamic Voltage Frequency Scaling
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) directly on mobile platforms at the edge is gaining traction due to a myriad of benefits, such as increased privacy, personalization, and reduced latency. However, LLMs have heavy computational requirements, which are difficult for resource-constrained mobile and edge platforms to fulfill. In addition to limited compute resources, mobile and edge systems often have a compact form factor and lack physical mechanisms to dissipate heat generated from high processor usage rates (e.g., fans) to prevent throttling and reduced processing power, which LLMs can easily cause. To mitigate these effects, prior works have proposed various power governing strategies, such as dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), for reducing power and heat generation for heavy computational tasks on mobile platforms. Recently, DVFS methods tailored for mobile LLMs have also been proposed. However, these methods mostly focus on optimizing hardware parameters and processor frequencies, and they fall short under some thermally constrained scenarios. Drawing from recent advances in machine learning, we identify and take advantage of the key insight that not all tokens require full-depth inference to maintain high-quality generation. Motivated by this, we present PELM, a solution that augments traditional DVFS processor frequency tuning with two additional workload-specific knobs: 1) speculative decoding and 2) variable verification depth to expand the optimization space to multiple dimensions for more power efficient on-device LLM inference. In extensive evaluations across hardware platforms and datasets, PELM demonstrates superior performance compared to state-of-the-art power governing methods, with up to 23.1% speedup and 52.4% reduction in energy consumption, while maintaining comparable task performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/imec-nu/PELM.

AI.tldr: PELM 通过在传统 DVFS 频率调节基础上引入投机解码与可变验证深度两个工作负载级调控旋钮，扩展多维优化空间，实现更节能的端侧 LLM 推理，最高加速 23.1%、能耗降低 52.4%。
AI.motivation: 移动与边缘设备部署 LLM 可带来隐私、个性化与低延迟优势，但 LLM 计算量大，且移动设备散热能力差（无风扇），易因高负载导致降频与性能下降。已有 DVFS 及针对移动 LLM 的 DVFS 方法主要优化硬件参数与处理器频率，在热受限场景下效果不佳。
AI.method: 基于"并非所有 token 都需要全深度推理即可维持高质量生成"的洞见，提出 PELM：在传统 DVFS 处理器频率调优之外，额外引入两个工作负载级调控旋钮——1) 投机解码（speculative decoding），2) 可变验证深度（variable verification depth），从而将优化空间扩展至多维度，实现更节能的端侧 LLM 推理。
AI.result: 在多种硬件平台与数据集上的广泛评测中，PELM 相比最先进的功耗管理方法表现更优，最高实现 23.1% 加速与 52.4% 能耗降低，同时保持可比的任务性能。源码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将硬件频率调节与算法/工作负载层面的调控（投机解码与可变验证深度）协同优化，可有效缓解移动端 LLM 的热受限与能耗问题，在几乎不损失生成质量的前提下显著提升能效。

title: Recovering Biomechanical Signals from Missing Keypoints Using Temporal Interpolation in Monocular Gait Analysis
summary: Monocular pose estimation enables low-cost gait analysis but is sensitive to missing keypoints caused by occlusion, detection errors, or efficiency-driven model reduction. While prior work on recovering missing joints focuses on complex learned models, the effectiveness of simple temporal methods remains underexplored. We evaluate knee-angle estimation under a missing-ankle-keypoint condition and test a first-order temporal interpolation scheme as a recovery mechanism. Across 527 frames of monocular walking video (428 with valid baseline detections), removing the ankle keypoint increased mean angular error to 23.4° +/- 46.7° and collapsed signal variance to near zero. Temporal interpolation reduced error to 1.1° +/- 6.7° and restored variance and smoothness to within a few percent of baseline. These results indicate that gait signals possess sufficient temporal redundancy for a simple, computationally trivial interpolation scheme to recover a critical missing joint, without resorting to learned reconstruction models. The findings support low-complexity, real-time-compatible designs for gait analysis in resource-constrained or occlusion-prone monocular settings.

AI.tldr: 在单目步态分析中脚踝关键点缺失会导致膝关节角估计误差剧增，而简单的一阶时间插值即可有效恢复该缺失关节，无需复杂学习模型。
AI.motivation: 单目姿态估计为低成本步态分析提供可能，但对遮挡、检测错误或效率导向的模型简化造成的关键点缺失十分敏感。既有缺失关节恢复工作多聚焦复杂学习模型，而简单时间方法的有效性仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 在缺失脚踝关键点条件下评估膝关节角估计，并测试一阶时间插值作为恢复机制，基于527帧单目步行视频（其中428帧基线检测有效）进行实验。
AI.result: 移除脚踝关键点后，平均角度误差升至23.4°±46.7°，信号方差几近消失；时间插值将误差降至1.1°±6.7°，并将方差与平滑度恢复到基线水平的几个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 步态信号具有充足的时间冗余，使计算代价极低的简单插值即可恢复关键缺失关节，无需依赖学习式重建模型，支持面向资源受限或易遮挡单目场景的低复杂度、实时兼容的步态分析设计。

title: SEA-SpeechBench: A Large-Scale Multitask Benchmark for Speech Understanding Across Southeast Asia
summary: The rapid advancement of audio and multimodal large language models has unlocked transformative speech understanding capabilities, yet evaluation frameworks remain predominantly English-centric, leaving Southeast Asian (SEA) languages critically underrepresented. We introduce SEA-SpeechBench, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale multitask benchmark that evaluates speech understanding in 11 SEA languages through 97,194 samples across 99 evaluation sets and 597 hours of curated audio data. Our benchmark comprises 9 diverse tasks across 3 categories: speech processing (automatic speech recognition, speech translation, spoken question answering), paralinguistic analysis (emotion, gender, age, speaker recognition), and temporal understanding, a novel dimension featuring timestamped content queries and temporal localization within extended audio sequences up to 3 minutes. We implement multilingual prompting in both native SEA languages and English to reflect user interactions with audio-language models. Evaluation of leading open-source and proprietary systems reveals marked performance gaps. Across all models, performance remains underwhelming on temporal understanding, emotion recognition, and speech translation. Prompting in low-resource languages such as Burmese and Tamil lags behind English by up to 41 percentage points. Our findings expose critical model limitations and underscore the need for inclusive model development. The SEA-SpeechBench benchmark is available at https://zwenyu.github.io/SEA-SpeechBench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SEA-SpeechBench——首个面向东南亚语言的大规模多任务语音理解基准，涵盖11种语言、99个评测集、97,194条样本与597小时音频，并揭示了现有模型在时间理解、情感识别与语音翻译上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 音频与多模态大模型发展迅速，但评测框架以英语为中心，东南亚（SEA）语言严重缺乏代表性，亟需面向该地区语言的系统性语音理解评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 SEA-SpeechBench，覆盖11种东南亚语言，包含99个评测集、97,194条样本、597小时音频；任务分3大类9项：语音处理（ASR、语音翻译、口语问答）、副语言分析（情感、性别、年龄、说话人识别）以及新提出的时间理解（时间戳内容查询与最长3分钟长音频内的时间定位）；并采用东南亚母语与英语的双语提示方式评测主流开源与闭源模型。
AI.result: 评测显示各类模型表现差距明显：在时间理解、情感识别和语音翻译上整体表现不佳；使用缅甸语、泰米尔语等低资源语言提示时，性能较英语最多落后41个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究暴露了当前语音语言模型的关键局限，强调需要面向多语言、特别是低资源语言的包容性模型开发；SEA-SpeechBench 已公开。

title: X2-NativeCursor: Native-Token Text Progress Tracking for Incremental-Text Streaming Codec TTS
summary: Incremental-text streaming text-to-speech (TTS) needs online text progress tracking for synchronized highlighting, interruption handling, and dialogue-history updates. Input text arrives before it is spoken, so text arrival alone cannot indicate speech progress. Existing waveform-based alignment requires complete audio or adds acoustic processing during streaming. We propose X2-NativeCursor, a lightweight observer that tracks progress from native speech tokens before waveform decoding without changing the TTS generator. Its normalization plan links spoken labels to their original-text spans. Text and native-token encoders feed a local matcher that estimates the current label position. A separate output rule converts revisable position estimates into a cursor that never moves backward. Mean absolute error against an automatic reference is 0.151 Chinese characters with 80-ms lookahead, versus 1.253 characters with 320-ms lookahead for an online waveform baseline. Alignment real-time factor also decreases from 0.3598 to 0.0180 relative to this baseline. Lower tracking error is retained under a second automatic alignment reference. We evaluate X2-NativeCursor on Qwen3-TTS and validate its adaptation to CosyVoice2 by training a separate observer for each backbone. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/X2Streaming-TTS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 X2-NativeCursor，一种在波形解码前基于原生语音 token 进行在线进度跟踪的轻量观察器，可在不修改 TTS 生成器的情况下实现增量流式 TTS 的文本进度对齐。
AI.motivation: 增量流式 TTS 需要在线文本进度跟踪以支持同步高亮、打断处理和对话历史更新；但输入文本早于语音到达，文本到达本身无法反映语音进度，而现有基于波形的对齐需完整音频或引入流式声学处理开销。
AI.method: X2-NativeCursor 作为轻量观察器，在波形解码前从原生语音 token 跟踪进度；其归一化方案将已说标签映射到原文跨度，文本编码器与原生 token 编码器输入局部匹配器以估计当前标签位置，独立输出规则将可修正的位置估计转换为不回退的游标。
AI.result: 在 80-ms 前瞻下，相对自动参考的平均绝对误差为 0.151 个汉字；在线波形基线在 320-ms 前瞻下为 1.253 个字符；对齐实时因子由 0.3598 降至 0.0180；在第二个自动对齐参考下仍保持更低跟踪误差；在 Qwen3-TTS 上评估，并为 CosyVoice2 分别训练观察器以验证适配性。
AI.conclusion: X2-NativeCursor 通过原生语音 token 实现在线文本进度跟踪，显著降低跟踪误差与对齐实时因子，且无需修改 TTS 生成器，具备跨主干的可适配性，代码已公开。

title: Which Medical Questions Deserve Rationales? Perturbation-Sensitive Selection for Robust QA
summary: Medical question-answering datasets often contain answer labels, whereas high-quality rationales remain scarce, noisy, or costly to validate. This changes the acquisition question: rather than asking which questions should be labeled, we ask which already-labeled questions should receive rationale supervision under a fixed token budget. We study an offline version of this problem in which candidate rationales are visible to the selector but withheld from downstream training unless selected. We propose root-mean-square Robustness-based Sample Prioritization (RMS-RSP), which perturbs hidden states only at rationale tokens and measures the resulting shift in the gold-versus-best-distractor margin. Across five medical QA datasets, MedGemma-4B-IT, three training seeds, ten budgeted non-RSP selectors, and an unbudgeted full-supervision reference, RMS-RSP provides a deliberately qualified result. Its locked-budget accuracy is 60.61% on average versus 60.08% for Random, with a statistically resolved gain only on AfriMed-QA (+1.44 points). Its full-budget accuracy area is not better than Random. However, after three answer-option reorderings, RMS-RSP improves robust accuracy and semantic consistency by 1.91 and 2.85 points on average, respectively, with the same direction on all five datasets. Training on every pool rationale raises macro accuracy to 63.74%, but consumes 29--254 times more rationale tokens and does not uniformly improve robustness. These findings do not establish universal accuracy gains; they instead suggest that rationale-local boundary sensitivity can identify supervision that improves invariance to semantically equivalent formatting changes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RMS-RSP方法，在固定token预算下，从已标注的医学问答数据中选择应接受rationale监督的样本，以提升模型对语义等价格式变化的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 医学问答数据集通常有答案标签但高质量rationale稀缺、噪声大或验证成本高，因此问题从"哪些问题需要标注"转变为"在固定token预算下，哪些已标注问题应接受rationale监督"。
AI.method: 提出RMS-RSP（均方根鲁棒性样本优先级），仅在rationale token处扰动隐藏状态，度量gold与最佳干扰项之间margin的变化；在五个医学QA数据集、MedGemma-4B-IT、三个训练种子、十种预算非RSP选择器及无预算全监督参考下进行评估。
AI.result: 锁定预算准确率平均60.61%对比Random的60.08%，仅在AfriMed-QA上获得统计显著提升（+1.44点）；全预算准确率面积不优于Random。但经三次答案选项重排后，鲁棒准确率和语义一致性平均分别提升1.91和2.85点，五个数据集方向一致。全池rationale训练将宏观准确率提至63.74%，但消耗29--254倍rationale token且未一致提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 结果未确立通用准确率增益，但表明rationale局部的边界敏感性可识别出能提升对语义等价格式变化不变性的监督信号。

title: Looped GPT-BERT: Trading Parameters for Computation in Small Language Modeling
summary: When training data are limited, increasing parameter count is not the only way to improve language-model performance. A small parameter set, when repeatedly applied, can also deliver comparable performance. We study Looped GPT-BERT in the BabyLM 2026 Strict-small setting, combining GPT-BERT's masked next-token and causal language-modeling objectives with depth-wise parameter sharing. We train on a preprocessed 7.48M-word English corpus and compare objective ratios, non-looped and looped architectures, and loop counts. Our final $4\times12$ model uses four physical layers for twelve recurrent traversals and contains 12.18M parameters. The BabyLM 2026 leaderboard reports an Overall Average of 35.42 and an NLP Average of 48.48. Compared with public BabyLM 10M Strict-small GPT-2 and GPT-BERT baselines, it achieves comparable performance on selected linguistic and downstream metrics, including BLiMP and GLUE, with fewer parameters. The loop ablations show that additional recurrent computation can improve training and preserve strong performance on selected linguistic tasks, whereas poorer performance on other tasks may reveal an inherent limitation of the looped design: using only a few physical layers restricts the model's representational space.

AI.tldr: 研究在BabyLM 2026 Strict-small设定下提出Looped GPT-BERT，将GPT-BERT的双目标（掩码下一词与因果语言建模）与深度参数共享结合，用4个物理层循环12次、共12.18M参数，在7.48M词语料上训练，取得可比性能。
AI.motivation: 在训练数据有限时，增大参数量并非提升语言模型性能的唯一途径；小规模参数集通过重复应用也可能达到相当的性能。因此作者探索在低资源（Strict-small）条件下，用循环/参数共享结构替代简单堆叠参数。
AI.method: 构建Looped GPT-BERT：融合GPT-BERT的掩码下一词预测与因果语言建模目标，并对深度维度进行参数共享（循环）。在预处理后的7.48M词英语语料上训练，系统比较目标比例、非循环与循环架构以及循环次数。最终模型为4×12结构，即4个物理层重复遍历12次，共12.18M参数。
AI.result: 在BabyLM 2026排行榜上，Overall Average为35.42，NLP Average为48.48。与公开的BabyLM 10M Strict-small GPT-2和GPT-BERT基线相比，在BLiMP、GLUE等部分语言学与下游指标上以更少参数达到可比性能。循环消融表明，额外的循环计算可改善训练并在部分语言学任务上保持较强表现。
AI.conclusion: 循环参数共享是在数据受限场景下提升性能的有效替代思路，额外循环计算有益；但在部分任务上的较差表现揭示了该循环设计的固有局限——仅用少量物理层会限制模型的表示空间。

title: When Auditors Fabricate: Batch-Size Degradation and Confident Hallucination in LLM Detection of Planted Document Contamination
comment: 8 pages, 3 tables. v2 removes an evaluation-scoring claim that was not independently observed, adds confidence intervals and significance tests, and states the batch size and retrieval confound explicitly. Preprint also deposited at Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21939087
summary: Large language models are increasingly proposed as automated auditors of document quality, yet their reliability as detectors of planted errors is poorly characterised. We construct a contaminated corpus of 150 academic papers spanning supply chain management and medical research, injecting 450 known contaminants of three types: typographical corruption, semantic reversal, and absurd out-of-context insertion. We then evaluate Google Gemini 3.0 Pro's ability to recover a 180-contaminant answer-key subset across 60 documents under three prompting regimes of increasing scale: single document, small batch, and large batch. Detection is unreliable even at small scale and collapses entirely at large scale: 50% recovery on single documents and 60% on small batches, a difference this sample cannot resolve, against 2.8% on large batches. The failure mode at scale is not abstention but fabrication. Rather than reporting incomplete processing, the model produced confident findings including invented contaminants of its own, absurdities such as "telepathic squirrel" and "quantum-powered toaster" that mimic the style of the planted material but do not appear in any document. Detection also varies by contamination type: absurd insertions were recovered at 75% in completed evaluations, while semantic reversals and typographical corruptions were each recovered at only 50%. The corruptions most likely to occur in the wild, plausible ones, are the ones most often missed. We conclude that LLM document auditing degrades not gracefully but deceptively, and outline the harness such systems require: bounded batch sizes, direct content injection, and mechanical verification of every reported finding against source text.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建含450个已知污染物的150篇论文语料，评估Gemini 3.0 Pro在不同批处理规模下的错误检测能力，发现其检测不可靠且在大规模下崩溃并产生虚构发现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被日益用作文档质量的自动审计者，但其作为"植入错误检测器"的可靠性尚缺乏充分表征，作者希望系统评估这一能力及其失效模式。
AI.method: 构建覆盖供应链管理与医学研究的150篇论文污染语料，植入三类共450个污染物（排版损坏、语义反转、荒谬的上下文外插入）；在单文档、小批量、大批量三种递进规模的提示方式下，评估Gemini 3.0 Pro对60篇文档中180个污染物答案子集的回收能力。
AI.result: 检测在小规模下即不可靠、大规模下完全崩溃：单文档回收率50%，小批量60%（该样本无法区分二者差异），大批量仅2.8%。大规模下的失效模式不是弃答而是虚构——模型自信地报告发现，包括自造的"心灵感应松鼠""量子动力烤面包机"等不存在的污染物。检测率还因污染类型而异：荒谬插入在已完成评估中回收率75%，而语义反转与排版损坏各仅50%。
AI.conclusion: 最可能真实发生于现实中的"合理型"污染反而最常被漏检；LLM文档审计的退化并非渐进式的，而是欺骗性的。作者据此提出此类系统所需的约束框架：限制批处理规模、直接注入内容、对每一项报告发现进行针对源文本的机械式核验。

title: Cross-Species Animal Re-Identification with Semantic Consistency Learning
summary: Generalizable animal Re-Identification (ReID) aims to recognize individual animals across species with diverse morphologies and ecological contexts. Unlike person ReID, where different domains share similar body structures, animal species often exhibit drastically different anatomical structures and visual patterns, making it difficult to establish shared visual correspondences. As a result, representations learned across species tend to form fragmented embedding spaces, which severely limits cross-species generalization. To address this challenge, we propose Semantic Consistency Learning (SCL), a framework designed to learn representations that remain stable across appearance variations while preserving semantic structures shared across species. SCL consists of two complementary components. Foreground-Background Decoupled Spectral Normalization (FDSNorm) stabilizes feature statistics by suppressing environment-induced style variations in a region-aware manner, while Cross-species Neighborhood Modeling (CNM) captures transferable relational structures across species through dynamic feature neighborhoods. Extensive experiments on 11 public animal ReID datasets demonstrate that SCL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods under multiple cross-species evaluation protocols and generalizes effectively to previously unseen species and ecological domains. Code is available at https://github.com/Kemalau/ECCV-26-SCL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义一致性学习（SCL）框架，用于可泛化的跨物种动物重识别。
AI.motivation: 动物重识别需跨物种泛化识别个体。与人重识别不同，不同动物物种的解剖结构与视觉模式差异巨大，难以建立共享的视觉对应关系，导致跨物种表征形成碎片化嵌入空间，严重限制跨物种泛化能力。
AI.method: SCL 包含两个互补组件：（1）前景-背景解耦谱归一化（FDSNorm），以区域感知方式抑制环境引起的风格变化，从而稳定特征统计量；（2）跨物种邻域建模（CNM），通过动态特征邻域捕获跨物种可迁移的关系结构。目标是在外观变化下保持表征稳定，同时保留跨物种共享的语义结构。
AI.result: 在 11 个公开动物 ReID 数据集上的大量实验表明，SCL 在多种跨物种评估协议下持续优于现有最先进方法，并能有效泛化至此前未见过的物种与生态域。
AI.conclusion: SCL 通过稳定特征统计与建模跨物种关系结构，缓解了跨物种嵌入空间碎片化问题，提升了动物重识别的跨物种泛化能力。代码已开源。

title: VFNet: Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Model for Void Fraction Estimation in Gas-Liquid Two-Phase Flow
summary: Void fraction, which quantifies the proportion of the fluid flow volume occupied by the gas phase, is a key parameter in the characterization of gas-liquid two-phase flow. Existing estimation methods either rely on flow assumptions that do not generalize across different fluids or on intrusive sensing that disturbs the flow behavior. We propose VFNet, a dual-branch spatio-temporal neural network for void-fraction prediction from synchronized multi-view videos of two-phase flow. A local branch extracts features from confined spatial regions and fuses the synchronized dual views, while a spatio-temporal branch captures the global evolution of the flow across space and time to refine a coarse geometric estimate. Trained on simulated computational fluid dynamics (CFD) data with known ground-truth void fractions and evaluated against both learning-based and traditional baselines, VFNet achieves the best performance across a broad range of metrics and also improves downstream flow-pattern classification on real two-phase flow data.

AI.tldr: 提出VFNet双分支时空神经网络，用同步多视角视频直接从气液两相流中预测空隙率，在CFD仿真数据上训练，性能优于学习型与传统基线，并提升真实数据的流型分类。
AI.motivation: 空隙率是气液两相流表征的关键参数。现有估计方法存在两类局限：一是依赖难以跨流体泛化的流动假设，二是采用侵入式传感，会干扰流场行为。
AI.method: VFNet为双分支时空网络，输入为同步多视角两相流视频。局部分支从受限空间区域提取特征并融合同步双视角信息；时空分支刻画流动在空间与时间上的全局演化，用于细化一个粗粒度的几何估计结果。模型在具有已知空隙率真值的CFD仿真数据上训练。
AI.result: 在多项评价指标上，VFNet在广泛指标范围内取得最佳性能，优于学习型与传统基线；在真实两相流数据上还提升了作为下游任务的流型分类表现。
AI.conclusion: 基于多视角视频的双分支时空网络可实现非侵入、跨流体泛化的空隙率估计，并可作为有效的上游表征服务于流型分类等下游任务。

title: Scaling E-Commerce Attribute Extraction with Parallel Decoding
comment: Accepted to 11th Workshop on Automated Knowledge Base Construction
summary: Customers rely on specific product attributes to compare products and make purchasing decisions, but e-commerce catalogs are messy and unstructured, making it difficult to identify which attributes matter most and extract them at scale. Standard Attribute Value Extraction (AVE) systems treat all attributes equally, producing large, inconsistent attribute sets that do not reflect the factors consumers use to differentiate products. We introduce a two-stage LLM pipeline that first discovers a compact, ranked schema of purchase-discriminative attributes for each product category, then extracts their values from catalog text using a fine-tuned compact LLM (Qwen3-4B) with Hyper-Parallel Decoding (HPD). This pipeline achieves 85% extraction accuracy, on par with the foundational LLM it was distilled from, while reducing inference costs by 92% over foundational LLMs, enabling production-scale use for product discovery and catalog enrichment. The resulting category-level structured representations effectively constitute automatically constructed product knowledge bases, providing consistent, comparable attributes across varied product categories that can ground downstream knowledge-intensive applications.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段LLM流水线：先为每个品类发现紧凑、按购买区分度排序的属性模式，再用微调的小模型（Qwen3-4B）配合超并行解码（HPD）从目录文本抽取属性值，达到85%抽取准确率，推理成本较基座LLM降低92%。
AI.motivation: 电商目录杂乱、非结构化，消费者依赖特定产品属性进行比价与购买决策，但难以识别哪些属性最关键并大规模抽取。现有属性值抽取（AVE）系统对所有属性一视同仁，生成庞大且不一致的属性集合，无法反映消费者真正的区分性因素。
AI.method: 两阶段LLM流水线：第一阶段为每个产品品类自动发现一个紧凑、按购买区分度排序的属性模式（schema）；第二阶段使用经微调的紧凑LLM（Qwen3-4B）结合超并行解码（HPD），从目录文本中抽取对应属性值。
AI.result: 抽取准确率达85%，与其蒸馏来源的基座LLM相当；推理成本相比基座LLM降低92%，可支持产品发现与目录富化的生产级应用。产出的品类级结构化表示实际上构成了自动构建的产品知识库，跨品类提供一致、可比较的属性，可用于支撑下游知识密集型应用。
AI.conclusion: 通过“属性发现+小模型高效抽取”的两阶段设计，兼顾了属性集的质量（紧凑、购买区分性强）与部署效率（低成本、高准确率），并将品类级结构化表示转化为自动构建的产品知识库，为产品发现和知识密集型下游任务提供可扩展的支撑。

title: StreamAlign: Streaming Text-Aligned Speech Tokenization
comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026. Project page: https://ishlove77.github.io/StreamAlign/
summary: Text-aligned speech tokenization methods have emerged to better align speech tokens with LLM token spaces, enabling more effective utilization of pretrained LLMs. However, they rely on offline automatic speech recognition (ASR), leading to two key limitations: (i) the need for complete utterances before tokenization, precluding real-time streaming, and (ii) vocabulary mismatch between ASR and LLMs, which reduces acoustic granularity from the subword to the word level. We introduce StreamAlign, a text-aligned speech tokenization framework that enables streaming tokenization for real-time speech-text joint modeling. StreamAlign performs online speech-text alignment by combining character-level RNN-Transducer alignment with word-level ASR guidance, mitigating ASR-LLM vocabulary mismatch while preserving recognition accuracy. A proactive word boundary classifier anticipates word completion at chunk boundaries, reducing tokenization latency from 560 ms to 270 ms. On LibriSpeech, StreamAlign achieves the lowest WER and highest UTMOS among evaluated tokenizers. Furthermore, StreamAlign-SLM, a spoken language model trained on StreamAlign units, outperforms other end-to-end spoken language models in speech continuation while achieving the strongest overall consistency on SALMon and spoken StoryCloze.

AI.tldr: StreamAlign 提出流式文本对齐语音分词框架，通过在线字符级 RNN-T 对齐与词级 ASR 引导，实现实时流式分词，将分词延迟从 560ms 降至 270ms，并在识别精度与语音语言模型性能上取得领先。
AI.motivation: 现有文本对齐语音分词方法依赖离线 ASR，存在两大局限：（i）必须等到完整语音段才能分词，无法支持实时流式处理；（ii）ASR 与 LLM 词表不匹配，使声学粒度从子词级退化为词级，损失细粒度信息。
AI.method: StreamAlign 结合字符级 RNN-Transducer 对齐与词级 ASR 引导进行在线语音-文本对齐，缓解 ASR-LLM 词表不匹配并保持识别精度；同时引入主动式词边界分类器，在分块边界预测词是否完成，从而降低分词延迟。
AI.result: 在 LibriSpeech 上，StreamAlign 在所评估的分词器中取得最低 WER 和最高 UTMOS；分词延迟由 560ms 降至 270ms。基于 StreamAlign 单元训练的语音语言模型 StreamAlign-SLM 在语音续写任务上优于其他端到端语音语言模型，并在 SALMon 与口语 StoryCloze 上取得最强整体一致性。
AI.conclusion: StreamAlign 首次实现面向实时语音-文本联合建模的流式文本对齐分词，兼顾低延迟、识别精度与语言建模性能，为流式语音语言模型提供了有效方案。

title: Can Artificial Intelligence Support Healthcare and Mental Health Through Early Cyberbullying Detection ? The Impact of Emotion-Aware AI on Proactive Online Safety
summary: Healthcare systems, mental health, and public well-being are increasingly affected by cyberbullying and harmful online interactions. This paper presents CareGuard, an early-warning framework designed to support healthcare-driven mental health protection and proactive online safety through the detection of cyberbullying-related content using advanced natural language processing techniques. CareGuard integrates zero-shot semantic labeling with fine-tuned transformer-based models, including BERT, DistilBERT, and RoBERTa, to enable robust and context-aware classification across sensitive cyberbullying categories. To improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary computation in healthcare-oriented monitoring settings, the framework incorporates an emotion-aware filtering mechanism alongside cosine similarity-based semantic screening, allowing the system to focus on semantically relevant and emotionally salient content. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that CareGuard effectively balances detection accuracy and computational efficiency, highlighting its potential for scalable deployment in healthcare systems, mental health monitoring, and online safety applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CareGuard早期预警框架，结合零样本语义标注与微调Transformer模型（BERT、DistilBERT、RoBERTa），并引入情感感知过滤和余弦相似度语义筛查，在基准数据集上实现了检测准确率与计算效率的平衡，面向医疗健康与心理健康监测场景。
AI.motivation: 医疗系统、心理健康与公共福祉日益受到网络欺凌和有害在线交互的影响，亟需能够支持心理健康保护与主动在线安全的早期预警手段。
AI.method: CareGuard将零样本语义标注与微调Transformer模型（BERT、DistilBERT、RoBERTa）相结合，实现跨敏感网络欺凌类别的上下文感知分类；同时引入情感感知过滤机制与基于余弦相似度的语义筛查，以降低医疗监测场景中不必要的计算开销。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的实验结果表明，CareGuard有效平衡了检测准确率与计算效率。
AI.conclusion: CareGuard在医疗系统、心理健康监测与在线安全应用中具备可扩展部署的潜力。

title: IAE-VTG: Interaction-Aligned Action-Entity Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) localizes the video segment that matches a natural-language query. Many queries describe an action performed by a particular entity. Existing methods often encode the query as a whole or use general video-text interactions, without explicitly checking whether the action and entity occur together. They may therefore select a segment that contains both concepts but not the event described by the query. We propose Interaction Aligned Action-Entity Video Temporal Grounding (IAE-VTG), which models this rela?tionship at both the representation and training assignment levels. First, the Fine-grained Disentangled Interaction Module (FDIM) separates action and entity related query information and aligns it with complementary motion and appearance features. It then combines token-level interactions to build representations that capture the relationship between the action and entity. Second, Interaction-Sensitive Assignment (ISA) adds this interaction evidence to bipartite matching, so training targets are selected using both temporal overlap and semantic compatibility. This reduces supervision from temporally plausible but semantically incorrect proposals. Experiments on QVHighlights, Charades?STA, and TACoS show that IAE-VTG consistently improves strong baselines and achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance on standard grounding metrics. Additional analyses show that the method is especially effective when similar actions or entities appear at multiple times and produces more reliable assignments for complex events.

AI.tldr: 提出IAE-VTG，通过表示与训练分配两个层面显式建模"动作-实体"关系，提升视频时序定位准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有VTG方法将查询整体编码或仅做通用视频-文本交互，未显式验证动作与实体是否共同出现，导致可能选出同时含两者概念但并非查询所述事件的片段。
AI.method: 1) 细粒度解耦交互模块（FDIM）：分离查询中动作与实体信息，分别与运动、外观特征对齐，再融合token级交互以构建刻画动作-实体关系的表示；2) 交互敏感分配（ISA）：将交互证据引入二分匹配，使训练目标同时依据时间重叠与语义兼容性选择，减少"时间合理但语义错误"提案的监督。
AI.result: 在QVHighlights、Charades-STA、TACoS上持续提升强基线，标准定位指标达到竞争性或SOTA水平；分析显示在相似动作/实体多次出现及复杂事件上尤为有效，分配更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模动作-实体交互关系并在匹配分配中加以利用，可有效缓解语义误配问题，提升视频时序定位性能。

title: Distilling Image Prototypes for Guided Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) enhances the robustness of models against distribution shifts but faces two critical challenges: error accumulation from noisy pseudo-labels and catastrophic forgetting of source knowledge. Uncertainty-based approaches designed to mitigate error accumulation often yield overconfident or computationally expensive estimates, while strategies intended to prevent forgetting via prototype replay rely on static representations that easily become misaligned as the model adapts. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel framework, Distilling Image Prototype for Guided Test-Time Adaptation (DIPTTA). The core of the proposed approach is the introduction of a Distill Image Prototype (DIP), a compact set of synthetic images that serves as a dynamic and regenerative anchor of source knowledge. This prototype enables a dynamic feature replay mechanism that continuously generates feature prototypes aligned with the current state of the model, thus effectively preventing catastrophic forgetting. Furthermore, the DIP anchors a source-calibrated uncertainty estimation method, which provides a less biased measure of sample reliability by leveraging stable source knowledge, thereby robustly suppressing error accumulation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DIPTTA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under severe domain shifts. The source code is available at https://github.com/LiwenWang919/DIPTTA.

AI.tldr: 提出DIPTTA框架，用可再生的蒸馏图像原型（DIP）同时解决测试时自适应中的误差累积与灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 测试时自适应（TTA）虽能提升模型对分布偏移的鲁棒性，但面临两大挑战：一是噪声伪标签导致的误差累积，二是源知识被灾难性遗忘。现有基于不确定性的方法往往给出过度自信或计算昂贵的估计，而基于原型回放的防遗忘策略依赖静态表征，随模型自适应容易失配。
AI.method: 提出DIPTTA框架。核心是引入蒸馏图像原型（DIP）——一小组紧凑的合成图像，作为源知识的动态且可再生锚点。基于DIP构建动态特征回放机制，持续生成与模型当前状态对齐的特征原型，防止灾难性遗忘；同时DIP锚定一种源校准的不确定性估计方法，利用稳定的源知识给出偏差更小的样本可靠性度量，从而抑制误差累积。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，DIPTTA显著优于现有最先进方法，在严重域偏移下优势尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过以合成图像原型作为动态可再生的源知识锚点，DIPTTA统一缓解了误差累积与灾难性遗忘两大难题，验证了动态特征回放与源校准不确定性估计的有效性，代码已开源。

title: LLaDA-UI: Bringing Block-wise Diffusion to Vision-Language GUI Agents
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) achieve high decoding efficiency through block-parallel, arbitrary-order generation, making them attractive for latency-sensitive applications. GUI agents represent a natural testbed for this paradigm, as they must repeatedly perceive screen states and emit structured, spatially grounded actions in real time. However, whether dLLMs can be extended into capable multimodal GUI agents while preserving their parallel decoding advantage remains an open question. We present LLaDA-UI, a 16.7B-parameter MoE-based, block-wise diffusion vision-language GUI agent. LLaDA-UI follows a two-stage training pipeline: general multimodal pre-training aligns a native-resolution vision encoder with the LLaDA2.0-mini-base diffusion language backbone, followed by GUI-agent supervised fine-tuning on diverse mobile, desktop, web, and grounding data. Across widely adopted grounding benchmarks and navigation benchmarks spanning multiple platforms, LLaDA-UI substantially outperforms Qwen2.5-VL-7B and surpasses Qwen3-VL-8B on four of six reported GUI benchmarks. These results establish block-wise diffusion as a practical generative paradigm for multimodal GUI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LLaDA-UI，一个基于 MoE 的 167 亿参数、块级扩散视觉语言 GUI 智能体，通过两阶段训练（多模态预训练+GUI 监督微调）在多个 GUI 基准上超越 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，并在六项基准中的四项上超过 Qwen3-VL-8B。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）凭借块并行、任意顺序生成实现高解码效率，适合延迟敏感的 GUI 智能体场景；但 dLLM 能否在保持并行解码优势的同时扩展为具备能力的多模态 GUI 智能体仍未明确。
AI.method: LLaDA-UI 为 16.7B 参数的 MoE 架构块级扩散视觉语言 GUI 智能体，采用两阶段训练：第一阶段通过通用多模态预训练，将原生分辨率视觉编码器与 LLaDA2.0-mini-base 扩散语言主干对齐；第二阶段在移动端、桌面、网页及 grounding 等多样化数据上进行 GUI 智能体监督微调。
AI.result: 在多个广泛采用的 grounding 基准和跨平台导航基准上，LLaDA-UI 显著优于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，并在六项 GUI 基准中的四项上超过 Qwen3-VL-8B。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了块级扩散作为多模态 GUI 智能体的一种实用生成范式。

title: A Low Grounding Score Is Not an Ungrounded Judge: Identifying the Perceptibility Confound in Multimodal Oversight
summary: Model judges now supervise multimodal systems at scale, filtering training data, selecting outputs, and supplying the reward that shapes multimodal reasoning models. Trusting one means first checking that it uses its evidence, and that check is itself worth scrutinizing, so we ask whether a counterfactual probe of visual grounding measures what it claims to. The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. We formalize it as the Verdict Grounding Score and show it cannot be read the way such scores are read. A verdict responds only to an edit that reaches the judge's decision-relevant reading, so the score is capped by how perceptible the edit is, and unless editing makes the attribute easier to read, the error is one-sided: the score can only make a judge look less grounded than it is. The practical failure is therefore a false alarm, an auditor discarding a usable overseer. Under assumptions we state, we show this missing quantity is not merely bounded but identified from three quantities the same audit protocol already collects, which makes the false-alarm rate directly measurable rather than merely a concern. Auditing nine judges, we find the predicted ordering holds strictly across our entire primary pool, and the typical judge there acts on only about half of the edits whose attribute it can otherwise resolve. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. The rule that follows is that an image-side counterfactual score should never be reported alone: a detection probe on the unedited image upper-bounds it, certifies its false alarms, and costs nothing extra to run.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"裁决接地分"（Verdict Grounding Score）这一反事实探测指标，用于衡量多模态评判模型是否真正利用了图像证据；但本文证明该分数无法按常规方式解读：它受编辑可感知性上限约束，误差呈单侧性，只会让评判者显得比实际更不接图。
AI.motivation: 模型评判者已在大规模上监督多模态系统（筛选训练数据、挑选输出、提供奖励）。信任此类评判者的前提是确认它确实使用了图像证据，而现有对视觉接地的反事实探测是否真的测量了它声称测量的东西，本身值得审视。
AI.method: 形式化定义为裁决接地分：编辑图像使真值翻转、固定思维链、观察裁决是否随之改变。证明该分数受编辑可感知性上限约束，除非编辑使属性更易读，否则误差为单侧（只会低估接地性）。在所声明的假设下，证明该缺失量不仅可被界定，还可由同一审计协议已收集的三个量识别出来，从而使虚警率可直接测量。
AI.result: 审计九个评判者，预测的排序在主要池中严格成立；典型评判者仅对约一半其本可分辨属性的编辑做出反应。采用保守拒绝阈值后，若干单元格被直接判定为虚警，最明显的是一个几乎每次都能检测出注入错误、却仍被评分为"完全未使用图像"的评判者。
AI.conclusion: 图像侧反事实分数绝不应单独报告：对未编辑图像的检测探针可为其提供上界、认证其虚警，且运行无需额外成本。

title: Arti-JEPA: Adapting Video World Model to Real-Time MRI of the Vocal Tract for Speech-Production Analysis
summary: Real-time MRI (rtMRI) captures the dynamics of the entire vocal tract during speech, but labeled data are scarce and the modality - single-slice, grayscale, low-resolution - differs substantially from the natural videos that video foundation models are trained on. We introduce Arti-JEPA, a joint embedding predictive architecture to model vocal tract rtMRI by continuing its self-supervised objective on about 62h of unlabelled vocal-tract videos, and evaluate the frozen representation on three tasks: cross-domain phoneme prediction (on typical speakers), fluent-vs-disfluent classification (a corpus containing stuttered speech), and characterizing pre/post-operative transfer (after partial glossectomy). Three key findings emerge. (1) A temporal video prior decisively outperforms per-frame image encoders, and latent prediction (V-JEPA) is at least as strong as pixel reconstruction (VideoMAE), with the edge on fine-grained phonemes. (2) Domain adaptation is \emph{task-dependent}: it roughly doubles cross-domain phoneme prediction $κ$ (to 0.352) but does not help binary stuttering classification. (3) Arti-JEPA was able to recover phoneme signal from pre/post glossectomy speech --- an in-domain probe decodes patients at least as well as a typical speaker, indicating that the residual transfer gap is cross-speaker/domain misalignment, not surgical signal loss, and post-operative decoding does not fall below performance on pre-operative speech. Together, these position a frozen, domain-adapted rtMRI encoder as a reusable measurement tool for articulatory and clinical speech science.

AI.tldr: 提出Arti-JEPA，用约62小时无标注声道rtMRI视频继续自监督训练，冻结表征在音素预测、流畅/不流畅分类及舌部分切除术前术后迁移三任务上验证。
AI.motivation: rtMRI可捕捉整条声道的语音动态，但标注数据稀缺，且其单切片、灰度、低分辨率特性与视频基础模型训练所用的自然视频差异巨大，因此需要适配该模态的表征学习方案。
AI.method: 在约62小时无标注声道视频上以联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA，V-JEPA式潜空间预测）继续自监督目标；在冻结表征上评估三个任务：跨域音素预测、流畅与不流畅（含口吃）分类、以及部分舌切除术的术前术后迁移分析。
AI.result: (1) 时序视频先验显著优于逐帧图像编码器，潜空间预测（V-JEPA）至少与像素重建（VideoMAE）相当，且在细粒度音素上更优；(2) 域自适应具任务依赖性：跨域音素预测κ约翻倍至0.352，但对二分类口吃识别无帮助；(3) 能从术前术后语音中恢复音素信号，域内探针解码患者表现不低于典型说话者，术后解码不低于术前。
AI.conclusion: 残余迁移差距源于跨说话人/跨域失配而非手术信号损失；冻结且域自适应的rtMRI编码器可作为发音与临床语音科学的可复用测量工具。

title: MethaneFuse: Learning from Multi-Sensor Satellite Observations for Methane Plume Detection
summary: Methane plume detection from satellite imagery is constrained by incomplete observations: public satellites provide complementary spatial, spectral, and atmospheric evidence, but real plume cases rarely contain fully paired multi-sensor measurements because of revisit schedules, cloud coverage, acquisition quality, and the transient nature of emissions. Most learning-based detectors rely on single-sensor inputs, especially Sentinel-2 (S2), leaving many reported plume cases unusable. We construct MethaneUnion, a temporal multi-sensor dataset built from Carbon Mapper plume reports and matched S2, Landsat 8/9 (L8/9), EMIT, and Sentinel-5P (S5P) observations. Built on MethaneUnion, MethaneFuse learns from heterogeneous satellite observations under partial sensor availability without requiring complete four-sensor measurements. MethaneUnion expands usable coverage from 3,211 valid S2-matched plume cases to 8,981 reported plume cases with multi-sensor observations. At the representative 480 m setting, MethaneFuse achieves 84.87 F1 and 93.62 AUROC, improving over the strongest baseline by 5.65 F1 and 8.30 AUROC points while reducing false positives by 8.19 points. Sensor-availability experiments show that MethaneFuse improves detection when S2 is available and transfers plume knowledge to L8/9, EMIT, and S5P when S2 is unavailable. These results demonstrate the value of learning from incomplete heterogeneous sensor observations for practical methane plume detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MethaneUnion多传感器时序数据集与MethaneFuse模型，通过在不完整异构卫星观测下学习，将可用羽流样本从3,211扩展到8,981，并在480m设定下达到84.87 F1、93.62 AUROC。
AI.motivation: 卫星甲烷羽流检测受观测不完整制约：公开卫星（S2、L8/9、EMIT、S5P）在空间、光谱与大气信息上互补，但由于重访周期、云覆盖、采集质量及排放瞬变性，真实案例极少具备完整配对的多传感器测量。现有学习方法多依赖单一传感器（尤其Sentinel-2）输入，导致大量已报告羽流案例无法使用。
AI.method: 构建MethaneUnion时序多传感器数据集，基于Carbon Mapper羽流报告匹配S2、Landsat 8/9、EMIT与Sentinel-5P观测；在其上提出MethaneFuse，可在传感器部分可用条件下从异构卫星观测中学习，无需完整的四传感器测量。
AI.result: MethaneUnion将可用覆盖从3,211个有效S2匹配羽流案例扩展至8,981个具多传感器观测的报告案例。在代表性480 m设定下，MethaneFuse取得84.87 F1与93.62 AUROC，较最强基线提升5.65 F1和8.30 AUROC，同时假阳性降低8.19个百分点。传感器可用性实验显示，S2可用时检测性能提升，S2缺失时可将羽流知识迁移至L8/9、EMIT与S5P。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，从不完整的异构传感器观测中学习对实际甲烷羽流检测具有重要价值。

title: SocialRL: Refining LLMs' Social Intelligence through Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning and Reward Design
summary: Social intelligence enables agents to read social context, infer intent, and adapt over sustained dialogue. As language models become autonomous collaborators, it is central to building effective and trustworthy human-AI interaction. Existing reinforcement learning methods optimize single-turn utterances and sparse outcome rewards, producing short-sighted policies that struggle to manage goal-relationship tensions across multi-turn interactions. We propose SocialRL, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework addressing both challenges. First, we apply multi-turn reinforcement learning using PPO that propagates delayed outcome rewards back to each turn, enabling long-horizon planning. Second, we design six process reward dimensions capturing the goal-relationship trade-off, including goal advancement, relational attunement, contextual coherence, etc. A reward model dynamically generates fine-grained scoring criteria for each dimension, while a stage-aware weight schedule prioritizes relationship-building in early turns, goal advancement mid-way, and balanced closure late. Across multiple social-dialogue benchmarks, SocialRL improves Goal Achievement by an average of 9.2 percentage points over the corresponding Base models. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of SocialRL across synthetic and real social scenes, as well as standard and challenging social scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出SocialRL多轮强化学习框架，通过PPO将延迟结果奖励回传至各轮以实现长时程规划，并设计六个过程奖励维度与阶段感知权重调度，在多个社交对话基准上平均提升目标达成率9.2个百分点。
AI.motivation: 社会智能要求智能体在多轮对话中解读社交语境、推断意图并持续适应，是构建有效且可信人机交互的核心。现有强化学习方法仅优化单轮话语且依赖稀疏的结果奖励，导致策略短视，难以在多轮交互中管理"目标—关系"之间的张力。该工作旨在同时解决长时程规划与目标-关系权衡两大挑战。
AI.method: 提出SocialRL多轮强化学习框架，包含两部分设计：其一，采用PPO进行多轮强化学习，将延迟的结果奖励回传至每一轮，实现长时程规划；其二，设计六个刻画目标-关系权衡的过程奖励维度（目标推进、关系契合、语境连贯等），由奖励模型为每个维度动态生成细粒度评分标准，并配合阶段感知权重调度——早期轮次侧重关系建立，中期侧重目标推进，后期侧重平衡收尾。
AI.result: 在多个社交对话基准上，SocialRL相较对应的Base模型在目标达成度（Goal Achievement）上平均提升9.2个百分点，验证了其在合成与真实社交场景、以及标准与高难度社交情境下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多轮强化学习结合延迟奖励回传与细粒度过程奖励设计，能够有效缓解单轮优化与稀疏奖励带来的短视问题，在目标-关系权衡的社交对话任务中取得稳定提升，适用于多样化的社交场景。

title: CARRE: Counterfactual Action Retrieval and Reason Evaluation for Explainable Churn Prescription
comment: 14pages, 1 figure, Accepted at Workshop on 5th End-to-End Customer Journey Optimization at the International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
summary: Churn models typically identify high-risk customers but do not specify which feasible retention action should be considered or why that action is appropriate. We present CARRE (Counterfactual Action Retrieval and Reason Evaluation), a three-stage framework that combines retrieval-augmented candidate generation, cost-aware counterfactual scoring, and large language model (LLM) reasoning. CARRE retrieves a predefined catalog of retention actions, estimates model-predicted churn-risk changes under explicit feature transformations, and generates a structured churn reason and a profile-grounded explanation for the selected action. On the IBM Telco Customer Churn dataset, CARRE achieves 79.8% greater mean model-predicted risk reduction than the plain SHAP baseline and 80.4% greater reduction than the cost-controlled SHAP+Cost baseline across 313 high-risk test cases; its cost-normalized efficiency is 10.5% higher than that of plain SHAP. On a 136-case reason-stratified evaluation sample, diagnosis-driven prompt refinement increases weak-label agreement from 79.4% to 90.4%, with no auxiliary-plan constraint violations; because the same sample was used for error diagnosis and re-evaluation, the post-refinement result is not an independent estimate of generalization. For 135 explanations generated using the pre-refinement v2 reason outputs, two cross-vendor LLM judges assign mean scores ranging from 4.02 to 5.00 out of 5, although one judge saturates on actionability, and a deterministic audit finds no contradictions among 66 verifiable profile claims. Retrieval ablations show that k=5 provides the best evaluated compromise between high candidate coverage and downstream reasoning agreement in this dataset. These results illustrate how retrieval, model-based counterfactual scoring, and language generation can be separated and jointly evaluated in a prototype churn-prescription pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出CARRE三阶段框架，将流失预测从风险识别扩展为可执行挽留方案推荐，结合检索、反事实评分与LLM推理，并在IBM Telco数据集上验证其风险降低、成本效率与解释质量优势。
AI.motivation: 传统流失模型仅识别高风险客户，不指明应采用哪种可行挽留动作及其理由。本文旨在弥补"预测"与"处方"之间的鸿沟，构建可给出具体挽留行动及理由的流失处方流程。
AI.method: CARRE为三阶段框架：(1)检索增强的候选动作生成，从预定义挽留动作目录中检索；(2)成本感知的反事实评分，在显式特征变换下估计模型预测的流失风险变化；(3)LLM推理，生成结构化流失原因与基于用户画像的动作解释。还采用诊断驱动的提示优化，并进行检索k值与消融实验。
AI.result: 在IBM Telco数据集313个高风险样本上，CARRE的平均模型预测风险降低比plain SHAP高79.8%，比成本控制的SHAP+Cost高80.4%，成本归一化效率比plain SHAP高10.5%。在136例原因分层样本上，诊断驱动提示优化使弱标签一致率从79.4%升至90.4%，且无辅助方案约束违反（但该样本同时用于诊断与复评，非独立泛化估计）。135个v2解释由两个跨厂商LLM评判，均分4.02–5.00/5，其中一个在可执行性上饱和；确定性审计未发现66条可验证画像陈述存在矛盾。检索消融显示k=5在候选覆盖与下游推理一致率间取得最佳折中。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，检索、基于模型的反事实评分与语言生成可在原型流失处方流程中被分离并联合评估；CARRE在风险降低、成本效率与解释质量上优于SHAP类基线，但部分评估存在非独立性与评判饱和等局限。

title: Fine-Tuning a KV Cache Concatenation-Aware Model or Recomputing KV Caches? Why Not Both?
summary: In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, a large number of retrieved chunks are concatenated to form the input context so that users can receive high-quality responses based on external knowledge. As a result, the input context length increases substantially, leading to a larger prefill workload and, in turn, a longer time to first token (TTFT). While previous works that reuse precomputed key-value (KV) caches effectively reduce TTFT for long-context inputs, it remains unclear whether response quality is preserved when the input context becomes very long. In this paper, we propose a combined approach that (i) fine-tunes the model while taking KV cache concatenation into account and (ii) selectively recomputes a subset of the KV caches. By applying both techniques, we demonstrate improved accuracy for long-context inputs. Experiments on the RULER benchmark show that, for a 124k-token input, our method improves the RULER score by 9.7 point over the baseline that recomputes KV caches only. Moreover, TTFT is reduced by 80% compared with full attention.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对RAG长上下文输入中KV缓存复用导致响应质量下降的问题，提出结合"面向KV缓存拼接的微调"与"选择性重算部分KV缓存"的方法，在保持低TTFT的同时提升长上下文精度。
AI.motivation: RAG系统需拼接大量检索片段作为输入上下文，导致上下文长度大幅增加、prefill负载加重、首token时延(TTFT)变长。已有工作通过复用预计算的KV缓存有效降低TTFT，但当输入上下文极长时，响应质量能否保持尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出组合式方法：(i) 在微调模型时将KV缓存拼接过程纳入考虑；(ii) 对KV缓存的一个子集进行选择性重算。两者结合应用于长上下文输入。
AI.result: 在RULER基准上，对于124k token的输入，相比仅重算KV缓存的基线，RULER分数提升9.7分；相比全注意力，TTFT降低80%。
AI.conclusion: 通过"感知KV缓存拼接的微调+选择性KV缓存重算"可在显著降低TTFT的同时提升长上下文RAG的响应质量，兼顾效率与精度。

title: SymbolicLight V2: Hybrid Neuromorphic Architecture and Sparse Execution for Low-Energy Language Inference
summary: SymbolicLight V2 combines sparse event computation with continuous-state processing in a hybrid neuromorphic language architecture. Extending V1's spike-gated dual paths, it adds graded signed events at further projections and softmax-free local attention. We implement the 194M-parameter model on an Alveo U50C FPGA using digital fixed-point arithmetic and on an ARM CPU using sparse integer execution. Across three same-checkpoint FPGA implementations at 175 MHz, active-row weight gathering and valid-state KV loading raise decode throughput from 474.6 to 643.2 tokens/s for a 32-token prefix and 128 outputs. Estimated gross card energy falls from 0.06087 to 0.04407 J per generated token, a 27.6% reduction. Complete-request energy, including prefill, falls by 24.4-27.7% across three prefix lengths. An independent idle split attributes 82.8% of gross card energy to loaded idle, explaining the benefit of shorter token latency. Against the recorded RTX 5090 compiled-FP32 baseline, integer FPGA execution uses 89.1% less estimated card energy during short-context decode; arithmetic precisions differ, and the GPU baseline is not the lowest-energy tested configuration. On four Cortex-A76 cores of a ROCK 5T, complete requests reach 65.4 tokens/s at 9.80 W and 0.151 J per generated token at the adapter's AC input. These results connect event sparsity to omitted computation and data movement. The mechanisms also support other dedicated V2 implementations: increasing throughput by a greater factor than active power lowers energy per generated token. Evaluation holds the deployed checkpoint fixed; its quality trails a same-budget dense control, so the results do not establish equal-quality efficiency.

AI.tldr: SymbolicLight V2 将稀疏事件计算与连续状态处理结合，在 FPGA（Alveo U50C）与 ARM CPU（ROCK 5T）上实现并优化 194M 参数模型的推理能效与吞吐。
AI.motivation: 延续 V1 的脉冲门控双路径设计，探索事件稀疏性如何转化为计算与数据搬运的省略，从而降低生成每 token 的能耗。
AI.method: 在 V1 基础上于更深投影引入分级带符号事件与无 softmax 局部注意力；用数字定点算术在 Alveo U50C FPGA（175 MHz）实现，并在 ARM CPU 上用稀疏整数执行；通过活跃行权重收集与有效状态 KV 加载优化三组同检查点 FPGA 实现。
AI.result: 32-token 前缀、128 输出下解码吞吐从 474.6 提升至 643.2 tokens/s；每 token 估算板卡总能耗从 0.06087 降至 0.04407 J（降 27.6%）；含 prefill 的完整请求能耗在三种前缀长度下下降 24.4–27.7%；空闲拆分显示 82.8% 总能耗来自 loaded idle。相较 RTX 5090 编译 FP32 基线，短上下文解码估算能耗低 89.1%。ROCK 5T 四核 Cortex-A76 上完整请求达 65.4 tokens/s、9.80 W、0.151 J/token。
AI.conclusion: 事件稀疏性可映射为省略的计算与数据搬运；吞吐提升幅度大于有功功率增幅即可降低每生成 token 能耗。评估固定部署检查点，其质量略逊于同预算稠密对照，故未证明等质量下的效率优势。

title: ROAM: Robust Organization of Atomic Memories for Agents through Semantic Relations
summary: Long-term language-model agents rely on external memory across interactions. Atomic memories are particularly useful: their fine-grained semantic boundaries enable precise retrieval and direct comparison between observations. Yet accumulating atoms inevitably become redundant, overlapping, or conflicting. Existing methods often ask an LLM manager to add, update, delete, or rewrite memories directly, coupling semantic interpretation, storage decisions, and content generation in one error-prone operation. We introduce ROAM, a relation-guided framework that uses atomicity for management while allowing richer answer-time representations. ROAM classifies incoming--stored atom pairs as independent, equivalent, directionally subsuming, or conflicting, then organizes observations into active Primary and supporting Evidence roles. Fusion subsequently combines complementary details and temporal changes into compact, potentially non-atomic views. Only Primary views are retrieved for answering, preventing redundant or outdated atoms from competing independently. Across models and evaluation settings, ROAM improves answer accuracy by up to 29.8 percentage points. Ablations show complementary benefits from different relations and consistent gains from fusion beyond role organization. Mechanism analysis further finds 15.6-point higher answer-critical source recall and an 11.5-point lower confounder-token share. ROAM remains robust across manager scales.

AI.tldr: ROAM 是一个关系引导的记忆管理框架：先对原子记忆对做关系分类，再用主/证据角色组织并融合，使检索只命中主视图，从而提升长期智能体的回答表现。
AI.motivation: 长期语言模型智能体依赖跨交互的外部记忆。原子记忆因细粒度语义边界而便于精确检索与直接比较，但持续累积会产生冗余、重叠与冲突。现有方法让 LLM 管理器直接增删改重写记忆，将语义解释、存储决策与内容生成耦合在一个易错操作中。
AI.method: ROAM 采用关系引导框架，以原子性做管理、以更丰富的回答期表示做使用。它将“新来原子—已存原子”对分为独立、等价、方向性包含、冲突四类，并将观察组织为活跃的 Primary 与支撑性 Evidence 角色；随后 Fusion 将互补细节与时间变化合并为紧凑、可非原子的视图。仅 Primary 视图被检索用于回答，避免冗余或过时原子各自竞争。
AI.result: 在不同模型与评测设置下，ROAM 的回答准确率最高提升 29.8 个百分点。消融显示不同关系带来互补收益，且 Fusion 在角色组织之外仍有一致增益。机制分析发现，回答关键来源召回率提升 15.6 个百分点，混淆项 token 占比降低 11.5 个百分点。ROAM 在不同管理器规模下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: ROAM 通过将记忆管理解耦为关系分类、角色组织与视图融合，有效缓解原子记忆的冗余、重叠与冲突问题，在准确率、关键证据召回与抗混淆能力上均取得提升，并具备跨模型、跨设置与跨管理器规模的稳健性。

title: LogiScope-VQA: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Logistics Hazard Identification in Industrial Scenarios
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) large-scale deployment in industrial warehouse settings specifically necessitates that models exhibit human-expert-level hazard-oriented perception, understanding, and reasoning capabilities. However, the scarcity of real industrial data, tightly coupled to commercial terms, significantly hampers further advancement. To bridge this gap, we curate LogiScope-VQA to investigate the practical applicability of mainstream LMMs in real-world logistics operations. LogiScope-VQA comprises 2,476 images and 2,918 videos primarily sourced from real-world logistics parks, along with 10,274 VQAs meticulously curated and validated by human annotators. Grounded in 18 core objects and 20 risk types, we devise 39 subtasks aligned with three principal themes: industrial element perception, warehouse knowledge understanding, and potential risk reasoning. Furthermore, we incorporate dynamic thinking-budget configurations and dual-dimensional risk bias analyses to elucidate the properties of LMMs. Extensive experiments unveil that even powerful proprietary models, including GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and Claude-Opus-4.7, exhibit a significant gap relative to human performance. The unique challenge of jointly integrating perception, understanding, and reasoning for hazard identification poses substantial headroom for further improvement on LogiScope-VQA. We additionally reveal the pervasive security bias issue that impedes LLMs' practical deployment in real-world settings. The industrial dataset is publicly available under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了面向工业仓储物流场景的大规模多模态基准 LogiScope-VQA，用于评估主流大型多模态模型在隐患感知、理解与推理方面的专家级能力。
AI.motivation: 工业仓储场景对 LMMs 的隐患感知、理解与推理提出人类专家级要求，但真实工业数据稀缺且受商业条款限制，阻碍了相关研究进展。因此需要一个基于真实物流场景的基准来检验主流 LMMs 的实际适用性。
AI.method: 构建 LogiScope-VQA 数据集，包含 2,476 张图像与 2,918 段视频（主要来自真实物流园区），以及 10,274 条经人工标注者精心整理并验证的 VQA。基于 18 类核心对象与 20 类风险，设计 39 个子任务，归入工业要素感知、仓储知识理解、潜在风险推理三大主题。此外引入动态思维预算配置与双维度风险偏差分析以刻画 LMMs 特性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，即便是 GPT-5.5、Gemini-3.1-Pro、Claude-Opus-4.7 等强 proprietary 模型，与人类表现仍存在显著差距；同时揭示了普遍存在的安全偏差问题，阻碍 LLMs 在真实场景中的实际部署。
AI.conclusion: 在 LogiScope-VQA 上，联合整合感知、理解与推理以进行隐患识别具有独特挑战性，仍有巨大提升空间。数据集以 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可公开。

title: MUCnoHARM@GermEval Shared Task 2026: Retrieval-based In-Context Learning for Defamatory Offences, and Where It Falls Short
comment: accepted at GermEval Workshop on Harmful Content Detection @ KONVENS 2026
summary: With hate speech being ubiquitous online, automatic detection is crucial, in particular when it comes to criminally relevant social media posts. We study a variety of retrieval-based in-context learning (RetICL) strategies for detecting defamatory offences under §§ 185-187 StGB (the subject of GermEval 2026 Subtask 4). Few-shot prompting beats zero-shot, but retrieval-based approaches offer only marginal gains over random demonstrations, and even fall behind an optimised static set of demonstrations. Providing concrete legal knowledge helps, yet model choice outweighs every other system choice.
