Models over-predict criminal relevance while still missing 26-57% of criminally relevant posts, suiting them for triage rather than autonomous moderation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于检索的上下文学习（RetICL）策略，用于识别德国刑法§§ 185-187（GermEval 2026子任务4）下的刑事相关诽谤言论。结果显示：少样本提示优于零样本；但检索相比随机示例仅有边际增益，甚至不如优化的静态示例集。加入具体法律知识有帮助，但模型选择的影响最大。模型会过度预测刑事相关性，同时仍遗漏26-57%的刑事相关帖子，因此更适合用于分诊而非自主审核。
AI.motivation: 网络仇恨言论普遍存在，识别具有刑事相关性的社交媒体帖子对自动检测至关重要。作者希望评估检索式上下文学习策略在这一法律领域任务中的有效性。
AI.method: 研究了多种基于检索的上下文学习（RetICL）策略，用于检测§§ 185-187 StGB下的诽谤犯罪（GermEval 2026子任务4）。对比了零样本、少样本、检索式示例、随机示例、优化静态示例集以及提供法律知识等设定。
AI.result: 少样本提示优于零样本；检索式方法相较随机示例仅有边际提升，甚至落后于优化后的静态示例集。提供具体法律知识有正向作用，但模型选择的影响超过其他所有系统设计选择。模型倾向于过度预测刑事相关性，同时仍漏检26-57%的刑事相关帖子。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型不适合自主审核，更适合用于分诊/人工复核筛选；模型选择是影响性能的最关键因素，检索策略的收益有限。

title: How Fragile Is Safety Alignment at Frontier Scale? A Single-Direction Attack on a 320B MoE
summary: Directional ablation removes an aligned language model's ability to refuse by projecting a single "refusal direction" out of the weights that write the residual stream. It needs no gradient-based training and no optimization, only a few hundred contrastive prompts, which makes it the canonical white-box attack on open-weight alignment. However, it has been established only on dense models up to roughly 70B parameters. We study whether it survives the shift to frontier mixture-of-experts (MoE) models whose residual streams are no longer a single tensor and whose weights ship quantized. We apply it to GLM-5.3-Flash (320B parameters, 288 routed experts, a four-wide hyper-connection residual, block-FP8). The attack survives the architecture, but what it reaches is no longer where a reader of the original recipe would look for it. Editing the attention, dense and routed-expert writers on their own removes 0.039, 0.016 and 0.148 of refusal respectively; editing all three together removes 0.776. As a result, 74% of the effect exists only under the joint intervention. The part the conventional recipe reaches by module-name matching accounts for 0.066 of that 0.776, which is why it fails silently on an MoE. The effect does not follow from removing just any direction: ablating a random direction orthogonal to it leaves refusal unchanged. A category-concentrated residue survives every edit we tried: subspaces fitted on violence, sexual content and hate leave measurable refusal at every rank from 1 to 12. We report the method, the 41-89 percentage-point reductions it achieves across seven harmful benchmarks with no detected change in capability, and the boundary where it stops.

AI.tldr: 方向性消融在320B MoE模型GLM-5.3-Flash上依然有效，但效果主要由注意力、稠密与路由专家写入者的联合干预产生，传统按模块名匹配的配方仅捕获约8.5%的效果，且部分类别性拒绝残差在各秩下均存活。
AI.motivation: 方向性消融作为开放权重对齐的经典白盒攻击，此前仅在前沿约70B以下的稠密模型上得到验证；本文旨在检验其能否迁移到残差流非单一张量、权重以低精度量化发布的MoE前沿模型。
AI.method: 将方向性消融应用于GLM-5.3-Flash（320B参数、288个路由专家、四宽度超连接残差、block-FP8），无需梯度训练或优化，仅用数百条对比提示；分别及联合编辑注意力、稠密与路由专家写入者，并与模块名匹配基线和随机正交方向对照。
AI.result: 单独编辑注意力、稠密与路由专家写入者分别消除0.039、0.016、0.148的拒绝；三者联合消除0.776，其中74%的效果仅存在于联合干预下；传统模块名匹配仅解释0.066。随机正交方向消融不改变拒绝行为；在暴力、性内容与仇恨类别上拟合的子空间在秩1至12均保留可测拒绝。七个有害基准上实现41–89个百分点的降低，且未检测到能力变化。
AI.conclusion: 方向性消融可跨越MoE架构与量化权重，但其有效位置与原始配方预期不符，模块名匹配在MoE上会静默失效；类别集中的拒绝残差构成该攻击的边界。

title: Morphological Decoupling-Based Skeletal Classification for Clinical Assessment of Malocclusion
comment: Accepted by Biocybernetics and Biomedical Engineering
summary: Malocclusion skeletal grading is a fundamental task in orthodontics, critical for diagnosis and treatment planning. Traditionally, cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is used for visual measurement, and the reconstructed lateral cephalograms are handed over to expert dentists for diagnosis. However, manual review is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and subject to inter-operator variability. Therefore, an automatic CBCT-based system is needed for reliable malocclusion skeletal grading. In this case, we develop TeethGNN, a novel graph-based framework designed to combine CBCT image features with morphological information for accurate and efficient malocclusion grading. TeethGNN utilizes a decoupled learnable decoder to directly predict key morphological indicators from CBCT images, eliminating the need for manual measurements. These morphological features are then fused with image features using a graph neural network (GNN), which effectively models the relationships between the modalities. To further enhance robustness and calibration, we introduce a collaborative calibration strategy. This strategy combines multi-scale graph adversarial perturbation for explicit calibration and nonlinear topological graph calibration for implicit confidence adjustment. Extensive experiments and ablation studies on our collected clinical dataset demonstrate that our malocclusion measurement system achieves 77.08\% in accuracy and 89.61\% in AUC, outperforming the compared state-of-the-art methods. These results validate the effectiveness of graph-based multimodal fusion and collaborative calibration in improving malocclusion grading performance. Our system shows strong potential for advancing computer-aided orthodontic diagnosis, providing an accurate and reliable solution for vision-based clinical measurement and diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出TeethGNN，一种基于图神经网络的CBCT多模态融合框架，用于自动错颌畸形骨性分级，临床数据集准确率77.08%、AUC 89.61%。
AI.motivation: 传统错颌畸形骨性分级依赖CBCT视觉测量与专家人工判读重建侧位片，存在耗时、费力、观察者间变异大的问题，因此需要可靠的自动化CBCT分级系统。
AI.method: TeethGNN包含三部分：1）解耦可学习解码器，直接从CBCT图像预测关键形态学指标，免去人工测量；2）用图神经网络将形态特征与图像特征融合，建模跨模态关系；3）协作校准策略，结合多尺度图对抗扰动（显式校准）与非线性拓扑图校准（隐式置信度调整）提升鲁棒性与校准性。
AI.result: 在自建临床数据集上，系统取得77.08%准确率和89.61% AUC，优于对比的现有最优方法；消融实验验证了图多模态融合与协作校准的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的多模态融合与协作校准能有效提升错颌畸形分级性能，该系统为计算机辅助正畸诊断及基于视觉的临床测量提供了准确可靠的方案，具有较大应用潜力。

title: UnitBoost: Managing Compound LLM Systems with a Merge Operator, Not a Model
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Managing Agents that Manage Agents
summary: Compound LLM systems often solve a coordination problem by adding a higher-level LLM. The resulting meta-agent reads workers' outputs, writes the final answer, allocates later calls, and decides when to stop. It is expressive, but it also concentrates three control decisions in an opaque, order-sensitive model call. We ask whether the manager needs to be generative at all. UnitBoost replaces that model with a defined meta-level operator: a task-given unit map turns worker outputs into slot-value proposals, a constrained argmax assembles the output, and the slots left unfilled or unsupported become an explicit residual for the next round. The operator is order-free, records unit provenance, and gives a simple guarantee: without coupling constraints, unit-wise maximization under the same admission score dominates selection of any complete candidate. On three held-out benchmarks, it exceeds the best single candidate chosen with gold labels by 0.060-0.195 absolute task-score points and input-matched generative managers by 0.048-0.076. Replacing only the management step improves six compound-system configurations by 0.013-0.182. Residual-directed rounds raise FanOutQA cell F1 from 0.4778 to 0.5524; matched controls show that the true residual outperforms random targets and ordinary rereading, while a label-free supply signal flags exhaustion after one unproductive round. The same analysis measures three conditions in which no such gain is available (one indivisible unit, unavailable unit identity, and an endpoint that charges for every emitted unit) and quantifies cross-unit coupling as a repair cost. The manager gives up semantic freedom and gains order invariance, unit provenance, and testable failure conditions.

AI.tldr: UnitBoost用定义式元级算子替代生成式管理LLM，实现无需语义自由的顺序无关、可溯源聚合，在多个基准上超越生成式管理器和金标最优单候选。
AI.motivation: 复合LLM系统通常引入更高层LLM解决协调问题，但元代理将读取输出、写答案、分配调用、终止判断三项控制决策集中于一次不透明且对顺序敏感的模型调用中。作者追问：管理者是否必须具有生成能力。
AI.method: 用任务给定的unit map将worker输出转化为slot-value提议；用受限argmax组装输出；未填充或不支持的slot构成显式残差供下一轮使用。该算子无顺序依赖、记录unit来源，并在无耦合约束下保证：同一准入分数下逐unit最大化支配任何完整候选的选择。
AI.result: 在三个留出基准上，超出用金标选出的最佳单候选0.060-0.195绝对任务分，超出输入匹配的生成式管理者0.048-0.076；仅替换管理步骤即改进六种复合系统配置0.013-0.182。残差导向的轮次将FanOutQA cell F1从0.4778提升至0.5524；匹配对照显示真实残差优于随机目标和普通重读，无标签供给信号可在一轮无效后标记耗尽。同时量化了三种无增益条件（单一不可分unit、unit身份不可用、按每个发出unit计费的端点）及跨unit耦合的修复代价。
AI.conclusion: 管理者放弃语义自由，换得顺序不变性、unit可溯源性和可检验的失败条件，表明协调问题不一定需要生成式管理模型。

title: Freezing of Gait Prediction Under Spatial Occlusion: An IMU-Supervised Cross-Modal Distillation Approach
summary: Parkinson's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterised by gradual deterioration of movement control. Automated freezing-of-gait (FOG) detection supports the objective assessment of gait-related motor impairment. Two common approaches are used for FOG prediction: (i) analysing video recordings of the patient's movements and (ii) analysing data collected using inertial measurement unit (IMU) wearable sensors attached to the patient's lower limbs. Video-based approaches may suffer detection errors during continuous turning-in-place tasks because the lower limbs undergo substantial geometric self-occlusion, degrading pose-estimation accuracy. IMU-based approaches are generally less affected by visual occlusion; however, they are difficult to deploy outside clinical or laboratory settings, as the sensors must be attached securely and remain in place throughout the assessment. Motivated by this, we propose a cross-modal subspace distillation framework to mitigate the limitations of unimodal FOG detection by combining IMU accuracy with video-based practicality. We extract invariant latent topologies from a pre-trained kinematic oracle to structurally supervise a non-encoded visual architecture during training. To resolve periods of severe spatial occlusion, a dual-stream visual model probabilistically fuses skeletal graph nodes and continuous spatial pixels, dynamically shifting reliance to uninterrupted pixel boundaries as joint tracking confidence drops. Evaluated against a public, multi-modal sequence dataset of Parkinson's individuals executing continuous $360^\circ$ turns, empirical results demonstrate that applying sensory boundary topologies strictly mitigates tracking evaluation entropy. Our constrained optimisation confirms that highly precise FOG prediction bounds can be achieved over zero-wearable inference environments.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态子空间蒸馏框架，将IMU的运动学知识迁移到纯视觉模型，以在零可穿戴设备条件下高精度预测帕金森病冻结步态。
AI.motivation: 视频方法在连续原地转身任务中因下肢严重自遮挡导致姿态估计精度下降；IMU方法虽受遮挡影响小，但传感器需牢固佩戴，难以在临床或实验室之外部署。
AI.method: 以预训练的运动学"oracle"（IMU模型）提取不变潜拓扑，对非编码的视觉架构进行结构监督；采用双流视觉模型，概率融合骨骼图节点与连续空间像素，在关节跟踪置信度下降时动态转向无遮挡的像素边界。
AI.result: 在帕金森个体执行连续360°转身的公开多模态序列数据集上，应用感觉边界拓扑显著降低了跟踪评估熵，约束优化验证了在零可穿戴推理环境下可实现高精度FOG预测边界。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态子空间蒸馏可在无需佩戴传感器的情况下获得接近IMU精度的冻结步态检测，兼顾准确性（IMU）与实用性（视频）。

title: Layerwise Tunable Lifting Scheme for the Convolutional Neural Network
summary: This work introduces a family of tunable lifting schemes for biorthogonal wavelet filter banks. We propose three lifting strategies: low-pass tuning (LS-LayLatt-LP), high-pass tuning (LS-LayLatt-HP), and a sequential lifting scheme that jointly adapts low- and high-frequency branches (LS-LayLatt-Sequential). All proposed designs are formulated using a lattice-based lifting structure, which guarantees invertibility and stability for arbitrary parameter values within the lifting functions. We evaluated the proposed methods by integrating them into a ResNet-18 backbone for image classification on the Describable Textures Dataset (DTD), as well as for anomaly detection on hazelnut images from the MVTec-AD dataset and private KRC102S dataset. Experimental results demonstrate consistent performance improvements across all evaluated tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一族用于双正交小波滤波器组的可调提升方案，包含低通、高通及序贯三种调节策略，基于格型提升结构保证可逆性与稳定性，并在分类与异常检测任务中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有小波滤波器组多为固定设计，难以针对不同任务灵活调节频带特性，需要一种可调且保持可逆性与稳定性的提升方案，以适配图像分类与异常检测等下游任务。
AI.method: 提出三种提升策略：低通调节（LS-LayLatt-LP）、高通调节（LS-LayLatt-HP）以及联合调节低高频分支的序贯提升方案（LS-LayLatt-Sequential）。所有设计均采用基于格型的提升结构，从而在提升函数内部任意参数取值下保证可逆性与稳定性。将上述方法集成到ResNet-18骨干网络中进行验证。
AI.result: 在可描述纹理数据集（DTD）图像分类、MVTec-AD数据集榛子图像异常检测以及私有KRC102S数据集异常检测任务上，实验结果均显示性能获得一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: 该格型提升小波滤波器组族具备可调、可逆且稳定的特性，能够作为通用模块嵌入深度网络，在多项视觉任务中带来稳定的性能增益。

title: RealSimLoop: Online Real-to-Sim Adaptation via Differentiable Reduced-Order Simulation with Vision Feedback
summary: Real-world observations of deformable objects are often sparse or surface-level, while downstream tasks require hidden physical quantities such as internal deformation, stress fields, and interaction forces. Physics-based simulation can recover these quantities, but online real-to-sim adaptation remains challenging due to costly full-space optimization, limited feedback, and time-varying material properties. To address these challenges, we propose RealSimLoop, a differentiable framework for online real-to-sim adaptation using vision data as physical feedback. Our approach achieves quasi-real-time performance by executing differentiable simulation within a reduced-order neural subspace, drastically accelerating the optimization loop. We couple this efficient dynamics model with differentiable rendering, enabling direct gradient backpropagation that leverages high-fidelity pixel data to refine physical parameters such as material stiffness. Furthermore, by employing a sliding-window objective function, RealSimLoop enables robust online adaptation, allowing the system to track time-varying material properties and effectively bridge the real-to-sim gap arising from model reduction or unmodeled dynamics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms conventional offline methods, and we validate the framework's versatility in downstream applications, including external force prediction and 3D stress field reconstruction with novel view synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出RealSimLoop：一种可微在线real-to-sim自适应框架，用视觉数据作为物理反馈，在降阶神经子空间内做可微仿真，实现准实时优化，可跟踪时变材料属性。
AI.motivation: 真实世界对形变物体的观测往往稀疏或仅限表面，而下游任务需要内部形变、应力场、交互力等隐藏物理量。基于物理的仿真可以恢复这些量，但在线real-to-sim自适应面临全空间优化代价高、反馈有限、材料属性时变等难题。
AI.method: 在降阶神经子空间内执行可微仿真以加速优化循环；将高效动力学模型与可微渲染耦合，实现梯度直接反传，用高保真像素数据精化材料刚度等物理参数；采用滑动窗口目标函数实现鲁棒在线自适应，跟踪时变材料属性并弥补模型降阶或未建模动力学带来的real-to-sim差距。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法优于传统离线方法；在下游应用（外部力预测、三维应力场重建、新视角合成）中验证了框架的通用性。
AI.conclusion: RealSimLoop通过降阶神经子空间可微仿真与可微渲染结合、配合滑动窗口目标，实现了准实时的在线real-to-sim自适应，可有效跟踪时变材料属性并支撑力预测与应力场重建等任务。

title: SkNeXt enables topology-guided neuronal reconstruction from petabyte-scale microscopy data
summary: Recent advances in high-resolution fluorescence and electron microscopy have enabled nanoscale imaging across increasingly large brain volumes, but the resulting terabyte- to petabyte-scale datasets make complete neuronal reconstruction prohibitively expensive in computation, data movement, and manual proofreading. Here, we present SkNeXt, a topology-first framework for scalable neuronal reconstruction from large volumetric microscopy datasets. Instead of densely processing entire image volumes, SkNeXt first converts neuronal morphology into compact SWC skeletons that preserve long-range connectivity. Proofreading is therefore focused on sparse neuronal trees, allowing branch, continuity, and connectivity errors to be corrected before high-resolution reconstruction. The corrected skeletons then serve as persistent structural priors for recovering detailed morphology while preserving neuronal identity and topology. Crucially, SkNeXt also uses neuronal skeletons as spatial indices for selective data access, retrieving high-resolution image regions only along reconstructed trajectories and bypassing most background and signal-free volumes. This substantially reduces I/O and computational overhead, allowing reconstruction cost to scale with neuronal morphology rather than total dataset size. Using SkNeXt, we reconstructed neurons from a petabyte-scale super-resolution fluorescence dataset of the mouse brain on a single GPU within one week, without requiring exhaustive dense inference across the complete imaging volume.

AI.tldr: SkNeXt：面向大体积显微成像数据的"拓扑优先"神经元重建框架，以SWC骨架为稀疏中间表示与空间索引，显著降低I/O与计算开销，实现PB级数据单GPU一周内重建。
AI.motivation: 高分辨荧光与电镜成像已能覆盖越来越大的脑体积，但产生的TB–PB级数据使完整的神经元重建在计算量、数据搬运和人工校对方面代价高得难以承受。
AI.method: 不进行整卷密集处理：先将神经元形态转换为保留长程连接的紧凑SWC骨架；将校对集中于稀疏神经元树，在重建前修正分支、连续性与连接性错误；以校正后的骨架作为持久结构先验恢复精细形态并保持神经元身份与拓扑；并将骨架用作空间索引，仅沿重建轨迹选择性读取高分辨图像区域，跳过大部分背景与无信号体素。
AI.result: 利用SkNeXt，在单块GPU上、一周内从PB级小鼠脑超分辨荧光数据集中完成神经元重建，无需对整个成像体积做穷尽式密集推理。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑优先的重建使成本随神经元形态复杂度而非数据集总规模增长，为大规模体积显微数据的可扩展神经元重建提供了可行路径。

title: HyperTrace: Hypothesis-Based Preference Tracing for Online LLM Personalization
summary: Personalized language models aim to adapt responses to individual users, whose preferences are often latent and revealed gradually through interaction. Existing training-free methods rely on stored histories or retrieved memories, but they often struggle to reconcile long- term preferences with short-term topic-specific needs. To address this issue, we propose HyperTrace, a training-free framework that formulates online personalization as latent preference tracing. HyperTrace maintains interpretable natural-language hypotheses over short-term intent and long-term preferences, and updates them through an SMC-style reweight process using an LLM-based surrogate choice model. By updating these hypotheses across turns and sessions, HyperTrace enables personalization without parameter updates. Experiments on PRISM and PersonaMem-v2 show that HyperTrace improves response alignment, preference prediction, and profile consistency over strong online baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of tracing latent user preferences for robust personalization. Code and scripts are available in the repository: https://github.com/jiseshen/HyperTrace.

AI.tldr: HyperTrace：免训练在线个性化框架，将个性化建模为潜在偏好追踪，用自然语言假设+序贯蒙特卡洛式重加权实现长短偏好与短期意图的统一。
AI.motivation: 个性化语言模型需适配用户，但用户偏好往往潜在且随交互逐步显现。现有免训练方法依赖存储历史或检索记忆，难以协调长期偏好与短期话题需求。
AI.method: HyperTrace为免训练框架，将在线个性化形式化为潜在偏好追踪。它维护关于短期意图与长期偏好的可解释自然语言假设，借助基于LLM的代理选择模型，通过SMC式重加权过程更新假设；跨轮次与会话持续更新，无需参数更新即可实现个性化。
AI.result: 在PRISM与PersonaMem-v2上，HyperTrace在响应对齐、偏好预测与画像一致性方面优于强在线基线，验证追踪潜在用户偏好对稳健个性化的有效性。代码见 https://github.com/jiseshen/HyperTrace。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式追踪潜在用户偏好（可解释假设+SMC式更新），可在免训练条件下兼顾长期偏好与短期意图，提升个性化效果。

title: $S^3$-Bench: Evaluating Speech Interaction Models as Scientific Voice Assistants
summary: The advance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has fundamentally reshaped the paradigm of human-computer interaction, especially speech interaction models capable of seamless conversations. Despite remarkable performance as general voice assistants, their performance in specialized domains remains underexplored, particularly in scientific areas. Scientific interactions introduce formidable challenges, involving rare technical terminology, spoken norms of abbreviations, and the natural verbalization of symbolic special expressions. In this paper, we introduce S$^3$-Bench, a systematic evaluation framework covering 10 major disciplines, consisting of a Knowledge set for speech question-answering and a Dialogue set for multi-turn progressive interactions with simulated user agents. By decomposing a complete atomic turn into stages of speech recognition, perception, knowledge utilization with reasoning, and response pronunciation, we systematically characterize the common challenges and performance tradeoffs of existing approaches. Furthermore, experiments on multi-turn interactions reveal persistent limitations in user adaptation and the generation of accurate, comprehensive, and efficient responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 S³-Bench，一个覆盖10个学科的科学语音交互评测框架，包含语音问答知识集与多轮对话集，通过分解原子交互轮次（语音识别、感知、知识推理、响应发音）系统刻画现有方法在科学领域语音交互中的挑战与性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型推动了语音交互发展，但现有模型在专业领域（尤其是科学领域）的表现尚缺乏探索。科学交互面临罕见术语、缩写口语规范、符号表达自然口语化等挑战，亟需系统性评测。
AI.method: 构建 S³-Bench 评测框架，覆盖10个主要学科，包含用于语音问答的 Knowledge 集和用于与模拟用户代理进行多轮渐进交互的 Dialogue 集；将完整原子轮次分解为语音识别、感知、知识利用与推理、响应发音四个阶段进行分析。
AI.result: 通过分阶段分析系统刻画了现有方法的常见挑战与性能权衡；多轮交互实验揭示出现有方法在用户适应能力以及生成准确、全面、高效响应方面存在持续局限。
AI.conclusion: 科学领域语音交互仍是当前 MLLM 的薄弱环节，S³-Bench 提供了系统的评测基准与分阶段诊断视角，为后续模型改进指明方向。

title: Pretraining and Distillation Matter More Than Architecture Family for Label-Free Single-Cell Classification
summary: Choosing a deep learning architecture for label-free single-cell classification remains an open question, with microscopy benchmarks reporting conflicting conclusions about CNNs versus transformers. We present a controlled benchmark on LIVECell phase-contrast microscopy data using source-image-disjoint train/validation/test splits to prevent parent-image leakage and matched optimisation, augmentation, and evaluation protocols across EfficientNet, Vision Transformer (ViT), and EVA-02 models. This allows the effects of architecture, pretraining, fine-tuning, tokenisation, and distillation to be disentangled. We find that the previously reported CNN advantage is largely explained by pretraining rather than architecture: the smallest pretrained model outperforms the strongest model trained from scratch despite far fewer parameters. Pretraining improves macro-F1 by 3-4 points, while the gap between the best pretrained CNN and transformer is below 0.5 points. Architectural choices nevertheless matter: ViT-S/8 outperforms ViT-S/16 and matches the four-times-larger ViT-B/16 at a quarter of the parameters, showing that finer tokenisation benefits small cell crops. Conversely, layer-wise learning-rate decay, central to the EVA-02 fine-tuning recipe, degrades performance, highlighting that transfer heuristics from natural-image recognition may not generalise to microscopy. Finally, knowledge distillation substantially improves the deployment frontier: compact EfficientNet-B0 students distilled from teacher councils outperform every individually trained backbone, including the EfficientNet-B5 and EVA-02 teachers. Overall, our results show that rigorous control of pretraining and evaluation is essential for interpreting biomedical architecture benchmarks, while distillation may be a more effective route to practical single-cell classification than architecture choice alone.

AI.tldr: 在严格控制预训练与评估协议的LIVECell相差显微基准上，CNN与Transformer的差距主要由预训练而非架构决定，知识蒸馏比架构选择更能提升单细胞分类的实用性能。
AI.motivation: 无标记单细胞分类中，深度架构选择尚无定论，显微基准对CNN与Transformer给出相互矛盾的结论；已有对比常受预训练、数据泄漏与协议不一致等混杂因素干扰。
AI.method: 在LIVECell相差显微数据上构建受控基准：采用源图像不相交（source-image-disjoint）的训练/验证/测试划分以避免父图像泄漏；对EfficientNet、ViT和EVA-02统一优化、数据增强与评估协议；系统解耦架构、预训练、微调、分词（tokenisation）与蒸馏的影响；并评估知识蒸馏（教师委员会蒸馏EfficientNet-B0学生）。
AI.result: 最小的预训练模型优于最强的从头训练模型，尽管参数量少得多；预训练使macro-F1提升3–4个点，而最佳预训练CNN与Transformer差距不足0.5个点；ViT-S/8优于ViT-S/16，并以四分之一参数量媲美四倍大的ViT-B/16；EVA-02微调配方中的逐层学习率衰减反而降低性能；由教师委员会蒸馏得到的EfficientNet-B0学生超越所有单独训练的骨干，包括EfficientNet-B5与EVA-02教师。
AI.conclusion: 严格把控预训练与评估是解读生物医学架构基准的前提；相比单纯选择架构，知识蒸馏可能是通向实用单细胞分类更有效的路径。

title: Target-Checked Reliability Score Refinement for Video Question Answering
summary: Video-language models can answer multiple-choice questions with high confidence yet be wrong. We study whether answer-level reliability scores can be improved under target shift without retraining the models or changing their answers. We collect option-probability lists from three fixed video-language models under four deterministic video samplings and represent cross-view changes and cross-model agreement as a response graph. Using a labeled target pilot, we compare the original score, defined as the probability assigned to the chosen answer, with a histogram-based gradient-boosting (HGB) score trained on the development datasets and a regularized logistic-regression score trained on the target pilot. A candidate replaces the original score only when repeated video-level checks indicate a positive, stable improvement. We develop this rule on public VideoQA benchmarks and Video Hallucination Diagnosis (VHD), a controlled diagnostic dataset for shared high-confidence errors. Ranking quality is measured by the area under the risk-coverage curve (AURC), where lower is better. On a held-out 963-question HERBench split, the method reduces mean AURC across the three models by 16.64% (95% confidence interval (CI), 12.12 to 22.61%); the smallest model-level gain is 11.39%. On a separate held-out 911-question Perception Test split, the mean reduction is 18.87% (95% CI, 15.43 to 22.14%). For InternVL3.5, the target check retains the original scores. Using the same outputs, the method outperforms seven training-free baselines in mean AURC on both datasets. It also improves AUROC, reduces calibration error, and lowers the error rate at 50% coverage by 6.50 and 6.58 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在目标域漂移下无需重训练或改变答案的答案级可靠性评分改进方法，通过多视频采样与多模型响应图构建特征，在诊断阳性且稳定时才替换原始分数，在VideoQA基准上显著降低AURC。
AI.motivation: 视频语言模型常以高置信度给出错误答案，现有可靠性评分（所选答案概率）在目标域漂移下不可靠，且需要在不重训练模型、不改变答案的前提下改进答案级可靠性评分。
AI.method: 从三个固定视频语言模型、四种确定性视频采样中采集选项概率列表，将跨视图变化与跨模型一致性表示为响应图；使用带标签的目标试点，比较原始分数（所选答案概率）、在开发集上训练的直方图梯度提升（HGB）分数和用目标试点训练的带正则逻辑回归分数；仅当重复的视频级检验显示正向且稳定的提升时才用候选分数替换原始分数。构建公开VideoQA基准与Video Hallucination Diagnosis（VHD）诊断数据集用于共同高置信错误，采用风险-覆盖率曲线下面积（AURC，越低越好）衡量排序质量。
AI.result: 在留出的963题HERBench划分上，三模型平均AURC降低16.64%（95% CI 12.12–22.61%），最小模型级增益11.39%；在另一留出的911题Perception Test划分上平均降低18.87%（95% CI 15.43–22.14%）；对InternVL3.5目标检验保留原始分数。相同输出下，两数据集平均AURC均优于七个免训练基线，同时改善AUROC、降低校准误差，并将50%覆盖率下错误率降低6.50与6.58个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在不重训练模型、不改变答案的情况下，通过响应图表示与带目标试点验证的分数替换规则，可持续提升视频语言模型答案级可靠性评分的排序质量与校准，且在目标检验不通过时安全保留原分数。

title: From Pixels to Hierarchical Sequences: Quadtree Mask Encoding for Vision-Language Binary Change Detection
summary: Dense change detection in remote sensing requires vision-language models (VLMs) to compare bi-temporal images and generate accurate pixel-level masks. Existing VLMs are largely confined to change captioning outputs, and the few that produce pixel-level masks still rely on external decoders or flat text-as-mask serialization, which are less effective for small and fragmented changes. We introduce QUAKE-CD, a framework that recasts dense change prediction as syntax-verifiable structured generation. QUAKE-CD represents binary change masks as grammar-constrained quadtree token sequences, making the masks compact, syntactically checkable, and deterministically decodable within an autoregressive generation space. We further construct QUAKE-CoT, which pairs these sequences with chain-of-thought traces grounded in visual evidence, and jointly optimizes textual reasoning and spatial dense prediction through a progressive curriculum followed by grammar-gated dual-reward RL. On QUAKE-CoT, QUAKE-CD achieves 78.31% accumulated F1, outperforming decoder-based and flat text-as-mask VLMs while producing more faithful bi-temporal reasoning.

AI.tldr: QUAKE-CD将稠密变化检测重构为语法可验证的结构化生成，用四叉树token序列表示变化掩膜，并配合思维链与强化学习优化，在QUAKE-CoT上取得78.31%累积F1。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在遥感稠密变化检测中多局限于变化描述输出；少数能生成像素级掩膜的模型依赖外部解码器或扁平化的"文本即掩膜"序列化方式，对小而破碎的变化效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出QUAKE-CD框架：将二值变化掩膜表示为语法约束的四叉树token序列，使掩膜紧凑、语法可检查、可在自回归生成空间内确定性解码；构建QUAKE-CoT，将序列与基于视觉证据的思维链轨迹配对，通过渐进式课程学习加语法门控双奖励强化学习联合优化文本推理与空间稠密预测。
AI.result: 在QUAKE-CoT上，QUAKE-CD达到78.31%的累积F1，优于基于解码器和扁平文本即掩膜的视觉语言模型，并产生更忠实的双时相推理。
AI.conclusion: 语法可验证的结构化生成是稠密变化检测的有效范式，兼顾紧凑表示、确定性解码与推理忠实性。

title: CLFTv2: Efficient Camera-LiDAR Fusion for Semantic Segmentation via Hierarchical Feature Pyramids
summary: Semantic segmentation for autonomous driving requires reliable detection of vulnerable road users (VRUs) despite heavy class imbalance. We introduce CLFTv2, a hierarchical camera-LiDAR fusion framework replacing global ViT attention with a Swin-based multi-scale encoder and a lightweight FPN-style residual decoder. Operating in the 2D perspective domain, CLFTv2 integrates multi-scale geometric cues through shifted-window attention and per-scale residual fusion, avoiding the computational overhead of query-matching decoders. Across three driving datasets, CLFTv2 consistently improves VRU recall. On ZOD, CLFTv2-Large achieves 53.5\% mIoU, improving pedestrian IoU from 35.5\% to 44.9\% over the prior CLFT model. On Waymo, CLFTv2 reaches 61.7\% mIoU. Additionally, a modality-isolation study suggests ViT's global receptive field yields stronger fusion gains only under dense LiDAR returns. Compared to a Swin-based Mask2Former adaptation, CLFTv2 requires 1.4$\times$ fewer GFLOPs and delivers 2.2$\times$ higher throughput, while achieving comparable overall accuracy. These results demonstrate that hierarchical local-attention fusion offers an efficient, scalable alternative to global-attention and query-based decoders for real-time on-vehicle perception in intelligent transportation systems. Source code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: CLFTv2是一种分层相机-LiDAR融合框架，以Swin多尺度编码器替代全局ViT注意力，并采用轻量FPN式残差解码器，在2D透视域内融合多尺度几何线索，提升弱势道路使用者（VRU）召回率与效率。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶语义分割需在严重类别不平衡下可靠检测弱势道路使用者（VRU）。已有CLFT模型依赖全局ViT注意力和查询匹配解码器，计算开销大；且全局感受野的融合增益条件尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出CLFTv2分层相机-LiDAR融合框架：用基于Swin的多尺度编码器替换全局ViT注意力，配轻量FPN式残差解码器；在2D透视域中通过移位窗口注意力与逐尺度残差融合整合多尺度几何线索，避免查询匹配解码器的计算负担。另开展模态隔离研究。
AI.result: 在三个驾驶数据集上持续提升VRU召回。ZOD上CLFTv2-Large达53.5% mIoU，行人IoU从35.5%提升至44.9%；Waymo上达61.7% mIoU。模态隔离研究表明ViT全局感受野仅在LiDAR点云密集时带来更强融合增益。相比基于Swin的Mask2Former变体，GFLOPs减少1.4倍、吞吐量高2.2倍，总体精度相当。
AI.conclusion: 分层局部注意力融合是全局注意力与查询式解码器的高效、可扩展替代方案，适用于智能交通系统中的实时车载感知。源码已公开。

title: Albedo Estimation via Latent Bridge Matching
comment: Accpeted at the Color and Imaging Conference (CIC 2026), hosted by the Society for Imaging Science and Technology (IS&T)
summary: Recent advances in Intrinsic Image Decomposition (IID) have increasingly relied on generative models. However, progress remains limited by three key challenges: (a) insufficient physical consistency, (b) high computational cost at inference time, and (c) limited generalization capabilities. In this work, we show that latent bridge matching (LBM) effectively addresses these limitations for albedo estimation. We introduce a novel LBM-based architecture that enforces physical consistency through a pixel reconstruction loss, benefits from the inherent efficiency of LBM low-cost inference, and improves generalization across diverse datasets by incorporating a shading conditioning. In this extended version, we additionally show that conditioning the shading estimator itself on the predicted albedo further improves reconstruction fidelity, and we benchmark our best model against stateof-the-art IID methods across five real and synthetic datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于潜在桥匹配(LBM)的反射率估计架构，通过像素重建损失保证物理一致性、利用LBM高效推理、并引入着色条件提升泛化能力，在五个数据集上对标SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于生成模型的本征图像分解(IID)存在三大瓶颈：物理一致性不足、推理计算开销高、泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 提出一种新的LBM架构：以像素重建损失强制物理一致性；利用LBM固有的低成本推理效率；通过引入着色(shading)条件增强跨数据集泛化。扩展版本进一步将预测的反射率作为着色估计器的条件。
AI.result: 在五个真实与合成数据集上，将最优模型与当前SOTA的IID方法进行了基准对比；着色估计器以预测反射率为条件进一步提升了重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 潜在桥匹配可有效缓解IID在物理一致性、推理效率与泛化性方面的局限，为反射率估计提供了新思路。

title: When Does Defendant Statement Matter? A Study of Bias and Persuasion in LLM-Simulated Jurors
summary: LLMs have been used to simulate human decision-making in professional settings, yet their behaviors in common-law jury trials remain unexplored. We study when and how a defendant's courtroom statement affects LLM-simulated jurors, focusing on persuasion, ideological bias, and background-based affinity. To support the analysis, we introduce JuryBench, a benchmark containing controversial criminal cases in U.S. criminal law. In each case, a defendant can claim various plausible justifications to support acquittal or reduced liability. We fix the base case and design defendants of different backgrounds, who give courtroom statements with varying emotional appeal or rebuttal. Jurors with diverse ideological profiles across the spectrum are simulated. We examine 20 frontier LLMs, resulting in a total of 432K decisions and rationales, and quantify changes in verdict severity. Our findings show that LLM-jury simulation echoes many human-jury findings. First, emotional persuasion can be detrimental, since jurors may perceive it as evidence of guilt or inconsistency. Next, we show that background fit between jurors and defendants is a stronger and significant factor than other isolated factors, and that jurors are in general harsher toward opposite-background defendants and lenient toward same-background ones. Finally, we find that juror ideology also strongly shapes severity judgments. These findings highlight both the promise and risks of using LLMs to model jury reasoning and call for careful evaluation. The data and code are available at https://github.com/choyingw/JuryBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出JuryBench基准，用于研究LLM模拟陪审员在普通法刑事审判中受被告陈述影响的方式，发现情绪说服可能适得其反，背景契合与意识形态偏见显著影响裁决严厉度。
AI.motivation: LLM已被用于模拟专业场景下的人类决策，但在普通法陪审团审判中的行为尚未被探索。作者希望系统考察被告法庭陈述对LLM模拟陪审员裁决的影响，包括说服效应、意识形态偏见和背景亲和性。
AI.method: 构建JuryBench基准，包含美国刑法中的争议刑事案件。固定基础案件，设计不同背景的被告，其法庭陈述在情感诉求或反驳强度上有所变化；同时模拟具有不同意识形态谱系的陪审员。测试20个前沿LLM，总计生成432K条裁决与理由，并量化裁决严厉度的变化。
AI.result: LLM陪审团模拟再现了许多人类陪审团发现：情绪说服可能有害，陪审员会将其视为有罪或不一致的证据；陪审员与被告的背景契合比其他孤立因素更强且显著，陪审员对背景相反的被告更严厉、对背景相同的被告更宽容；陪审员意识形态也强烈影响严厉度判断。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果既显示LLM建模陪审团推理的前景，也揭示其风险，呼吁进行谨慎评估。数据与代码已公开于GitHub。

title: Leveraging Fine-grained Error Correction in Korean Speech Recognition for Consultation Services
comment: Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) technology is fundamental to customer service automation and large-scale transcription. However, even advanced ASR models exhibit inevitable errors in complex real-world environments such as call center conversations. When privacy restrictions preclude audio access, error correction must rely on text-based post-editing. Existing text-only approaches face significant challenges in low-resource languages, mainly due to a critical scarcity of annotated corpora and tailored correction methodologies. For Korean, this resource gap is particularly pronounced, as existing resources are predominantly designed for ASR training rather than text-based error correction. To address this, we introduce DasanCallDial, the first large-scale Korean benchmark dataset specifically curated for dialogue-level ASR error correction. Derived from genuine call center interactions, it comprises 1,974 dialogues with 115,460 utterances. Leveraging this resource, we propose Detector-Gated Contextual Span Correction (DCSC), a text-only post-editing framework for error-sparse Korean speech recognition transcripts. DCSC combines an encoder-based detector that first performs token-level error detection, followed by a language model-based corrector trained to rectify fine-grained span-level errors. Additionally, we employ dialogue-level context augmentation to enable the model to leverage discourse history for disambiguation. By employing multi-level granularity, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively overcoming the limitations of general LLMs in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个大规模韩语对话级ASR纠错基准数据集DasanCallDial，并设计仅基于文本的后编辑框架DCSC，通过检测器门控的上下文片段纠正实现最优性能。
AI.motivation: 真实呼叫中心场景下ASR不可避免存在错误，而隐私限制使音频不可用，只能依赖文本后编辑。现有纯文本方法在低资源语言（尤其韩语）上面临标注语料稀缺、缺乏针对性纠错方法的问题，且现有韩语资源主要用于ASR训练而非文本纠错。
AI.method: 构建DasanCallDial数据集，源自真实呼叫中心对话，含1,974段对话、115,460条话语。提出Detector-Gated Contextual Span Correction（DCSC）框架：基于编码器的检测器先进行词级错误检测，再由语言模型驱动的纠正器进行细粒度片段级纠错；并采用对话级上下文增强，利用话语历史消歧。
AI.result: 通过多级粒度设计，DCSC在仅文本的韩语ASR纠错任务上取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能，有效克服通用大语言模型在低资源场景下的局限。
AI.conclusion: DasanCallDial与DCSC为低资源语言的对话级ASR文本纠错提供了数据与方法的双重支撑，验证了多级粒度与对话上下文增强的有效性。

title: StreetDiff: Multi-view Street Scenes Generation via Cross-view Consistent Multi-view Stable Diffusion with Structure Prompts
summary: Multi-view diffusion models have shown strong performance in scenes with strong geometric priors and sparse semantics, such as indoor rooms or simple outdoor environments (e.g., fields, courtyards). However, they often fail to maintain cross-view consistency under camera rotation, especially in structurally complex urban environments. Without explicit modeling of spherical correspondence across views, existing approaches tend to produce object duplication, structural distortion, and layout inconsistency. To address this limitation, we propose StreetDiff, a multi-view diffusion framework that explicitly enforces cross-view alignment during denoising. StreetDiff introduces a Panorama--Perspective Synergy design to decouple global layout reasoning from local detail synthesis, and incorporates a Panorama Alignment Module (PAM) that establishes spherical-projection-based attention constraints across views. By injecting structured alignment constraints without modifying the diffusion backbone, our framework achieves robust cross-view coherence in challenging urban street scene generation tasks. In addition, we construct Street360, a large-scale HDR multi-view urban panorama dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StreetDiff significantly improves structural consistency and visual fidelity compared to prior multi-view diffusion generation methods.

AI.tldr: StreetDiff：面向城市街景的多视角扩散框架，通过全景-透视协同与球面投影对齐注意力约束，实现跨视角一致性生成。
AI.motivation: 现有多视角扩散模型在几何先验强、语义稀疏的场景（如室内房间、简单户外环境）表现良好，但在相机旋转下难以维持跨视角一致性，尤其是在结构复杂的城市环境中。由于缺乏跨视角的球面一致性显式建模，现有方法易产生物体重复、结构扭曲与布局不一致等问题。
AI.method: 提出 StreetDiff 多视角扩散框架，在去噪过程中显式施加跨视角对齐约束。其核心包括：(1) Panorama–Perspective Synergy 设计，将全局布局推理与局部细节合成解耦；(2) Panorama Alignment Module (PAM)，基于球面投影建立跨视角注意力约束。该框架在不修改扩散主干网络的前提下注入结构化对齐约束。此外构建了大规模 HDR 多视角城市全景数据集 Street360。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，StreetDiff 相比现有多视角扩散生成方法，在结构一致性与视觉保真度上均有显著提升，在挑战性的城市街景生成任务中实现了稳健的跨视角连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模球面跨视角对应关系并解耦全局布局与局部细节，可在不改动扩散主干的情况下有效缓解城市街景多视角生成中的一致性缺陷，同时配套数据集为后续研究提供支撑。

title: Can We Trust Video Hallucination Detectors? VidHalLoc for Evaluating the Evaluators
summary: Video-language models and video agents can produce hallucinations that conflict with spatiotemporal evidence. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate model hallucinations, and heterogeneous mechanisms make detector reliability difficult to compare. We introduce VidHalLoc, a benchmark that evaluates hallucination detection methods under a unified diagnostic evaluation protocol using 2,000 adversarial hallucination samples across Video Question Answering and Video Captioning tasks, spanning Ontology and Dynamic hallucination categories. To construct VidHalLoc efficiently, we introduce VideoHALO, a Harness Engineering-informed multi-agent workflow that decomposes data construction into four executable stages supported by a memory system and a communication protocol. Evaluation of fifteen methods reveals that the four dedicated detectors peak at an Overall accuracy of only 34.63%, indicating limited reliability across video hallucination types [Dataset Repository: https://huggingface.co/datasets/wesfggfd/VidHalLoc].

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VidHalLoc 基准，用统一诊断评估协议评测视频幻觉检测方法，含2000个对抗性幻觉样本，覆盖视频问答与视频描述任务、Ontology与Dynamic两类幻觉；为高效构建该基准，提出 VideoHALO 多智能体工作流。对15种方法的评测显示，四种专用检测器最高总体准确率仅34.63%，表明视频幻觉检测可靠性有限。
AI.motivation: 视频-语言模型与视频智能体会产生与时空证据相冲突的幻觉。现有基准主要评估模型自身的幻觉，而检测方法的异构机制导致检测器可靠性难以横向比较。
AI.method: 提出 VidHalLoc 基准：在统一的诊断评估协议下评测幻觉检测方法，包含2000个对抗性幻觉样本，覆盖视频问答（Video Question Answering）与视频描述（Video Captioning）任务，以及 Ontology 与 Dynamic 两类幻觉。为高效构建该基准，提出 VideoHALO——一种受 Harness Engineering 启发的多智能体工作流，将数据构建分解为四个可执行阶段，并由记忆系统与通信协议支撑。
AI.result: 对15种方法的评测表明，四种专用检测器的总体准确率（Overall accuracy）最高仅为34.63%，说明其在各类视频幻觉上的可靠性有限。
AI.conclusion: VidHalLoc 提供了统一、可比的视频幻觉检测评测方案，并揭示现有专用检测器在视频幻觉检测上可靠性不足，同时通过 VideoHALO 展示了高效可扩展的基准构建路径。

title: Strangers to Themselves: What Language Models Say About Themselves Is Generic
summary: Language models can fluently describe how they would behave: whether they would cave to pushback, misuse a tool, or lie under pressure. Is that description actually about the model speaking? We turn self-knowledge into a prediction test. Across nine behavioral evaluations, we measure how a model behaves under different conditions, ask it to predict those rates, and compare its predictions with controls that remove the self from the question. We find that: (i) Direct self-report is weak (r = +0.04), and even showing the model the exact items only raises prediction to +0.24. Crucially, the same item-informed question about "capable AI agents in general" does just as well (+0.28), while other models' answers about themselves predict the target model at least as well as its own. (ii) Frontier scale does not detectably change this pattern: any gains in prediction are not self-specific, and are consistent with a better theory of how AI assistants behave rather than better self-knowledge. (iii) First-person framing does have one robust effect: it shifts reports in the flattering direction, understating harmful behavior relative to the same question about a generic agent. (iv) Finetuning on a model's own behavioral record can teach narrow self-predictions, but it also changes the behavior being predicted and the gains do not transfer broadly. The practical implication is simple: asking a model what it would do mostly reveals a theory of AI assistants in general, plus a favorable bias, rather than privileged knowledge of that model.

AI.tldr: 将"模型自我知识"转化为预测测验：在九项行为评估中，让模型预测自身行为的发生率，并与去除"自我"的对照问题比较，发现直接自我报告几乎无效，其预测力更多来自"关于AI助手的一般理论"而非专属自我知识，且第一人称框架带来美化偏差。
AI.motivation: 语言模型能流畅描述自己会如何行为（屈服于压力、滥用工具、说谎等），但这种描述是否真的反映该模型自身的特殊性尚不清楚。作者旨在检验"自我报告"究竟包含的是关于该模型的专属知识，还是关于AI助手的一般性理论加偏见。
AI.method: 设计"自我知识=预测检验"范式：在九项行为评估中，先在不同条件下测量模型的真实行为率，再要求模型预测这些比率，并与删除"自我"的对照问题比较。对照包括：向模型展示具体题目、把同一问题改为询问"一般性的有能力AI代理"、以及用其他模型的自我回答来预测目标模型。此外还考察前沿规模的影响，以及用模型自身行为记录做微调能否教会其自我预测。
AI.result: (i) 直接自我报告预测力很弱（r=+0.04）；即使展示确切题目，预测力也仅升至+0.24；而关于"一般性AI代理"的同样知情问题达到+0.28，其他模型对自身的回答对目标模型的预测力不弱于其自身回答。(ii) 模型规模提升未能改变这一模式，预测能力的增益并非自我特异的，更符合"对AI助手行为更好的理论"而非"更好的自我知识"。(iii) 第一人称框架有一个稳健效应：使报告向美化方向偏移，相比对一般代理的同一问题，低报了有害行为。(iv) 用模型自身行为记录微调可教出狭窄的自我预测，但同时改变了被预测的行为，且收益无法广泛迁移。
AI.conclusion: 问一个模型"你会怎么做"，主要揭示的是一种关于AI助手的一般理论加上一种有利偏差，而非对该模型的优先/特权知识。这提示依赖模型自我报告来评估其行为倾向存在根本局限。

title: Deep and shallow biases in language models
summary: Large language models often repeatedly select the same answer even when many alternatives are plausible. Prior work treats this concentration as bias, but it does not distinguish stable model preferences from responses that depend on a particular prompt wording. We introduce a bias depth score that measures both how strongly a model prefers its top answer under direct prompting and whether that answer survives scenario reframing. Across 4,442 opinion prompts and four large language models, only about a quarter of the concentrated preferences survive reframing. We call these persistent cases Deep biases, and the remaining prompt-dependent cases Shallow biases. Our results show that Deep biases are more often inherited from pretraining and preserved through SFT. Under both continued fine-tuning and prompt-based debiasing for diversity, Deep biases are consistently harder to remove than Shallow biases. Bias depth therefore separates stable learned biases from prompt-wording artifacts that single-prompt metrics conflate. Code, models, and data are available at deepbias.github.io.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“偏差深度分数”（bias depth score），用于区分模型稳定的偏好与依赖特定提示措辞的响应，并将持续性偏好称为“深层偏差（Deep biases）”、提示依赖型称为“浅层偏差（Shallow biases）”。
AI.motivation: 已有研究将大语言模型在多备选下反复选择同一答案的现象视为偏差，但未区分“稳定的模型偏好”与“仅在特定提示措辞下出现的响应”，导致单提示指标将两类现象混为一谈。
AI.method: 提出 bias depth score，同时衡量直接提示下模型对首选答案的偏好强度，以及该答案在场景重述（scenario reframing）后是否依然保持；在 4,442 个观点提示和四个大语言模型上进行评估，并考察持续微调与基于提示的去偏（提升多样性）两种干预。
AI.result: 在 4,442 个观点提示与四个模型中，仅有约四分之一的集中偏好能在重述后存活；深层偏差更常继承自预训练并通过 SFT 保留；在持续微调和基于提示的去偏下，深层偏差均比浅层偏差更难消除。
AI.conclusion: 偏差深度可将稳定的习得偏差与提示措辞造成的假象区分开，弥补单提示指标混淆两类现象的不足；代码、模型与数据见 deepbias.github.io。

title: Contrastive Projection: Reading Transformer Internals by Differencing Logit Lenses
summary: Reading a transformer's internal states in token space is easy to do and hard to trust: a logit lens on a single hidden state is dominated, at intermediate layers, by the generic tokens the model would predict for almost any input. We read the difference instead. Subtracting two closely matched prompts' hidden states and projecting through the unembedding cancels the shared component and surfaces what separates them, an operation equivalent to reading a RepE/ActAdd steering vector through a logit lens. Built into a training-free tracer that reads at every position, sub-layer, and head and averages over designed baselines, it traces a compound- noun MLP->attention chain in Phi-2, confirmed there by activation patching, with the same distinction recovered across three architectures by readout and probe rather than by patching; it reads what retrieval surfaces for real versus fictional entities, and reads metaphor as a set of domain-to-domain mappings rather than a single figurativity feature. A cross-seed control marks the boundary: across five networks differing only in initialization, the same distinction surfaces as almost entirely different tokens (top-10 overlap 0.08). What a computation looks like in token space is network-specific; the distinction it draws is not

AI.tldr: 提出"差分logit lens"（读两个匹配提示的隐状态之差并投影至词表），构建免训练追踪器，在Phi-2中定位复合名词的MLP→注意力链，并在多架构与跨种子对照中界定了该读法的适用范围。
AI.motivation: 单个隐状态的logit lens在中间层常被"通用token"主导，难以可信地读出模型内部计算；作者希望用一种更稳健的读法，在不训练探针的前提下揭示区分性信息。
AI.method: 相减两个高度匹配提示的隐状态，经unembedding投影，抵消共享成分、凸显差异成分；该方法等价于把RepE/ActAdd的steering vector通过logit lens读出。据此构建免训练追踪器，覆盖每个位置、子层与注意力头，并对设计的基线做平均；辅以activation patching与probe验证，并做跨架构与跨随机种子对照。
AI.result: 在Phi-2中追踪到复合名词的MLP→注意力链，并由activation patching确认；该区分在三种架构上经readout与probe可复现（而非靠patching）；可读出真实实体与虚构实体的检索差异，并将隐喻读作一组领域到领域的映射而非单一"比喻性"特征；跨五个仅初始化不同的网络，同一区分浮现为几乎完全不同的token（top-10重叠仅0.08）。
AI.conclusion: 计算在token空间中的"表象"是网络特异的，但其所刻画的功能性区分本身并不依赖具体网络；差分读法提供了免训练、可迁移的内部机制探查路径。

title: FlowCPO: A Unified Divergence View of Preference Alignment for Flow Models
summary: Preference alignment for flow and diffusion models now spans online reinforcement learning and offline preference optimization, but the relation between these methods remains unclear. In particular, existing forward-process alignment methods require fresh samples from the current model, while offline methods based on fixed preference pairs rely primarily on positive-only fine-tuning or DPO-style likelihood-ratio surrogates. We organize these approaches through a divergence-based framework and introduce FlowCPO, an offline forward-KL objective that uses both preferred and dispreferred samples without online rollouts. For linear interpolation, we show under explicit regularity conditions that the forward-KL objective is bounded by a contrastive flow matching loss, yielding a tractable surrogate on fixed data. We further show that this loss is nonnegative, whereas the signed regression loss of simplified FlowDPO can be unbounded below. In the in-domain setting, FlowCPO achieves higher mean GenEval and OCR scores than the evaluated baselines, reaching 0.84 and 0.87 versus 0.81 and 0.74 for FlowDPO at CFG 3.0. In the out-of-domain setting, the results are mixed, with the best GenEval result but lower reward scores than RFT on several metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文用散度框架统一流/扩散模型的偏好对齐方法，并提出离线前向KL目标 FlowCPO，用固定偏好数据构造可处理对比代理损失，在域内任务上优于 FlowDPO，域外表现参差。
AI.motivation: 流模型与扩散模型的偏好对齐已分化为在线强化学习与离线偏好优化两条路线，但两者关系不明；已有前向过程对齐方法需当前模型的新鲜采样，而基于固定偏好对的离线方法多依赖仅正样本微调或 DPO 式似然比替代，缺乏统一解释与同时利用正负样本的离线目标。
AI.method: 通过基于散度的框架组织现有方法，提出 FlowCPO——一种离线前向 KL 目标，同时使用偏好与非偏好样本且无需在线采样。针对线性插值，在显式正则条件下证明前向 KL 目标被对比流匹配损失上界，从而在固定数据上得到可处理替代损失；并分析该损失非负，而简化 FlowDPO 的带符号回归损失可无下界。
AI.result: 域内设置下，FlowCPO 在 CFG 3.0 时平均 GenEval 与 OCR 分数高于所评估基线，分别达 0.84 与 0.87，而 FlowDPO 为 0.81 与 0.74。域外设置结果参差：GenEval 最佳，但若干指标上奖励分数低于 RFT。
AI.conclusion: FlowCPO 以散度视角将在线与离线偏好对齐联系起来，提供无需在线 rollout、可利用正负偏好对的离线前向 KL 替代目标，并在域内评测中取得优势；但其域外泛化并不全面，存在指标间取舍。

title: Interpreting Object-Dependent Concept Brittleness in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted at ACM MM 2026. 27 pages, 17 figures, including appendices
summary: Although text-to-image diffusion models generally exhibit strong prompt-following ability, we identify a persistent and previously underexplored failure pattern in which a small subset of prompts differing only in the object consistently fails to realize the same target concept under identical generation settings. We term this phenomenon object-dependent concept brittleness. Such cases suggest systematic internal blind spots rather than random sampling noise. In this paper, we present an interpretability-oriented framework to audit and minimally correct these failures. Our key idea is to analyze denoising trajectories in a step-wise sparse autoencoder (SAE) space, where abstract style and attribute concepts become more separable than in the raw denoising representation. This sparse space enables us to compare successful and failed generations, identify concept dimensions whose evidence is missing, weakened, or temporally delayed, and construct class-level concept prototypes from reliable class-consistent samples. Based on this audit process, we introduce a lightweight inference-time correction strategy that interpolates denoising features toward the corresponding prototype in SAE space. Rather than serving as a task-specific retraining method, this intervention acts as a validation of the diagnosed concept deficiency. We evaluate the proposed framework on style and attribute failure cases across multiple diffusion backbones, with significant improvements in concept consistency, text fidelity, and repair success. Further analyses show that deeper denoising representations provide clearer concept structure, while early-stage intervention offers the strongest correction leverage. Code is available at https://github.com/Metecade/Object-Dependent-Concept-Brittleness.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现文生图扩散模型存在"物体依赖的概念脆弱性"：仅在物体上不同的提示词，在相同生成设置下会系统地无法实现同一目标概念。作者提出可解释性框架，通过在去噪轨迹的稀疏自编码器(SAE)空间中审计并最小化纠正这类失败。
AI.motivation: 文生图扩散模型虽普遍具备较强的提示跟随能力，但存在一种此前未被充分探究的失败模式：一小部分仅在物体上不同的提示词，在相同生成设置下持续无法实现同一目标概念。这类现象暗示模型存在系统性内部盲区，而非随机采样噪声，因此有必要对其进行审计与纠正。
AI.method: 核心思想是在逐步稀疏自编码器(SAE)空间中分析去噪轨迹，该空间中抽象的风格与属性概念比原始去噪表示更易分离。基于此稀疏空间：对比成功与失败的生成，识别证据缺失、减弱或时序延迟的概念维度，并从可靠的类一致样本构建类级概念原型。进而提出轻量级推理时纠正策略，在SAE空间中将去噪特征向对应原型插值，作为对所诊断概念缺陷的验证而非任务特定重训练。
AI.result: 在多个扩散骨干网络上针对风格与属性失败案例进行评估，在概念一致性、文本保真度和修复成功率上均取得显著提升。进一步分析表明：更深的去噪表示提供更清晰的概念结构，而早期干预具有最强的纠正杠杆效应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种可解释性导向的审计与最小纠正框架，能够有效诊断并修复物体依赖的概念脆弱性，验证了概念缺陷假设，并揭示了表示深度与干预时机对纠正效果的影响。代码已开源。

title: Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations via Class-Wise Adaptive Modality Fusion and Affective Geometry
comment: Accepted at the 11th Workshop and Competition on Affective Behavior Analysis in-the-Wild (ABAW) at ECCV 2026
summary: Emotion Recognition in Conversations (ERC) requires integrating heterogeneous textual, audio, and visual cues while accounting for conversational context and emotional dynamics. We extend the Self-Distillation Transformer architecture for ERC with appearance+geometry visual representations, class-wise adaptive modality fusion, and a valence-arousal prior for affective transitions. On the MELD and IEMOCAP datasets, geometry-enhanced visual representations improve weighted F1 by 0.27 and 4.36 points over appearance-only features, respectively, while class-wise adaptive fusion provides further gains of 0.17 and 0.25 points over the original softmax gate. The valence-arousal prior yields targeted improvements of 0.30 and 0.74 accuracy points on emotionally shifted utterances while preserving performance on stable turns. These results indicate that structured facial cues, emotion-dependent modality weighting, and affective geometry provide complementary benefits for multimodal ERC.

AI.tldr: 本文在Self-Distillation Transformer基础上，引入几何视觉表征、类别自适应模态融合与效价-唤醒先验，提升多模态对话情感识别性能。
AI.motivation: 对话情感识别需融合文本、音频、视觉异构线索，并建模对话上下文与情感动态，现有方法在视觉表征、模态融合权重及情感转移建模上仍有不足。
AI.method: 扩展Self-Distillation Transformer架构，采用外观+几何视觉表征、类别自适应模态融合（替代原softmax门控）以及效价-唤醒先验建模情感转换。
AI.result: 在MELD与IEMOCAP上，几何视觉表征使加权F1分别提升0.27和4.36个百分点；类别自适应融合再提升0.17和0.25个百分点；效价-唤醒先验在情感转换话语上分别提升0.30和0.74准确率点，且稳定轮次性能保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 结构化面部线索、情感相关模态加权与情感几何对多模态对话情感识别具有互补增益。

title: Vague2Detect: Handling Ambiguous Prompts in Knowledge-Based Open-World Detection
summary: Real-world detectors must often interpret functional or ambiguous prompts, yet conventional models such as YOLO remain restricted to fixed class lists. Even open-vocabulary models like YOLO-World frequently misalign vague language with the intended objects. Building on our prior work Commonsense-Guided Open-World Object Detection Using LLMs and Visual-Semantic Matching, we address YOLO-World's limitations in grounding task-driven queries. We propose Vague2Detect, a hybrid pipeline in which a fine-tuned Sentence-BERT retrieves candidates from a structured household Knowledge Base (KB), and YOLO-World verifies their presence in the image. For prompts outside the KB, a large language model (GPT-3.5-turbo) generates candidate descriptions, dynamically expanding the KB to cover novel concepts. On a benchmark of household scenes using custom images and an Open Images V7 subset, YOLO-World alone achieves only 32% Vague Prompt Success Rate (VPSR), the ability to map ambiguous queries to correct detections. In contrast, Vague2Detect improves performance to 61% VPSR with high precision, and up to 85% when augmented with GPT fallback.

AI.tldr: 提出Vague2Detect混合检测流程：微调Sentence-BERT从结构化家庭知识库检索候选，YOLO-World验证图像中存在性，GPT-3.5-turbo为库外提示生成候选描述以动态扩展知识库，将模糊提示成功率从32%提升至61%（含GPT回退达85%）。
AI.motivation: 现实检测器需理解功能性或模糊提示，但YOLO等传统模型仅限固定类别列表，即使YOLO-World等开放词汇模型也常将模糊语言与目标物体错误对齐，难以支撑任务驱动的查询。
AI.method: Vague2Detect混合流水线：1）微调Sentence-BERT从结构化家庭知识库中检索候选物体；2）YOLO-World在图像中验证候选是否存在；3）对知识库外的提示，由GPT-3.5-turbo生成候选描述，动态扩展知识库以覆盖新概念。延续其前期工作Commonsense-Guided Open-World Object Detection Using LLMs and Visual-Semantic Matching。
AI.result: 在自建图像与Open Images V7子集构成的家庭场景基准上，单独YOLO-World的模糊提示成功率（VPSR）仅32%；Vague2Detect提升至61%且保持高精度，加入GPT回退后最高可达85%。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM与检索-验证相结合的混合管道，可有效弥合模糊/任务驱动语言与开放词汇检测器之间的语义鸿沟，显著提升模糊提示下的检测对齐能力，并可借助LLM动态扩展知识库以泛化至新概念。

title: Improving Cross-Lingual Token Representations by Adding a Pinch of SALT
summary: Cross-lingual sentence encoders enable scalable transfer across hundreds of languages, powering applications such as translation mining and zero-shot learning in low-resource settings. Although trained for sentence-level alignment, they are increasingly also applied to token-level tasks such as hallucination detection and sequence tagging, exposing a mismatch between training and usage. We propose SALT, a lightweight post-training method that improves token representations by injecting span-level supervision into existing sentence encoders. Across five multilingual token-level benchmarks, SALT achieves the best overall results on four of them, outperforming alternative fine-tuning strategies and competitive encoders. It also improves sentence-level performance on cross-lingual retrieval and classification tasks. These results demonstrate that span-level supervision is an effective signal for improving both token and sentence representations.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级后训练方法 SALT，通过向跨语言句编码器注入片段级监督来改进 token 表示，在五个多语言 token 级基准中四个取得最佳结果，同时提升句级检索与分类性能。
AI.motivation: 跨语言句编码器虽以句级对齐为训练目标，却被日益广泛地用于幻觉检测、序列标注等 token 级任务，导致训练目标与实际使用之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: SALT 是一种轻量级后训练方法，在已有句编码器中注入 span 级（片段级）监督信号，以改进 token 表示，并与其他微调策略及竞争性编码器进行对比。
AI.result: 在五个多语言 token 级基准上，SALT 在其中四个取得最佳整体结果，优于替代微调策略与竞争编码器；同时在跨语言检索与分类等句级任务上也带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 片段级监督是同时改善 token 表示与句表示的有效信号，可缓解句级训练与 token 级使用之间的错配，并具备跨任务、跨语言的迁移价值。

title: 5-Dialects-BN: Unmasking the Impact of Transliteration on Bangla Dialectal LLMs
comment: 31 pages, 18 figures, 26 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across natural language processing (NLP) tasks, yet their capabilities degrade sharply for low-resource languages and dialectally diverse settings. Bangla, the world's sixth most spoken language, exemplifies this gap: existing resources overwhelmingly target Standard Bangla, leaving its regional dialects without the benchmarks needed to develop or evaluate dialect-aware systems. We address this gap with 5-Dialects-BN, the first multi-annotation Bangla dialect benchmark to align Romanized transliteration with dialectal text, Standard Bangla, English, and subjectivity labels across five regional varieties. The dataset comprises 6,000 manually annotated entries spanning five major dialects: Chittagong, Barisal, Noakhali, Sylhet, and Rangpur (Chittagong 1,900; Noakhali 1,500; Sylhet 1,200; Barisal 700; Rangpur 700), reflecting natural online availability. Each entry is enriched with five aligned annotations: the original dialectal text, a Romanized transliteration, an English translation, a Standard Bangla translation, and a subjectivity label (subjective vs. objective). Annotations were produced and cross-validated by native speakers and undergraduate linguistics students to ensure dialectal authenticity and semantic fidelity. The resulting resource supports a diverse suite of tasks, including dialect identification, dialect-to-standard normalization, machine translation, subjectivity classification, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA) of multilingual LLMs. By providing a standardized, multi-annotation benchmark, 5-Dialects-BN enables principled evaluation of LLMs on dialectally diverse Bangla and lays a foundation for further research in low-resource, dialect-aware NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 5-Dialects-BN，首个孟加拉语多标注方言基准，覆盖五种地区方言共 6,000 条人工标注数据，每条含方言原文、罗马化转写、英语翻译、标准孟加拉语翻译及主观性标签，支持方言识别、标准化、机器翻译、主观性分类与 LoRA 微调等任务。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在低资源语言和方言多样化场景下性能显著下降。孟加拉语作为全球第六大语言，现有资源几乎全部针对标准孟加拉语，地区方言缺乏可用于开发与评估方言感知系统的基准，因此需要构建标准化、多标注的方言数据集来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建 5-Dialects-BN 数据集，包含 6,000 条人工标注条目，覆盖吉大港（1,900）、诺阿卡利（1,500）、锡尔赫特（1,200）、巴里萨尔（700）、朗布尔（700）五种方言，分布反映自然在线可获取性。每条数据对齐五种标注：方言原文、罗马化转写、英语翻译、标准孟加拉语翻译和主观性标签（主观/客观）。标注由母语者与语言学专业本科生完成并交叉验证，以保证方言真实性与语义保真度。
AI.result: 该资源支持方言识别、方言到标准的规范化、机器翻译、主观性分类以及多语言大模型的参数高效微调（如 LoRA）等一系列任务，为方言多样化孟加拉语上的大模型评估提供了标准化基准。
AI.conclusion: 5-Dialects-BN 通过提供标准化、多标注的基准，实现了对具备方言多样性孟加拉语的大模型进行规范化评估，并为低资源、方言感知的自然语言处理研究奠定基础。

title: Putting Captions to the Test: Evaluating Video Caption Quality through Multiple-Choice Question Answering
summary: Evaluating video captioning remains a critical challenge for Visual Large Language Models (VLLMs). Existing metrics primarily rely on matching generated text against ground-truth references. This paradigm suffers from the ``one-to-many'' nature of video description, where high-quality captions are often penalized for lexical mismatches or valid shifts in visual focus. Furthermore, such assessments are typically one-dimensional, failing to provide a fine-grained analysis of caption quality. To address this, we redefine caption quality through the lens of information fidelity: A caption must maximize the coverage of salient visual information while ensuring strict factuality. We introduce CapQuiz, a novel reference-free benchmark that assesses captions based on their utility in answering human-verified, fine-grained, multiple-choice questions derived from the video. CapQuiz features a hierarchical taxonomy of 10 question types (spanning Descriptive and Inferential categories) across 24 diverse video domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CapQuiz correlates significantly better with human judgments than existing metrics and offers interpretable insights into model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CapQuiz，一个无参考的视频描述评测基准，通过信息保真度（视觉显著性覆盖+严格事实性）重新定义描述质量，用人工验证的细粒度多选题衡量描述的可用性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频描述评测主要依赖生成文本与参考文本的匹配，受"一对多"特性困扰：高质量描述常因词汇不匹配或合理的视觉关注点偏移而被误判；同时评测维度单一，缺乏细粒度分析。
AI.method: 将描述质量重新定义为信息保真度：描述需在保证严格事实性的前提下最大化对显著视觉信息的覆盖。据此构建CapQuiz——一种无参考基准，依据描述在回答由视频衍生的、人工验证的细粒度多选题时的效用进行评测；其分类体系含10种问题类型（覆盖描述性与推理性两类），横跨24个视频领域。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CapQuiz与人类判断的相关性显著优于现有指标，并能提供关于模型性能的可解释洞察。
AI.conclusion: CapQuiz通过信息保真度视角与问答式无参考评测，缓解了"一对多"匹配偏差，提供更贴近人类判断且可解释的视频描述评测方案。

title: Towards Stress-Aware Sentence-Level Filipino G2P With Weakly-Supervised ByT5 Fine-Tuning
comment: Accepted at the 10th International Conference on Natural Language Processing and Information Retrieval (NLPIR 2026), Nara, Japan
summary: Grapheme-to-phoneme conversion (G2P) refers to the task of converting a sequence of graphemes to a corresponding sequence of phonemes. While Filipino G2P is fairly straightforward due to its shallow orthography, the inclusion of prosodic features such as stress adds a layer of complexity that requires sentence-level context instead of single-word inputs. However, sentence-level data for Filipino typically do not include phoneme transcriptions, posing a challenge for training G2P models. As such, we investigate how to obtain sentence-level phoneme data for Filipino using available data and compare the resulting models with multilingual word-level G2P as well as measure how accurately they predict stress marker position for Filipino. We propose fine-tuning a ByT5-based model, pre-trained on multilingual word-level G2P data, on three sentence-level G2P datasets annotated with an LLM-assisted pipeline guided by data from Wiktionary. This approach produces models that perform well on the G2P task, achieving at best around 0.54% PER and 2.50% CER, a significant decrease compared to base model PER at around 19.74%, on a manually-corrected test set. The model is able to correctly classify most of the main stress classes in Filipino, but struggles particularly with malumi words. We show that a ByT5-based model performs well at sentence-level Filipino G2P and offers strong potential for Filipino homograph disambiguation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用LLM辅助、以Wiktionary数据为导向的标注流水线，构建三个菲律宾语句子级G2P数据集，并在多语言词级G2P预训练的ByT5模型上微调；在人工校正测试集上PER降至约0.54%、CER约2.50%，但malumi类重音词识别仍较困难。
AI.motivation: 菲律宾语拼写浅层，单词级G2P较为直接，但重音等韵律特征依赖句子级语境，无法由单词输入推断；而现有菲律宾语句子级数据通常不含音素转写，导致句子级G2P模型训练缺乏标注数据。
AI.method: 以多语言词级G2P数据预训练的ByT5为基础模型，采用由Wiktionary数据引导的LLM辅助标注流水线，生成三个带音素标注的菲律宾语句子级G2P数据集，并在其上微调；与多语言词级G2P模型对比，并评估重音标记位置预测准确率。
AI.result: 在人工校正测试集上，微调模型最佳达到约0.54% PER与2.50% CER，较基础模型约19.74% PER显著下降；模型能正确分类菲律宾语多数主要重音类别，但对malumi类词表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 基于ByT5的模型在菲律宾语句子级G2P上表现良好，并在菲律宾语同形异音词消歧方面具有较强潜力。

title: Multi-Functional Embedding Models for Funder Name Disambiguation in Scientific Publication Records
summary: Understanding the historical allocation and distribution of research funding advances our knowledge of how scientific research is supported across fields, institutions, and regions. However, large-scale analyses are hindered by the lack of comprehensive funder name disambiguation solutions, as funder names often exhibit spelling variations, translations, abbreviations, and inconsistent levels of granularity. In this paper, we present a framework for developing multilingual, multi-functional funder name disambiguation models and demonstrate its application to research publications in biodiversity conservation. To construct a training dataset, we integrated the Research Organization Registry (ROR), which provides unique identifiers for research organizations, with two publication datasets: the Web of Science (WoS) and the Crossref Open Funder Registry (OFR). We used multi-task learning with Contrastive Loss and Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss to fine-tune three open-weight embedding models from the Sentence Transformer, Gemma, and Qwen3 families. The best-performing models achieved accuracy above 0.90 when matching WoS funder names to ROR identifiers, outperforming general-purpose LLMs, including GPT-5.2, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, and Gemini-2.5-Flash, by more than 0.1. For funder names not indexed in ROR, we constructed a similarity network among funder names and identified clusters within it. Finally, we analyzed the disambiguation results and highlighted challenges arising from limited knowledge of smaller funders and funders from non-English-speaking countries. This work provides a reusable framework for funder name disambiguation with potential applicability across different model architectures and datasets, featuring cost-effective training data creation and multi-task learning and disambiguation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多语言、多功能资助机构名称消歧框架，通过整合ROR、WoS与Crossref OFR构建训练数据，并利用多任务学习微调三种开源嵌入模型，在生物多样性保护领域实现高于0.90的匹配准确率，且优于通用大模型。
AI.motivation: 研究资助的历史分配与分布对理解科研支持模式具有重要意义，但资助机构名称存在拼写变体、翻译、缩写及粒度不一致等问题，缺乏大规模、全面的资助机构名称消歧方案，制约了相关的大规模分析。
AI.method: 整合提供机构唯一标识的ROR与WoS、Crossref OFR两个出版物数据集构建训练数据；采用结合对比损失（Contrastive Loss）与多负样本排序损失（Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss）的多任务学习，微调来自Sentence Transformer、Gemma与Qwen3系列的三个开放权重嵌入模型；对未收录于ROR的资助机构名称，构建名称相似性网络并识别其中的聚类。
AI.result: 最佳模型在将WoS资助机构名称匹配至ROR标识时准确率超过0.90，较GPT-5.2、Claude-Sonnet-4.6、Gemini-2.5-Flash等通用大语言模型高出0.1以上；通过对消歧结果的分析，揭示了因对小型资助机构及非英语国家资助机构了解有限而带来的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可复用的资助机构名称消歧框架，具备跨模型架构与数据集的潜在适用性，并具有训练数据构建成本低、支持多任务学习与消歧的特点。

title: VLX-VR: An Agentic-Aware Video Reasoning Model
summary: Real-world video understanding requires integrating visual, audio, textual, and temporal evidence distributed across a video. Yet many pipelines use a fixed video context and single-pass inference, limiting adaptive evidence acquisition when observations are incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting. We present VLX-VR, an agentic-aware video reasoning model trained within a video reasoning framework defined by a Think--Memory--Observation loop. At each step, VLX-VR determines the needed evidence, invokes read_memory or write_memory, incorporates the returned Observation, and decides whether to continue or produce the task output. We train VLX-VR with multimodal data, including videos and agent trajectories, using reinforcement learning to learn evidence acquisition, memory use, and termination. On MINERVA, VLX-VR achieves state-of-the-art performance among the models included in our comparison, with 78.79% accuracy. Under the original three duration groups, its accuracies are 76.70%, 78.73%, and 80.92%, with a cross-duration accuracy variance of 2.97~$\mathrm{pp}^2$. On correctly answered samples, 96.20% of VLX-VR's reasoning traces are consistent with the MINERVA reference reasoning traces and the evidence described by them, while approximately 75.80% of all evaluated samples satisfy both answer correctness and this evidence-grounded trace criterion. These results show strong performance and broadly stable behavior across durations, while counting, state changes, causal reasoning, and spatial perception remain challenging.

AI.tldr: 提出智能体式视频推理模型VLX-VR，基于Think-Memory-Observation循环与强化学习，在MINERVA上达78.79%准确率。
AI.motivation: 真实世界视频理解需整合视觉、音频、文本与时间等多模态证据，但现有流程多采用固定视频上下文与单次推理，当观测不完整、模糊或冲突时缺乏自适应证据获取能力。
AI.method: VLX-VR在Think-Memory-Observation循环框架下训练：每步先判定所需证据，调用read_memory或write_memory，融合返回的Observation，再决定继续推理或输出结果；使用包含视频与智能体轨迹的多模态数据，通过强化学习习得证据获取、记忆使用与终止策略。
AI.result: 在MINERVA上取得对比模型中的最优性能，准确率78.79%；三个时长分组分别为76.70%、78.73%、80.92%，跨时长准确率方差为2.97 pp²；答对样本中96.20%的推理轨迹与参考推理轨迹及其所述证据一致，约75.80%的评测样本同时满足答案正确与证据grounded轨迹标准。
AI.conclusion: 模型性能强劲且跨时长行为基本稳定，但计数、状态变化、因果推理与空间感知仍是挑战。

title: Stable Answers, Unfinished Reasoning: Why Self-Consensus Is Not a Safe Early-Exit Signal
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables. Yunxiang Mo and Donghao Zhao contributed equally. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/Antony-zdh/stable-answers-unfinished-reasoning
summary: A natural way to cut reasoning-model inference cost is to repeatedly probe a single partial trajectory for its current answer and stop once probes agree -- self-consensus. We ask whether any such rule is both safe and token-saving, and whether one can be selected once and reused. A preregistered sweep of 3,520 consensus rules, replayed on frozen trajectories from two models and three benchmarks, clears none of three acceptance gates fixed in advance; the frontier reproduces on a held-out split and on two unseen models -- while a boundary-confidence control (DEER) swept through the same pipeline clears all three. The reason lies in the signal: agreement establishes that the current answer persists under a fixed probing procedure, not that the reasoning has terminated -- a consensus-termination gap. Stopping on it commits non-terminal answers. At a rule still saving 32% of the tokens, one stop in nine fires on an answer the trajectory itself later abandons, and most of those stops cut off a correction it would otherwise have made. Widening the agreement window does not remove them: the share levels off near 7%, and by then the saving has fallen to 8%. Probe re-wording and a hand-labelled error taxonomy show the agreed answer is often a placeholder the model had not settled on. Used on its own as the stop signal, agreement fails not because it is insufficiently strict, but because it repeatedly measures the wrong object.

AI.tldr: 本文检验"自洽性共识"（对同一部分轨迹反复探测答案、一致即停）能否作为安全且省token的推理提前停止规则。预注册扫描3520条共识规则、在两个模型三个基准的冻结轨迹上回放，无一通过预先设定的三道验收门槛，而边界置信度控制方法DEER同一流程下全部通过。
AI.motivation: 推理模型推理成本高，人们自然希望通过反复探测部分轨迹的当前答案、一旦探测结果一致就停止（self-consensus）来降低成本。作者要检验：这类规则是否既安全又省token，且能否一次性选定并复用。
AI.method: 预注册扫描3,520条共识规则，在两个模型、三个基准的冻结轨迹上回放；设置三道预先固定的验收门槛；在留出划分和两个未见模型上复现前沿；设置边界置信度控制方法DEER走同一流程作为对照；扩大一致性窗口；进行探测改写重述与人工标注错误分类。
AI.result: 无一条共识规则通过三道验收门槛；前沿在留出划分与两个未见模型上复现，而DEER控制通过全部三道门槛。在仍节省32%token的规则下，九次停止中有一次停在轨迹后来被自身放弃的答案上，且多数此类停止截断了模型本可做出的纠正。扩大一致性窗口不能消除问题：比例稳定在约7%附近，而此时节省已降至8%。探测重述与错误分类显示，一致的答案常是模型尚未确定的占位答案。
AI.conclusion: 一致性只能证明当前答案在固定探测流程下持续存在，不能证明推理已终止——即"共识-终止缺口"。基于一致性停止会提交非终止答案。作为停止信号，一致性失败并非因为不够严格，而是因为它反复度量了错误的对象。

title: SalamandraTA at WMT 2026 Terminology Shared Task: Hard Examples Are Better Teachers
comment: To appear at Proceedings of the Eleventh Conference on Machine Translation (WMT26; camera-ready version)
summary: Terminology-aware translation asks for more than a correct translation: the output must use the exact terms a glossary prescribes. The standard recipe, fine-tuning on glossary-annotated translation pairs, hides an inefficiency: for most examples the glossary prescribes exactly what the model would have produced anyway, so they teach nothing about following a glossary. We therefore keep only the examples where the model's own translation contradicts the glossary. In a controlled study at fixed data volume, this selection alone raises term accuracy from 78.7% to 89.9%. The filtered data, built by a two-way synthetic pipeline on open models, is part of the instruction-tuning mixture of our public release SalamandraTA-7b-instruct v3.0, which, used exactly as released and wrapped in a document-level inference pipeline, forms the BSC submission to the WMT26 Terminology Shared Task Track 1. At the official WMT26 evaluation, our system achieves 94.2% term success at 74.6 chrF++, with only two of the twenty-two submissions outperforming it on both metrics. On last year's benchmark, it also surpasses our GRPO-based system, despite being trained solely with ordinary supervised fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 术语感知翻译的微调数据中，大部分样本的术语其实模型本来就能译对，学不到新知识。本文只保留模型自身译文与术语表冲突的样本，在固定数据量下将术语准确率从78.7%提升到89.9%，并以此构建 SalamandraTA-7b-instruct v3.0，在 WMT26 术语任务中取得94.2%术语成功率与74.6 chrF++。
AI.motivation: 术语感知翻译要求输出必须使用术语表规定的确切术语，而标准做法（在带术语标注的翻译对上微调）存在效率问题：大多数样例中术语表规定的译法恰好是模型本就会产出的，这类样本对"遵循术语表"这一能力没有教学价值。
AI.method: 采用数据筛选策略，仅保留模型自身翻译与术语表相矛盾的样例；通过开放式模型上的双向合成流水线构建筛选后的数据，并将其纳入公开发布的 SalamandraTA-7b-instruct v3.0 指令微调混合数据中；在推理端配合文档级推理流水线，形成 BSC 在 WMT26 术语共享任务 Track 1 的提交系统。
AI.result: 在固定数据量的对照实验中，仅该筛选策略便将术语准确率从78.7%提升至89.9%；官方 WMT26 评测中系统达到94.2%的术语成功率与74.6 chrF++，22个提交中仅两个在两项指标上同时优于该系统；在去年的基准上，该系统也超越了此前的 GRPO 系统。
AI.conclusion: 仅保留模型译文与术语表冲突的样本进行筛选训练，是一种简单而有效的提升术语遵循能力的方式；仅使用普通监督微调即可达到甚至超越基于强化学习（GRPO）的系统表现。

title: From Few-Shot Segmentation to Clinician-in-the-Loop Medical Image Analysis
summary: Few-shot medical image segmentation (FSMIS) seeks to delineate unseen structures from a small support set, but its standard formulation fixes task-defining evidence before inference. This assumption is fragile under acquisition shift, atypical pathology, ambiguous boundaries, and poor image quality. Adding clinician interaction and rapid adaptation is not sufficient: the binding constraint is deciding when asking or changing is warranted. We therefore reframe FSMIS as a three-layer sequential decision problem. First, decidable self-assessment separates errors that a bounded intervention can repair from those that no admissible intervention can reach. We formalize this distinction through a correctable set defined by the update operator and remaining interaction budget. Second, selective interaction allocates a distinct expert-attention budget by response-conditioned net expected value of information, yielding explicit accept, query, and defer actions. Third, bounded adaptation emphasizes reversibility and independent safety reassessment rather than speed. A complementary cross-case memory stores reproducible correction priors over failure modes instead of disease-specific mask priors. This structure links sparse support representation, cross-domain robustness, multi-level risk estimation, clinician feedback, and governed experience transfer. We state six hypotheses with an explicit dependency order and propose a minimal pilot that can falsify the foundational self-assessment claim before a clinician study. The central claim is not that interaction resolves domain shift, but that scarce expert attention should be used only when a bounded intervention is expected to reach a clinically better outcome.

AI.tldr: 该文将少样本医学图像分割(FSMIS)重新表述为三层序贯决策问题：可判定的自评估、选择性交互、有界自适应，核心主张是稀缺专家注意力应仅在有界干预预期能带来更优临床结局时才被使用。
AI.motivation: 标准FSMIS在推理前固定任务定义证据，这一假设在采集偏移、非典型病理、边界模糊和图像质量差的情况下十分脆弱。仅加入临床医生交互与快速自适应并不充分，真正的瓶颈在于判断"何时值得提问或改变"。
AI.method: 提出三层序贯决策框架：1）可判定自评估，用更新算子与剩余交互预算定义可纠正集，区分有界干预可修复与不可达的误差；2）选择性交互，按响应条件下的信息净期望价值分配专家注意力预算，输出接受/查询/推迟三种显式动作；3）有界自适应，强调可逆性与独立安全性重评估而非速度；并辅以跨病例记忆，存储可复现的失败模式纠正先验而非疾病特异性掩码先验。
AI.result: 将该结构关联到稀疏支持表示、跨域鲁棒性、多层级风险估计、临床医生反馈与受治理的经验迁移；提出六个具有明确依赖顺序的假设，并设计一个最小试点，可在临床研究之前先证伪基础性自评估主张。
AI.conclusion: 核心主张并非交互能解决域偏移，而是稀缺的专家注意力只应在有界干预被预期可达到临床更优结局时才被使用。

title: What Makes Adversarial Examples Transfer Across Deepfake Detectors?
summary: Deepfake detectors remain vulnerable to transfer-based black-box attacks, in which adversarial examples are generated on a source surrogate model and transferred to a target model, unknown to the attacker. Yet how source--target compatibility shapes attack success remains poorly understood. Prior studies evaluate limited detector pools and rarely disentangle architectural from training factors. We conduct a controlled evaluation of adversarial transferability across 60 detectors spanning six backbones, two pretraining regimes, and five training-data configurations, using two attack procedures: AutoAttack (AA) and the Carlini--Wagner attack with Expectation over Transformation (CW--EOT). Matched comparisons reveal significantly higher transfer when source and target share an exact backbone, architecture family, pretraining regime, or training data. This compatibility structure is attack-dependent: exact backbone compatibility has the largest effect under AA, whereas shared pretraining and training data have the largest effects under CW--EOT. When transfer is averaged across non-target sources, mean attack success rate (ASR) is $7.21\%$ under AA and $19.52\%$ under CW--EOT. By contrast, a multi-source oracle combining both attacks attains a \(64.48\%\) mean ASR after excluding exact backbone and training-data matches, showing that source averaging can substantially understate target vulnerability. We release 240,000 adversarially perturbed images, complete pairwise transfer results, detector configurations, and evaluation code. These findings establish source--target compatibility and source-model selection as central dimensions of credible transfer-based black-box robustness evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文对60个Deepfake检测器进行受控迁移攻击评估，揭示源-目标兼容性（骨干、架构族、预训练、训练数据）显著影响迁移成功率，且该结构随攻击方法变化；单源平均ASR低估漏洞，多源oracle可达64.48%。
AI.motivation: 基于迁移的黑盒攻击对Deepfake检测器构成威胁，但源模型与目标模型的兼容性如何影响攻击成功率尚不清晰。既有研究检测器池有限，且难以分离架构因素与训练因素。
AI.method: 构建涵盖60个检测器、6种骨干、2种预训练范式、5种训练数据配置的受控评估。采用AutoAttack（AA）与Carlini–Wagner结合期望变换（CW–EOT）两种攻击流程，并进行匹配对比以分离兼容性因素。
AI.result: 共享精确骨干、架构族、预训练范式或训练数据时迁移显著更高，且该兼容性结构依赖攻击方法：AA下精确骨干影响最大，CW–EOT下共享预训练与训练数据影响最大。非目标源平均ASR为AA 7.21%、CW–EOT 19.52%；多源oracle在排除精确骨干与训练数据匹配后仍达64.48%平均ASR。
AI.conclusion: 源-目标兼容性与源模型选择是可信迁移黑盒鲁棒性评估的核心维度，单源平均会显著低估目标模型漏洞。作者发布24万张对抗扰动图像、完整成对迁移结果、检测器配置与评估代码。

title: Beyond Similarity: Foundation Models as an Efficient Backbone for Training-Free Composed Video Retrieval
summary: Composed video retrieval (CoVR) searches a gallery for the target video that realizes a natural-language modification of a source clip. However, at gallery scale, this creates a fundamental tension: compact embeddings enable efficient, reusable search but can miss the transient actions, state changes, and subtle constraints that demand fine-grained video reasoning, whereas applying large multimodal models uniformly sacrifices scalability. To address these limitations, we propose that frozen foundation models should instead occupy complementary roles, with inference depth adapted to query difficulty. Based on this premise, we introduce \methodname{}, a framework for training-free \methodexpansion{}. Specifically, a composed-query embedding first searches reusable video-only gallery representations; uncertain queries undergo bounded reranking and candidate expansion; ambiguous edits trigger target-description generation; and only close leading candidates reach multimodal verification. To support these roles, frame selection, spatial resolution, and time cues are adapted to each stage. Across complete target-gallery evaluations, our method reaches state-of-the-art performance among training-free approaches, with 89.55 and 93.43 R@1 on Dense-WebVid-CoVR and CoVR-R, respectively (with more than +35\% and +25\% absolute margins to the closest counterpart). These results show that adaptively orchestrating foundation-model capabilities can combine scalable retrieval with fine-grained reasoning without task-specific training. The source code and all relevant guidelines are available on https://github.com/demidovd98/CoVRAGE.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的组合视频检索框架 CoVRAGE，让冻结基础模型按查询难度分工协作，在 Dense-WebVid-CoVR 和 CoVR-R 上取得免训练方法的最优性能（R@1 分别为 89.55 和 93.43）。
AI.motivation: 组合视频检索（CoVR）需在库规模下检索出对源视频片段进行自然语言修改后的目标视频。紧凑嵌入虽高效可复用，却会遗漏瞬态动作、状态变化和细粒度约束；而统一使用大型多模态模型又牺牲可扩展性。因此需要一种兼顾可扩展性与细粒度推理的方案。
AI.method: 提出训练自由的 CoVRAGE 框架，基于"冻结基础模型应承担互补角色、推理深度随查询难度自适应"的前提。流程为：先用组合查询嵌入检索可复用的纯视频库表示；不确定查询进行受限重排与候选扩展；模糊编辑触发目标描述生成；仅领先的少数候选进入多模态验证。各阶段自适应调整帧选择、空间分辨率和时间线索。
AI.result: 在完整目标库评估中，达到免训练方法的最优性能：Dense-WebVid-CoVR 上 R@1 为 89.55，CoVR-R 上为 93.43，较最接近的对比方法分别有超过 +35% 和 +25% 的绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: 自适应地编排基础模型能力，可在无任务特定训练的情况下，同时实现可扩展检索与细粒度推理。

title: MetroLLM-Bench: Evaluating Language Models as Transit Kiosk Runtimes
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/continker/metrollm-bench (tag paper-v1.2); DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21893944
summary: We introduce MetroLLM-Bench, a 955-case benchmark for testing language models as the policy layer of a transit kiosk. It covers six real metro systems, ranging from 37 to 414 stations, and eleven categories that include routing, fare calculation, disruptions, accessibility, and adversarial input. In each case, the model must call structured tools and submit a machine-renderable terminal state containing an outcome, a per-ticket fare quote when applicable, and a kiosk action. Fourteen deterministic scoring components form Tier 1; eight semantic-quality components form Tier 2, six of which use a language-model judge. We report Tier 1 and the combined score of both tiers. A stratified 75/25 split reserves 717 cases for training-data generation and 238 for held-out evaluation. We evaluate twenty-six models from six vendors, of which twenty-three are ranked. On the held-out partition, a 4B Qwen 3.5 student trained through parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) exceeds both GPT-5.6 tiers on Tier 1 (91.3 against 90.6 and 90.0) and matches GPT-5.4 full at maximum reasoning effort (91.4), with a 2.6 GB Q4_K_M footprint. Larger 9B and 27B students provide no further Tier 1 improvement over the 4B student at this training scale. Across the four Qwen sizes, the PEFT gain over the corresponding base model decreases from +7.03 points at 2B (three training seeds) to -0.91 at 27B; every seed shows the same direction at every size.
