A deterministic rule-based baseline reaches 84.6 on Tier 1, with the remaining language-model advantage concentrated in policy adaptation, compound scenarios, accessibility, and temporal reasoning. Muse Glimmer 30B leads the composite ranking, and serving configuration alone moves the Qwen 3.5-to-3.8 comparison by 2.7 Tier 1 points. The benchmark, harness, reproduction guide, and fine-tuned students are released at https://github.com/continker/metrollm-bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MetroLLM-Bench，一个包含 955 个案例的地铁自助终端策略层基准测试，覆盖 6 个真实地铁系统与 11 类任务；通过对 26 个模型（含 PEFT 微调学生模型）的评测，发现 4B 学生模型在 Tier 1 上超越更大模型与部分闭源模型，并揭示 PEFT 增益随模型规模增大而衰减的规律。
AI.motivation: 语言模型被用作交通自助终端的策略层时，缺乏覆盖真实地铁系统、多任务类别（路径规划、票价计算、运营中断、无障碍、对抗输入）且可结构化评分的标准化评测基准。作者希望建立一个可复现、可机读、能区分确定性规则与语义质量的基准，以系统评估不同模型作为终端策略层的实际能力，并探究微调与规模对性能的影响。
AI.method: 构建 955 案例基准，覆盖 6 个真实地铁系统（37 至 414 站）与 11 类任务；每个案例要求模型调用结构化工具并输出机器可渲染的终止状态（结果、单票票价报价、终端动作）。评分分两层：Tier 1 为 14 个确定性组件，Tier 2 为 8 个语义质量组件（其中 6 个使用语言模型裁判），同时报告 Tier 1 与两层合并分。采用分层 75/25 划分，717 例用于训练数据生成，238 例留出评测。对来自 6 家厂商的 26 个模型进行评测（23 个参与排名），并使用 PEFT 训练 2B/4B/9B/27B 的 Qwen 3.5 学生模型，采用多随机种子验证。
AI.result: 在留出集上，经 PEFT 训练的 4B Qwen 3.5 学生模型 Tier 1 得分 91.3，超过 GPT-5.6 两个档位（90.6、90.0），并与最大推理努力的 GPT-5.4 持平（91.4），而 Q4_K_M 量化后体积仅 2.6 GB。9B 与 27B 学生模型在该训练规模下未比 4B 学生带来进一步 Tier 1 提升。四个 Qwen 规模上，PEFT 相对基座模型的增益从 2B 的 +7.03 分降至 27B 的 -0.91 分，且每个规模下各随机种子方向一致。确定性规则基线 Tier 1 达 84.6，语言模型的剩余优势集中在策略适应、复合场景、无障碍与时间推理。Muse Glimmer 30B 在综合排名中领先，仅改变服务配置即可使 Qwen 3.5 与 3.8 的 Tier 1 对比变动 2.7 分。
AI.conclusion: MetroLLM-Bench 为地铁终端策略层提供了可复现、分层评分的标准化评测框架，揭示了小模型经 PEFT 可在确定性指标上超越大模型、而 PEFT 收益随规模增大而递减的规律，并表明服务配置对模型对比结果有显著影响。基准、评测框架、复现指南与微调学生模型均已开源。

title: Elastoformer: Enabling Dynamic Adaptivity via Elastic Model Transformation
summary: EdgeAI systems are increasingly employing computer vision applications to enable intelligent, on-device decision-making in real-time. However, these deployments face highly dynamic operational conditions, with fluctuating constraints on latency, power availability, and memory resources. Deep Neural Networks (DNN), which follow fixed computational execution flows, lack the flexibility to adapt to such variability, resulting in inefficient and suboptimal performance in edge scenarios. This underscores the need for architectures that are not only efficient but also dynamically scalable at runtime. In this paper, we propose Elastoformer: A framework that transforms conventional neural networks (NN) into Elastic NN capable of real-time elastic inference. Unlike the conventional bag-of-models approach, which requires maintaining multiple independent models for different operating conditions, Elastoformer offers a single, modular solution that dynamically switches between multiple modes of operation at runtime, adapting efficiently to the changing computational budgets of edge devices without the overhead of managing separate models. Experiments reveal that our framework achieves up to 85% reduction in computation FLOPs, 50% reduction in latency and 76% reduction in memory overhead, while showcasing the architecture agnostic nature of the framework across both Vision Transformers and CNNs. Our code is available at https://github.com/sudaksh14/Elastoformer.

AI.tldr: 提出Elastoformer框架，将常规神经网络转化为可在运行时动态切换多种工作模式的弹性神经网络，实现边缘设备上的实时弹性推理。
AI.motivation: EdgeAI视觉应用面临延迟、功耗、内存等高度动态的运行约束，而DNN采用固定计算执行流程，缺乏适应这种变化的能力，导致边缘场景下性能低效且次优，因此需要既高效又能在运行时动态伸缩的架构。
AI.method: Elastoformer将传统神经网络转化为弹性NN，支持实时弹性推理。与需为不同运行条件维护多个独立模型的"模型集合"方法不同，它提供单一模块化方案，可在运行时在多种操作模式间动态切换，以适配边缘设备变化的计算预算，且无管理多模型的额外开销。框架具有架构无关性，适用于Vision Transformer和CNN。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架最多减少85%的计算FLOPs、50%的延迟和76%的内存开销，并在Vision Transformer和CNN上验证了架构无关性。
AI.conclusion: Elastoformer以单一模块化弹性架构替代多模型方案，可在运行时高效适配边缘端动态计算预算，显著降低计算、延迟与内存开销，并具备跨架构通用性。

title: Deterministic Prompting for Speaker-Stable Low-Resource Greek TTS
summary: Modern TTS systems approach human quality for high-resource languages but degrade when clean speech data is scarce. Modern Greek exemplifies this, lacking the curated corpora behind state-of-the-art synthesis. We propose a data curation recipe that transforms audiobook recordings into TTS-ready data via WhisperX alignment and filtering. Then we fine-tune Parler-TTS (880M), a prompt-based multilingual model whose pre-training encodes phonetic priors transferable to Greek. During development, we find that LLM-generated style prompts introduce speaker drift at inference. Replacing them with deterministic prompts resolves this, and a speaker-specific LoRA stage trained on 3.5 h of single-speaker data anchors identity while updating ~5% of parameters. Our system achieves WER 10.7% (2.9 above the ASR floor), MOS-I 4.00 (vs. 4.36 human speech), and near-human speaker consistency (MOS-C 4.24 vs. 4.30), showing that robust single-speaker Greek TTS is achievable with limited curated data.

AI.tldr: 提出一套数据策管流程与微调策略，用有限单说话人希腊语数据构建高质量TTS系统。
AI.motivation: 现代TTS在高资源语言上接近人类水平，但干净语音数据稀缺时性能下降。现代希腊语即典型例子：缺乏支撑最先进合成系统的精选语料库，因此需要低资源条件下的数据构建与建模方案。
AI.method: 提出将有声书录音转化为TTS可用数据的数据策管方案，基于WhisperX对齐与过滤；随后微调Parler-TTS（880M），利用其预训练中的音素先验迁移到希腊语。开发中发现LLM生成风格提示会在推理时引起说话人漂移，改用确定性提示解决；并引入基于3.5小时单说话人数据的说话人特定LoRA阶段，仅更新约5%参数以锚定身份。
AI.result: WER为10.7%（比ASR下限高2.9）；MOS-I为4.00（人类语音4.36）；说话人一致性接近人类（MOS-C 4.24 vs. 4.30）。
AI.conclusion: 在有限精选数据条件下，稳健的单说话人希腊语TTS是可行的；数据策管、确定性提示与轻量LoRA微调是关键。

title: ScorePrompts: Natural-Language Exploration of Symbolic Music Scores through Analysis
comment: Accepted as a Late Breaking Demo (LBD) at the International Society of Music Information Retrieval conference (ISMIR) 2026
summary: We present ScorePrompts, an interactive system in which users upload a score, receive natural-language descriptions of its musical structure, ask questions about specific passages, and inspect the corresponding analysis results in staff notation. Specialist MIR components first estimate harmony, tonality, cadences, formal boundaries, texture, and note-level roles, organizing their outputs at note, beat, measure, and piece levels. A schema-constrained language model converts these results into descriptions rather than inferring musical structure directly from raw MusicXML. For questions such as "What changes in measures 14-18?", a deterministic router selects the relevant measures and analytical levels and returns a concise response together with the underlying results and caveats. Verovio renders the score and links the returned information to cited measures and note-level attributes. The interface also exposes intermediate tables and disagreements between analytical levels. ScorePrompts is intended for exploratory score analysis and explanation, not score editing. The demo shows how existing analysis models, constrained language generation, Q&A retrieval, and notation-based visualization can provide natural-language access to symbolic music analysis while keeping intermediate results inspectable.

AI.tldr: ScorePrompts 是一个交互式乐谱分析系统：用户上传乐谱后，系统以自然语言描述其音乐结构、支持针对具体段落的问答，并在五线谱上可视化对应的分析结果。
AI.motivation: 让符号音乐分析结果以自然语言方式可被访问，同时保持中间结果可检查，服务于探索性乐谱分析与解释（而非乐谱编辑）。
AI.method: 专门的 MIR 组件先估计和声、调性、终止式、曲式边界、织体和音符级角色，并将输出按音符、拍、小节、整曲多层级组织；采用受 schema 约束的语言模型将分析结果转写为描述，而非直接从原始 MusicXML 推断结构。对如"第14–18小节发生了什么变化"这类问题，确定性路由器选取相关小节与分析层级，返回简洁回答及底层结果与注意事项；Verovio 渲染乐谱并将返回信息链接到所引用的小节与音符级属性。
AI.result: 系统可对第14–18小节等问题返回简洁自然语言回答，并附带底层分析结果与注意事项，同时在乐谱中标示引用的小节与音符级属性；界面还展示中间表格及各分析层级之间的不一致。
AI.conclusion: 该演示表明，现有分析模型、受约束的语言生成、问答检索与基于记谱的可视化相结合，可为符号音乐分析提供自然语言访问，并保持中间结果可检查。

title: MedDeID enables locally governed clinical-text de-identification from real or synthetic training data
comment: 64 pages total: 32-page main manuscript with 4 figures, followed by 32-page Supplementary Information
summary: Clinical notes contain personally identifiable information (PII), restricting reuse for research and medical AI, especially when data cannot leave an institution. We developed MedDeID, an on-premises framework combining in-house annotation and synthetic-note generation with model training, inference, pseudonymisation and evaluation. On an independently annotated, adjudicated 300-note Dutch hospital benchmark, a hospital-trained compact transformer detected 98.9% of identifying text while redacting 0.24% of text outside annotated identifiers; a synthetic-only counterpart detected 96.1%. On 100 primary-care notes, the synthetic-trained model achieved higher recall than the hospital-trained model (90.3% versus 87.0%) and greater robustness to identifier-format perturbations. An English instantiation trained without real text detected 99.7% and 98.9% of annotated identifier characters on two external synthetic benchmarks. These results demonstrate transfer of the workflow to another language, but not clinical English performance. MedDeID provides a route to locally governed de-identification using real or synthetic training data.

AI.tldr: 提出MedDeID——一套院内本地部署的去标识化框架，结合院内标注与合成病历生成，覆盖训练、推理、假名化与评估。在荷兰医院300份独立标注基准上，院内训练的小型Transformer识别出98.9%的标识文本，误删仅0.24%；纯合成训练版本识别率96.1%。在100份基层医疗病历上，合成训练模型召回率（90.3%）高于院内训练模型（87.0%），且对标识符格式扰动更鲁棒。英语版本在不使用真实文本的情况下，在两个外部合成基准上分别识别出99.7%和98.9%的标识符字符，证明工作流可跨语言迁移，但不代表临床英语性能。
AI.motivation: 临床病历含个人可识别信息（PII），在数据不得离开机构的前提下，限制了其用于研究与医学AI的可复用性；因此需要可在本地治理、无需外传数据的去标识化方案。
AI.method: MedDeID为院内（on-premises）去标识化框架，整合院内标注与合成病历生成，以及模型训练、推理、假名化和评估全流程。评估使用三类数据：独立标注并裁决的300份荷兰医院病历基准、100份基层医疗病历、以及两个外部合成英文基准；对比院内训练与纯合成训练的紧凑型Transformer。
AI.result: 荷兰医院300份基准：院内训练模型识别98.9%标识文本，误删非标识文本0.24%；纯合成训练模型识别96.1%。100份基层医疗病历：合成训练模型召回率90.3%，高于院内训练模型的87.0%，且对标识符格式扰动更鲁棒。英语实例在不使用真实文本训练的情况下，于两个外部合成基准分别识别99.7%和98.9%的标识符字符。英文结果仅表明工作流可跨语言迁移，未证明临床英语性能。
AI.conclusion: MedDeID证明使用真实或合成训练数据即可实现本地可控的去标识化，并可将工作流迁移至其他语言；但其在临床英语场景的实际效果尚未得到验证。

title: Direct Diversity Optimization for Diverse Successful Trajectories in Preference Post-Training
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 19 pages, 11 figures
summary: LLM agents for sequential decision tasks are often post-trained with trajectory-level outcome labels, but such labels provide little supervision for preserving multiple successful branches from the same decision state. We study this problem as successful strategy coverage: how broadly a model realizes distinct successful strategies under a fixed rollout budget. We present Direct Diversity Optimization (DDO), an offline post-training method that combines Divergence-Tree Collection (DTC) with the Reference-Relative Target-Odds Objective (RTO). DTC constructs state-aligned branch sets rooted at shared decision states, and RTO trains the model to match reference-relative targets over successful alternatives. DDO achieves the strongest task success and successful strategy coverage among the compared post-training methods across BabyAI, BabaIsAI, and WebShop. It also achieves the highest recovery rate after local action replacement and higher task success and coverage than successful-only imitation and decoding-time diversification controls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Direct Diversity Optimization (DDO)，一种离线后训练方法，结合 Divergence-Tree Collection (DTC) 与 Reference-Relative Target-Odds Objective (RTO)，用于提升 LLM 智能体在序贯决策任务中的成功策略覆盖度。
AI.motivation: 轨迹级结果标签对从同一决策状态保留多条成功分支的监督不足，需要研究"成功策略覆盖度"：在固定 rollout 预算下模型能实现多少种不同的成功策略。
AI.method: DDO 由两部分组成：DTC 构建以共享决策状态为根的状态对齐分支集；RTO 训练模型在成功备选策略上匹配参考相对目标（reference-relative targets）。
AI.result: 在 BabyAI、BabaIsAI 和 WebShop 上，DDO 在任务成功率与成功策略覆盖度上均优于对比的后训练方法；在局部动作替换后取得最高恢复率，且任务成功与覆盖度高于仅成功模仿及解码期多样化基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过 DTC 与 RTO 的组合，DDO 有效提升了智能体的成功策略覆盖度和鲁棒性，验证了面向多样化成功分支的离线后训练范式的有效性。

title: OntologyAligner: Ontology-Aligned Retrieval and Hierarchy-Guided Large Language Model Reranking for Biomedical Ontology Normalization
summary: Biomedical ontology normalization maps free-text expressions to standardized concepts, enabling consistent integration and analysis of biomedical data. This task remains challenging because lexical variation and subtle distinctions among hierarchically related concepts can obscure concept boundaries. We present OntologyAligner, a three-stage framework that combines ontology-aligned retrieval, large language model candidate reranking, and selective hierarchy-guided refinement. We also construct PhenoNormBench, a unified benchmark comprising 13,390 samples from seven Human Phenotype Ontology datasets. OntologyAligner achieved state-of-the-art performance on HPO normalization, with 88.78% Macro Top-1 Accuracy and 86.75% Micro Top-1 Accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.85 and 5.07 percentage points, respectively. Ablation analyses showed complementary contributions from all three stages, and sensitivity analyses demonstrated stability across candidate-set sizes and model backbones. Applications to MONDO, MEDIC, and NCBITaxon further established portability to other ontologies. OntologyAligner offers a generalizable framework for accurate mapping of biomedical text to structured ontology concepts. PhenoNormBench and the code are publicly available at https://github.com/zhelishisongjie/OntologyAligner.

AI.tldr: 提出OntologyAligner三阶段框架（本体对齐检索、大模型候选重排序、选择性层级引导精化），并构建PhenoNormBench基准，在HPO规范化上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 生物医学本体规范化将自由文本映射到标准概念，但词汇变异及层级相关概念间的细微差异会模糊概念边界，导致任务困难。
AI.method: OntologyAligner为三阶段框架：本体对齐检索、大语言模型候选重排序、选择性层级引导精化；同时构建PhenoNormBench基准（含七个HPO数据集共13,390个样本）。
AI.result: 在HPO规范化上达SOTA：Macro Top-1 88.78%、Micro Top-1 86.75%，较最强基线分别提升4.85与5.07个百分点；消融显示三阶段互补，敏感性分析表明对候选集规模与模型骨干稳定；在MONDO、MEDIC、NCBITaxon上验证可移植性。
AI.conclusion: OntologyAligner为生物医学文本到结构化本体概念的准确映射提供了可泛化框架，基准与代码已公开。

title: NOPE-HYPE: A Structured Simulation Workflow for Robust Speech-to-Text Across Diverse Acoustic Environments
summary: Robust speech-to-text translation systems should perform reliably across diverse acoustic conditions, yet practical pipelines lack controllable tools for systematic environment exploration. Large speech models remain sensitive to unseen acoustic conditions, as training data rarely cover the full range of real environments.We present NOPEHYPE, a structured training workflow that combines a controllable environment simulator, coverage-optimal environment reduction on Power Spectral Density (PSD) templates, and a small, interpretable hyperparameter search over simulator knobs. We show that simulator-generated noise achieves performance comparable to balanced realnoise training across Whisper and SeamlessM4T models, provide principled environment prototype sets, and identify practical default simulator configurations from a structured 27-run hyperparameter sweep.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NOPEHYPE，一种面向语音到文本翻译（ST）的结构化训练流程，结合可控环境模拟器、基于PSD模板的覆盖最优环境约减与小型可解释超参搜索，用于系统化地提升模型在多样声学条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 实用的语音到文本翻译系统需在多样声学环境下可靠工作，但现有流程缺乏可控工具来系统探索环境。大型语音模型对未见声学条件仍敏感，因为训练数据难以覆盖真实环境的完整分布。
AI.method: NOPEHYPE包含三部分：(1) 可控环境模拟器；(2) 在功率谱密度（PSD）模板上进行覆盖最优的环境约减，得到有原则的环境原型集；(3) 对模拟器旋钮进行小型、可解释的超参数搜索（27次运行的扫描）。
AI.result: 在Whisper与SeamlessM4T模型上，模拟器生成的噪声训练可达到与均衡真实噪声训练相当的性能；同时给出了有原则的环境原型集，并从结构化27次超参扫描中识别出实用的默认模拟器配置。
AI.conclusion: 通过可控模拟、覆盖最优环境选择与可解释超参搜索，可系统化地构建鲁棒的语音到文本翻译训练流程，并为环境噪声模拟提供可复用的默认配置。

title: Automatic Reproducible Camera Intrinsic Calibration
summary: Accurate camera intrinsic calibration is fundamental to robot perception, and the accuracy depends on the quality of the collected images. However, existing target-based calibration methods often require the practitioner to manually filter out high-quality images and to specify an appropriate radial distortion order. This paper presents a fully automatic intrinsic calibration pipeline that determines both from the collected data. We adopt an iterative rejection scheme that estimates parameters on a candidate image set and removes views whose mean residual exceeds a multiple of the median. Crucially, this process runs independently under each candidate distortion order, so that the retained image set is consistent with the residual scale of that order. Further, the distortion order is selected on held-out images, with the intrinsics and distortion fixed and only the board pose re-estimated, ensuring that an added coefficient is supported by independent observations. Finally, we integrate both steps into an interactive calibration tool that supports full-pipeline data inspection and parameter estimation. Experiments on our own camera data and five public real-world datasets show that image filtering reduces the held-out reprojection error by 25\%, the order selection further by 5\%, achieving the lowest held-out mean among four compared configurations without manual image selection. We will release the code and data to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: 提出全自动相机内参标定流程，从数据中自动确定高质量图像子集与畸变阶数，实验证明可显著降低留出重投影误差。
AI.motivation: 相机内参标定精度依赖采集图像质量，但现有靶标类方法需人工筛选高质量图像并手动指定径向畸变阶数，缺乏自动化与客观依据。
AI.method: 采用迭代剔除策略：在候选图像集上估计参数，剔除平均残差超过中位数若干倍的视图；该过程在每个候选畸变阶数下独立运行，使保留图像集与该阶数的残差尺度一致。畸变阶数在留出图像上选择，固定内参与畸变、仅重估标定板位姿，以保证新增系数有独立观测支撑。两步集成到支持全流程数据检查与参数估计的交互式标定工具中。
AI.result: 在自采相机数据和五个公开真实世界数据集上，图像筛选使留出重投影误差降低25%，阶数选择进一步降低5%，在四种对比配置中取得最低的留出均值，且无需人工选图。
AI.conclusion: 该全自动流程可同时自动完成图像筛选与畸变阶数选择，有效提升标定精度，并将开源代码与数据以促进后续研究。

title: A statistical approach to bias in zero-shot learning: the lens of handwriting recognition
summary: Generalized zero-shot learning (GZSL) has emerged as an important paradigm for visual recognition systems that must generalize to classes that were not observed during training. Traditional GZSL techniques are limited by their applicability to a relatively small number of such unseen classes, scalability beyond which is challenging due to its well-known misclassification bias towards classes observed during training. In this work, we investigate the GZSL paradigm through the lens of zero-shot handwritten word recognition over extremely large vocabularies. We propose a statistical approach to rectifying this bias, which views any classical GZSL feature learner as a black box mechanism whose intrinsic bias in identifying the training status (seen vs. unseen) of a typical data point we aim to correct, similar to an out of distribution inferential problem. Our method leverages a simple two-stage hierarchical architecture, combining a classical GZSL blackbox in the first stage and an ensemble of lightweight Monte Carlo bias-correctors in the second. Once debiased, the classification of test data is undertaken only restricted to its predicted training status via well-founded statistical methods (eg nearest neighbour, logistic regression and random forests). We achieve relative accuracy improvements of over 20% in the classification of unseen words compared to established techniques. A key outcome is that word recognition over large scale vocabularies is amenable to a much lower dimensional representation (~15 dimensions). Our approach is underpinned by mathematical analysis that captures the essence of the statistical approach to bias correction. Our approach to bias rectification can be combined in a turn-key fashion with any classical GZSL learner as a blackbox, thereby suggesting a wide scope of applicability of this method for a wide variety of GZSL implementations in different domains.

AI.tldr: 本文通过零样本手写单词识别任务研究广义零样本学习（GZSL），提出一种将经典GZSL学习器视为黑盒、用两阶段层次架构校正其训练状态偏置的统计方法，在未见词分类上取得超过20%的相对精度提升，并表明大规模词表识别可用约15维的低维表示。
AI.motivation: 传统GZSL方法受限于可处理的未见类数量较少，难以扩展到大规模类别，原因是其对训练中见过的类存在众所周知的误分类偏置。作者希望借助超大规模词表下的零样本手写单词识别来重新审视GZSL范式，解决该偏置问题。
AI.method: 提出一种统计式偏置校正方法：将任意经典GZSL特征学习器视为黑盒，将其在判断数据点训练状态（见过/未见）时的内在偏置类比为分布外推断问题。方法采用简单的两阶段层次架构，第一阶段使用经典GZSL黑盒，第二阶段使用轻量级蒙特卡洛偏置校正器集成。去偏后，测试数据的分类仅在其预测的训练状态范围内进行，采用最近邻、逻辑回归和随机森林等统计方法。方法配有数学分析支撑。
AI.result: 与已有技术相比，在未见词分类上取得超过20%的相对精度提升。一个关键结果是，大规模词表下的单词识别可采用约15维的低维表示。
AI.conclusion: 该偏置校正方法可以即插即用（turn-key）方式与任何经典GZSL学习器结合，作为黑盒使用，因而在不同领域、各类GZSL实现中具有广泛的适用性。

title: RAP: Research Attention Prediction Reveals Target-Conditioned Evidence Acquisition Biases
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as research agents, yet their ability to track shifts in research attention is difficult to evaluate because reviews and research ideas lack uniquely verifiable outcomes. We introduce Research Attention Prediction (RAP), a rolling benchmark covering 278 AI/ML fields and 1,390 episodes. At each cut-off, an LLM agent searches a temporally restricted arXiv corpus and predicts the next six months' paper shares across eight frozen research directions. Search generally helps, but all four diagnostic models perform worse than an exact-count exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) baseline in compositional accuracy. We identify two linked bottlenecks. Under cumulative-history access, State carry-forward outperforms direct Forecast for all four diagnostic models; frozen-evidence replay links a shared component of this reversal to Forecast-oriented policies retrieving a smaller share of recent evidence. Even with exact historical activity, future-specific updating remains limited, with only GPT-5.5 plus reopened Search slightly surpassing EWMA. Fine-tuning on realised outcomes improves Qwen3-4B's forecast Spearman correlation by 0.105 on held-out fields at later origins, with gains also on change-rich episodes.

AI.tldr: 提出滚动基准 RAP（278 个 AI/ML 领域、1390 个 episode），评估 LLM 智能体预测未来六个月研究注意力分布的能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 日益作为研究智能体使用，但其追踪研究关注度变化的能力难以评估，因为综述与研究想法缺乏可唯一验证的结果。
AI.method: 在 RAP 中，每个时间切点上智能体在受限时间窗口的 arXiv 语料中检索，并预测八个固定研究方向未来六个月的论文份额；对比四个诊断模型与精确计数的 EWMA 基线，并进行累积历史访问、冻结证据重放及微调实验。
AI.result: 检索总体有帮助，但四个诊断模型在组合准确率上均不如 EWMA 基线；累积历史下 State carry-forward 优于直接 Forecast，冻结证据重放将该反转部分归因于 Forecast 策略检索到的近期证据份额较少；即使给定精确历史活动，未来特异性更新仍有限，仅 GPT-5.5 加重新开放检索略超 EWMA；在真实结果上微调使 Qwen3-4B 在后续时间原点保留领域上的 Spearman 相关提升 0.105，变化丰富 episode 亦有增益。
AI.conclusion: 现有 LLM 智能体在预测研究注意力转移上普遍弱于简单统计基线，检索与状态机制存在证据覆盖瓶颈，微调可带来一定改进。

title: LinearMask-GS: Stable-Mask Importance Pruning for Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: Accepted to BMVC 2026. 17 pages main paper + 17 pages supplementary material, 3 figures, 4 tables in the main paper
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis but produces millions of primitives through adaptive densification, leading to significant storage overhead. Learned-mask pruning methods such as LP-3DGS address this by assigning each Gaussian a learnable mask to identify and prune redundant primitives. However, we identify a limitation of this paradigm: the steep slope of the Gumbel-Sigmoid activation drives mask values to the extremes within the short mask-training window, before the importance ranking has stabilized, producing a sharply bimodal distribution from which that ranking can no longer be reliably recovered. We propose LinearMask-GS, which replaces Gumbel-Sigmoid with a linear increment activation that keeps mask values in a mid-confidence regime throughout mask training, producing a stable, unimodal mask distribution whose ranking tracks importance. On Mip-NeRF 360, our method achieves 3.6x and 1.6x Gaussian reductions over 3DGS and LP-3DGS, respectively, while maintaining or improving rendering quality. For outdoor scenes, it yields a 1.6x reduction (from 2.18M to 1.36M) with notable gains in PSNR (+0.38 dB), SSIM (+0.025), and LPIPS (-0.029).

AI.tldr: 提出LinearMask-GS，用线性增量激活替代Gumbel-Sigmoid来改进3DGS的掩码剪枝，实现更稳定的掩码分布与更高的压缩率。
AI.motivation: 3DGS通过自适应致密化产生数百万图元，存储开销大；现有学习掩码剪枝方法（如LP-3DGS）存在缺陷：Gumbel-Sigmoid激活的陡峭斜率使掩码值在短训练窗口内迅速趋于两极，在重要性排序尚未稳定前就形成尖锐双峰分布，导致排序无法可靠恢复。
AI.method: LinearMask-GS用线性增量激活（linear increment activation）替代Gumbel-Sigmoid，使掩码值在掩码训练全程保持在中置信度区间，从而产生稳定、单峰的掩码分布，其排序能够准确反映图元重要性。
AI.result: 在Mip-NeRF 360上，相比3DGS和LP-3DGS分别实现3.6倍和1.6倍的高斯数量缩减，同时保持或提升渲染质量；户外场景实现1.6倍缩减（从2.18M降至1.36M），PSNR提升+0.38 dB，SSIM提升+0.025，LPIPS降低-0.029。
AI.conclusion: 通过将掩码激活从Gumbel-Sigmoid改为线性增量，避免了训练早期掩码值过早饱和带来的排序失效问题，在保持或提升渲染质量的前提下显著压缩了3DGS的存储开销。

title: Data-Centric Post-Training for Financial Reasoning: Mining, Distillation, and Verifiable Learning
summary: Financial text, textbooks, and question-answer pairs are abundant, but only a small fraction is directly usable for reasoning-focused post-training. Existing QA pairs often lack explicit reasoning, sufficient context, or reliably verifiable answers, while textbooks must first be transformed into synthetic training examples. We present a data-centric pipeline that constructs complementary corpora by mining open-source reasoning traces, distilling financial instruction data, and generating knowledge-graph-guided question-answer pairs from financial educational material. After semantic deduplication, three lightweight sequence classifiers select finance-relevant examples, reject under-specified questions, and identify tasks suitable for reinforcement learning with compact rule-based verifiers. For model adaptation, we study supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, while self-distilled fine-tuning and post-training model merging are used to prevent the loss of financial capabilities already present in the starting model. We evaluate the adapted language models using FINESSE-Bench, reporting aggregate performance and changes relative to their starting checkpoints. Across the selected comparisons, ordinary SFT reduces FINESSE-Bench accuracy by 3.2-4.0 percentage points, whereas self-distilled SFT improves over the corresponding starting models by 1.0-2.8 points. Equal-weight merging recovers 3.0 points over its SFT parent and finishes 0.9 points above the original model; GRPO on hard tasks adds 0.4 points after self-distilled SFT or 3.0 points when applied directly to verifiable tasks. These results show that retention-aware adaptation can improve financial reasoning without the regressions observed after ordinary SFT.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以数据为中心的流水线，融合开源推理轨迹、金融指令蒸馏与知识图谱引导的QA生成，构建互补语料，并采用保留感知的适配策略（自蒸馏SFT、模型合并、GRPO）来提升金融推理能力，避免普通SFT带来的性能回退。
AI.motivation: 金融文本、教材和问答对虽丰富，但可直接用于推理型后训练的数据很少：现有QA对往往缺乏显式推理、上下文不足或答案难以可靠验证，教材又需先转化为合成训练样本。因此需要构建高质量、可验证的金融推理训练数据与适配方法。
AI.method: 数据侧：挖掘开源推理轨迹、蒸馏金融指令数据、基于金融教育材料生成知识图谱引导的QA对；经语义去重后，用三个轻量序列分类器筛选金融相关样本、剔除欠定问题、识别适合基于紧凑规则验证器进行强化学习的任务。模型侧：研究监督微调（SFT）与强化学习，并用自蒸馏微调与后训练模型合并防止起始模型已有金融能力的遗忘。
AI.result: 在FINESSE-Bench上评估：普通SFT使准确率下降3.2-4.0个百分点；自蒸馏SFT相比对应起始模型提升1.0-2.8个百分点；等权合并比其SFT父模型恢复3.0个百分点，并比原始模型高0.9个百分点；GRPO在自蒸馏SFT后于困难任务上增加0.4个百分点，直接用于可验证任务时增加3.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 保留感知的适配策略能够在提升金融推理能力的同时，避免普通SFT所导致的性能回退，说明数据构建与防遗忘适配方法对金融领域后训练均至关重要。

title: ProbPlug: A Plugin Uncertainty Network for Reliable Confidence in LLM Binary Classification
comment: Accepted by the 23rd Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence. (PRICAI 2026)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across a broad range of classification settings, yet the reliability of their predictions remains a major obstacle to deployment in high-stakes scenarios. Although confidence estimation for LLMs has been widely studied, confidence calibration for LLM-based classification remains underexplored. We introduce ProbPlug, a lightweight confidence estimation framework for LLM-based binary classification, which predicts whether an output is correct using internal token features extracted from a frozen LLM. ProbPlug employs a self-attention module to aggregate hidden representations and can be integrated into the original inference pipeline without modifying the base model. Experiments across multiple tasks involving both text-based and multimodal large models show that ProbPlug provides more reliable confidence estimates, improves classification performance with negligible additional overhead, and exhibits strong generalization across tasks. These results indicate that ProbPlug serves as a practical solution for confidence estimation in LLM-based classification. Our code is publicly available at Github.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProbPlug，一种面向大语言模型二分类任务的轻量级置信度估计框架，利用冻结 LLM 的内部 token 特征预测输出是否正确，在多个文本与多模态任务上提升了置信度可靠性与分类性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在各类分类任务上表现优异，但其预测可靠性不足，阻碍了在高风险场景中的部署；尽管 LLM 置信度估计已有较多研究，但面向 LLM 分类的置信度校准仍缺乏深入探索。
AI.method: ProbPlug 从冻结的 LLM 中提取内部 token 特征，通过自注意力模块聚合隐藏层表示，从而预测模型输出是否正确；该框架可无缝集成到原有推理流程中，无需修改基础模型，属于轻量级置信度估计方案。
AI.result: 在涵盖纯文本与多模态大模型的多个任务实验中，ProbPlug 提供了更可靠的置信度估计，在极小的额外开销下提升了分类性能，并展现出较强的跨任务泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ProbPlug 可作为 LLM 分类任务中置信度估计的实用解决方案，代码已公开于 GitHub。

title: If It's Not Buggy, Don't Fix It: On the Dynamics of Iterative Bug-fixing with LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become ubiquitous in software development, with LLM-based automated program repair tools increasingly used during code review. In this report, we explore the iterative blind use of LLMs as bug-fixers. Across multiple models and repair environments, we find that LLMs consistently claim to detect bugs in entirely bug-free programs while the rate of repair of buggy programs is less than that of the damage to correct programs. We also explore the long-term dynamics of this iterative process, and find that this frequently reaches a pseudo-bug-fixing cycle where the same changes are added and removed again ad infinitum. Lastly, via mechanistic probing, we unveil the existence of a steering vector which controls the editing propensity, suggesting that LLMs have an internal representation of ``buggy code", and that this representation is what is falsely activated to induce pseudo-bug fixing. These results provide insight towards the dynamics of fully autonomous bug-fixing systems, as well as stopping conditions under ambiguous goals.

AI.tldr: 该报告揭示LLM作为自动程序修复器在盲用场景下的失效模式：模型常对无缺陷程序误报并改动，而真实修复率反而低于对正确代码的破坏率，且迭代过程易陷入反复增删的伪修复循环；机制探针进一步发现控制编辑倾向的"引导向量"，表明模型内部存在被误激活的"缺陷代码"表征。
AI.motivation: LLM已广泛用于软件开发，基于LLM的自动程序修复工具在代码评审中被频繁部署，但其在缺乏可靠验证的条件下被盲目迭代使用所带来的风险尚未被系统考察。作者希望理解完全自主修复系统的长期动态与在模糊目标下的停止条件问题。
AI.method: 在多种模型与多种修复环境下进行迭代式盲用实验；统计对无缺陷程序的误报率与真实缺陷的修复率并作对比；追踪多轮迭代的长期动态以观察修复行为演化；最后通过机制可解释性探针（mechanistic probing）识别控制编辑倾向的引导向量。
AI.result: LLM在不同模型与环境下一致地对完全无缺陷的程序声称检测到缺陷；对存在缺陷程序的修复率低于对正确程序造成破坏的比率；长期迭代频繁进入"伪修复循环"，同一批改动被反复添加与撤销；机制探针发现一个控制编辑倾向的引导向量，可操纵模型的改动行为。
AI.conclusion: LLM内部存在"缺陷代码"的内部表征，该表征被错误激活即导致伪修复行为。研究为完全自主修复系统的动力学以及模糊目标下的停止条件设计提供了启示。

title: SA-Profile: Automated Sulcus Angle Profiling from Super-Resolution MRI
comment: Accepted at MICCAI endorsed Event MICAD 2026
summary: Trochlear dysplasia (TD) is an abnormality of the femoral trochlea associated with anterior knee pain and patellar instability. The sulcus angle (SA) is used to assess trochlear morphology, but it is typically measured on a single axial MR slice with no clear guidance on which to select, making it sensitive to slice selection and landmark placement. We propose an automatic framework for continuous SA profiling from super-resolved MR volumes. Clinically acquired axial, coronal, and sagittal MR scans are combined using implicit neural representations to reconstruct a high-resolution volume. SA measurements are computed across the trochlear region using two landmark detection U-Net models. The approach was evaluated on the public fastMRI dataset and a small in-house cohort of patients with TD. Compared with conventional manual single-slice SA measurements, the proposed automated method yielded a mean absolute error of 11.6$^\circ$ while providing continuous characterization of trochlear morphology. Population-level analysis demonstrated distinct mean SA profiles between the public cohort and the in-house TD cohort, highlighting the potential of profile-based assessment to characterize TD. By reducing reliance on a single manually selected axial slice, the proposed framework extends conventional SA assessment to a continuous profile-based description of trochlear morphology without additional imaging, while remaining conceptually linked to current clinical assessment. Further validation is required. The code is available: https://github.com/wehrlimi/SA_Profile.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于隐式神经表示超分辨与双U-Net地标检测的自动化框架，实现股骨滑车沟角（SA）的连续剖面刻画，在fastMRI和院内TD队列上验证。
AI.motivation: 滑车发育不良（TD）与前膝痛、髌骨不稳相关，滑车沟角（SA）是评估滑车形态的关键指标，但传统SA仅在单一轴位MR层面手工测量，层面选择与地标定位缺乏明确规范，导致结果对层面选取敏感、重复性差。
AI.method: 将临床采集的轴位、冠状位、矢状位MR扫描通过隐式神经表示（INR）融合重建为高分辨率体数据；在滑车区域使用两个地标检测U-Net模型自动定位测量点，进而沿滑车范围连续计算SA，形成SA剖面。
AI.result: 在公开fastMRI数据集与小型院内TD患者队列上评估：相较传统手工单层面SA，自动化方法的平均绝对误差为11.6°；群体层面分析显示公开队列与院内TD队列具有不同的平均SA剖面具特征性差异。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在不增加额外成像的前提下，将传统单层面SA评估拓展为连续剖面式的滑车形态描述，且概念上与现行临床评估保持一致，有望用于TD刻画；但仍需进一步验证。

title: TransGaze-Object: Transformer Based Driver Gaze Object Prediction Framework in Real Driving
summary: Driver gaze provides information regarding driver visual attention and situational awareness to the surrounding traffic. Existing driver gaze estimation studies represent gaze in terms of gaze zone or gaze vector/point-of-gaze (PoG). However, object-level gaze information provides a more semantically meaningful representation of visual attention by identifying attended objects, such as vehicles, pedestrians, or traffic signals. In this study, we propose an end-to-end driver gaze object prediction framework, TransGaze-Object, Transformer-based Gaze Object prediction model. The proposed framework first extracts facial features, including face and iris-weighted eye features, along with trafficobject spatial features. A transformer based cross-attention mechanism is then used to compute similarity scores and attention weights for predicting the drivers gaze object. To train this model, we propose a benchmark driver gaze dataset, Urban Driving-Face Scene Gaze (UD-FSG), comprising synchronized driver-face and traffic-scene images, scene objects bounding boxes, and gaze labels in terms of 2D gaze coordinate and gaze object. The TransGaze-Object model achieves an overall accuracy of 60% for gaze-object prediction, compared to 51% accuracy obtained from associating the estimated Point-of-Gaze to traffic objects. The error analysis reveals that TransGaze-Object reduces confusion between traffic objects (predicted) and the background (ground-truth), achieving an error rate of 11.68%, a 49.7% relative reduction compared with 23.21% error obtained from PoG-based gaze-object association. Overall, the results demonstrate the effectiveness of directly predicting gaze objects from driver-face and traffic-scene information, rather than estimating an intermediate Point-of-Gaze and subsequently associating it with traffic objects.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端Transformer驾驶员注视对象预测框架TransGaze-Object，并构建UD-FSG基准数据集，直接由驾驶员面部与交通场景预测注视对象，准确率60%，优于基于PoG关联的51%。
AI.motivation: 驾驶员注视反映其视觉注意与情境意识。现有研究多以注视区域或注视向量/注视点(PoG)表示注视，缺乏语义信息；对象级注视信息通过识别被注视对象（车辆、行人、交通信号等）能更语义化地表达视觉注意，故需直接预测注视对象。
AI.method: 提出端到端框架TransGaze-Object：先提取面部特征（含人脸与虹膜加权眼部特征）及交通对象空间特征，再通过基于Transformer的交叉注意力机制计算相似度分数与注意力权重以预测注视对象。同时构建UD-FSG基准数据集，包含同步的驾驶员面部与交通场景图像、场景对象边界框，以及2D注视坐标和注视对象标注。
AI.result: TransGaze-Object注视对象预测整体准确率为60%，而将估计的PoG与交通对象关联的方法为51%。误差分析显示，该模型将交通对象与背景的混淆降至11.68%，相比PoG关联法的23.21%相对降低49.7%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，直接由驾驶员面部与交通场景信息预测注视对象，优于先估计中间量PoG再与交通对象关联的两阶段方法。

title: Active Adaptation, Not Static Defense: Temporal Dynamics of Preventative Steering in Adversarial Fine-Tuning
summary: Large language models remain fragile against malicious fine-tuning, motivating training-time defenses against harmful persona drift. Preventative Steering injects undesirable-trait persona vectors during fine-tuning and removes them at evaluation time, yet the mechanism behind its lasting protection remains unclear. Analyzing its temporal optimization dynamics, we find that the defense emerges from an early compensatory adaptation phase followed by a steady-state phase where the corrective signal decays; in parameter space, attention output projections emerge as the dominant residual-write route for defensive updates. Through Intervention Delta Preservation (IDP) and IDP Continuation experiments, we further show that preserving or reinjecting the weight offset fails to maintain protection, indicating that preventative steering relies on active adaptation rather than a static defense. Motivated by this finding, we propose Progressive Intensity Scheduling (PIS), which starts with a moderate injection strength and increases it after static-strength alignment begins to decay. Across the evaluated Qwen2.5 and Gemma-3 models, PIS improves safety robustness over static-strength steering while reducing harmful trait expression.

AI.tldr: 本文分析预防性引导（Preventative Steering）抵御恶意微调的机制，发现其保护源于早期补偿性适应阶段与后期校正信号衰减的稳态阶段，注意力输出投影是防御更新的主要残差写入路径；据此提出渐进强度调度（PIS），可提升安全性并减少有害特质表达。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型面对恶意微调仍然脆弱，需要训练时防御以抑制有害人格漂移。预防性引导通过在微调时注入不良特质人格向量、评估时移除来实现保护，但其持久保护的内在机制尚不明确，阻碍了防御方法的进一步优化。
AI.method: 从时间优化动态入手分析预防性引导的机制，刻画其早期补偿性适应与后期稳态衰减两阶段，并在参数空间定位注意力输出投影为主要残差写入路径；通过干预增量保持（IDP）与IDP延续实验检验静态权重偏移能否维持保护；基于"依赖主动适应而非静态防御"的结论，提出渐进强度调度（PIS），先以中等注入强度启动，在静态强度对齐开始衰减后提升强度。
AI.result: 机制分析表明防御效果来自早期补偿性适应，随后校正信号在稳态阶段衰减，注意力输出投影主导防御性更新。IDP与IDP延续实验显示，保留或重新注入权重偏移均无法维持保护，说明其依赖主动适应而非静态防御。在Qwen2.5与Gemma-3模型上，PIS相较静态强度引导提升了安全鲁棒性，同时减少了有害特质表达。
AI.conclusion: 预防性引导的持久保护源于动态适应过程而非静态参数偏移；据此设计的渐进强度调度通过阶段性增强注入强度，在多个模型上实现更优的安全鲁棒性与更低的有害特质表达，为训练时防御提供了可解释的机制依据与改进方案。

title: YallaMorph: A Benchmark for Evaluating Arabic Morphological Generation in Large Language Models
summary: Arabic morphology remains challenging for large language models, since fluent generation does not guarantee accurate morphosyntactic control. Existing Arabic evaluations mainly target downstream tasks and do not directly test controlled morphological generation from explicit lexical and feature-based input. We introduce YallaMorph, a large-scale benchmark for Arabic morphological generation covering verbs, nouns, adjectives, their cliticized forms, and invalid configurations. We evaluate multilingual and Arabic-oriented LLMs under diacritized and undiacritized settings over 600K benchmark entries. Results show that Arabic morphological generation remains difficult, especially for cliticized, unseen, and morphologically rare forms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出YallaMorph，一个面向阿拉伯语形态生成的大规模基准，涵盖动词、名词、形容词及其附缀形式与非法配置，共60万条测试项，在带符/不带符两种设置下评估多语言与阿拉伯语专用LLM。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语形态对LLM仍具挑战性，流利生成不等于准确的形态句法控制；现有阿拉伯语评测主要面向下游任务，未直接测试基于显式词汇与特征输入的可控形态生成。
AI.method: 构建YallaMorph大规模基准，覆盖动词、名词、形容词、其附缀化形式以及非法配置；设计带变音符号与不带变音符号两种生成设置，对多语言LLM和阿拉伯语导向LLM在60万条基准条目上进行评测。
AI.result: 阿拉伯语形态生成依然困难，模型在附缀化、未见形式以及形态稀有形式上表现尤为欠佳。
AI.conclusion: 显式词汇与特征驱动的可控形态生成构成阿拉伯语LLM的实际短板，YallaMorph可作为针对性诊断与改进的基准。

title: From Retrieval to Weights: Parametric Individualization of Small Language Models with Individual Text Corpora
summary: We approach a cognitive simulation perspective on episodic and semantic memory in multiple-choice question answering by incorporating text from individual text corpora (ITC) into retrieval-augmented generation and DoRA fine-tuning. We web-crawl the search histories of 515 participants who answered 36 multiple-choice knowledge items and analyze a stratified subsample of 150 participants. For each participant, one DoRA adapter consolidates their ITC into a small language model (SLM) whose baseline correctness falls below the participants' lowest quartile. The adapter measurably writes the ITC into the weights: it fits its own participant's held-out text better than other participants' texts (dz =1.27), an individuality effect that increases with ITC size in rank order. On the generalized knowledge test, however, the adapter adds knowledge rather than alignment with the individual: log-loss match improves, whereas match accuracy under a bias-corrected PMI readout does not, and retrieval adds nothing on top. Our results demonstrate that ITCs can be consolidated into the weights of SLMs, an encouraging basis for individualized tutoring agents, and we discuss how to move from there toward a realistic simulation of episodic and semantic memory at the individual level.

AI.tldr: 该研究将个体文本语料（ITC）通过检索增强生成与DoRA微调整合进小语言模型，以模拟个体层面的情景记忆与语义记忆；ITC可被写入模型权重并体现个体性，但在泛化知识测试上带来的是知识增量而非个体对齐。
AI.motivation: 从认知模拟视角出发，探索如何在个体层面模拟情景记忆与语义记忆；同时为个性化辅导智能体提供技术基础，检验个体文本语料能否被整合进小语言模型。
AI.method: 爬取515名被试的搜索历史（每人回答36道多项选择知识题），并对150人的分层子样本进行分析。为每名被试训练一个DoRA适配器，将其ITC整合进基线正确率低于该被试最低四分位的小语言模型（SLM），并结合检索增强生成进行评估。
AI.result: 适配器可测量地将ITC写入权重：对本被试留出文本的拟合优于他人文本（dz=1.27），该个体性效应随ITC规模按秩次增强。但在泛化知识测试上，适配器带来的是知识增量而非个体对齐：log-loss匹配改善，而经偏差校正的PMI读出下的匹配准确率未提升，检索亦无额外增益。
AI.conclusion: ITC能够被整合进小语言模型的权重，这为个性化辅导智能体提供了有前景的基础；作者进一步讨论了如何由此推进到个体层面情景记忆与语义记忆的现实模拟。

title: ScopeMamba-YOLO: Widening the Perceptual Scope Inward and Outward for Small Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Small object detection in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and remote sensing imagery requires preserving high-resolution detail while modeling long-range context. Adding a stride-4 detection level and removing the stride-32 stage benefits tiny targets but weakens peripheral spatial support, whereas directly inserting selective scanning into the main feature path can interfere with weak local cues. We propose ScopeMamba-YOLO, built around an off-path, zero-gated selective-scanning principle that decouples contextual modeling from the convolutional stream. The principle is instantiated by a Cascaded Global-Context Module (CGCM) in the backbone and a Selective-Scan PAN (SS-PAN) in the neck. An Adaptive Multi-scale Strip (AMS) Block reduces the cost of high-resolution feature extraction, while a Scale-Adaptive DFL (SA-DFL) head reallocates distributional support and regression capacity across scales with only 0.008M additional parameters. Controlled experiments show that matched main-path selective scanning reduces mAP50 by 0.98 pp, whereas off-path CGCM improves the final configuration by 0.67 pp over the three-seed no-CGCM mean; operator controls indicate that this gain is not explained by auxiliary branch capacity alone. ERF analysis further shows that the complete context pathway increases the peripheral energy ratio from 0.008 to 0.090 at stride 8. On VisDrone-2019, ScopeMamba-S achieves 50.8% mAP50 with 3.57M parameters, exceeding YOLOv8s by 10.8 pp while using 32% of its parameters; ScopeMamba-M reaches 52.6% mAP50 with 6.48M parameters. Consistent improvements are also observed on AI-TOD, especially for very-tiny and tiny objects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScopeMamba-YOLO，通过“离路零门控选择性扫描”原则，将全局上下文建模与卷积主路解耦，在无人机与遥感小目标检测上以极低参数量取得显著精度提升。
AI.motivation: 无人机与遥感图像中的小目标检测需同时保留高分辨率细节并建模长程上下文。增加stride-4检测层、去除stride-32阶段有利于微小目标，但削弱了外围空间支撑；而将选择性扫描直接插入主特征路径又会干扰微弱的局部线索，因此需要一种不干扰主路的上下文建模方式。
AI.method: 提出ScopeMamba-YOLO，核心为离路、零门控的选择性扫描原则，将上下文建模与卷积流解耦。该原则由骨干中的级联全局上下文模块（CGCM）和颈部中的选择性扫描PAN（SS-PAN）实例化；并设计自适应多尺度条带（AMS）块降低高分辨率特征提取成本，以及尺度自适应DFL（SA-DFL）头，以仅增加0.008M参数重新分配跨尺度的分布支撑与回归能力。
AI.result: 对照实验显示，将选择性扫描置于主路会使mAP50下降0.98个百分点，而离路CGCM相比三种子无CGCM均值提升0.67个百分点；算子控制表明该增益不能仅由辅助分支容量解释。ERF分析显示完整上下文路径在stride 8处将外围能量比从0.008提升至0.090。在VisDrone-2019上，ScopeMamba-S以3.57M参数达到50.8% mAP50，超过YOLOv8s 10.8个百分点且仅用其32%参数；ScopeMamba-M以6.48M参数达到52.6% mAP50。在AI-TOD上亦有一致提升，尤其对very-tiny和tiny目标。
AI.conclusion: 离路零门控选择性扫描能够在不干扰卷积主路局部线索的前提下有效引入长程上下文，显著提升小目标检测性能，且参数效率高，在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性与泛化性。

title: 3rd Place Solution to Human Motion Challenges in Real-World and Clinical Settings (MoCha) @ECCV2026: Language-Aligned Motion Representations for Domain-Generalizable UPDRS-Gait Severity Estimation
comment: 3rd Place Solution to the MoCha 2026 Challenge at ECCV 2026
summary: In this work, we introduce language-aligned motion representations for domain-generalizable UPDRS-Gait severity estimation, aiming to learn semantically structured motion features that generalize across heterogeneous clinical domains. We first learn motion representations using a Bi-GRU backbone that captures the temporal dynamics of SMPL sequences. Prior to model training, motion captions are generated offline using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. The backbone is then trained with both classification and text-alignment objectives to learn discriminative and semantically structured motion representations while accounting for the class imbalance present in the training data. We subsequently adapt the learned backbone independently to each source domain so that the model can capture domain-specific motion characteristics. The resulting source-specific models are then merged at the parameter level to consolidate complementary knowledge across source domains into a single domain-generalized model. To further mitigate class imbalance, we perform GPT-5.5-based pseudo labeling, and our final merged models for each site do not use any class-prior correction during inference. The resulting model is evaluated under the unseen-site setting of the MoCha Challenge, using Macro F1 as the primary evaluation metric. Our method achieves a macro-F1 of 0.57 on the hidden test set with only 637K active parameters at inference, ranking 3rd among 58 leaderboard entries in the MoCha 2026 Challenge. The challenge attracted 1,669 submissions from 112 participants and offered monetary prizes sponsored by Machine Medicine Technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言对齐的运动表征，用于跨临床域泛化的UPDRS-Gait严重程度估计，在MoCha 2026挑战赛隐藏测试集上取得0.57的Macro-F1，排名第3/58。
AI.motivation: 临床步态数据存在异质性域差异和类别不平衡，现有方法难以学习到语义结构化且可跨域泛化的运动特征，因此需要面向域泛化的UPDRS-Gait严重程度估计方法。
AI.method: 以Bi-GRU为骨干建模SMPL序列的时序动态；离线用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct生成运动描述；联合分类与文本对齐目标训练骨干以获取判别性、语义结构化表征并应对类别不平衡；随后将骨干独立适配到各源域，再在参数层面合并为单一域泛化模型；进一步用GPT-5.5伪标签缓解类别不平衡，推理时不使用类别先验校正。
AI.result: 在MoCha Challenge未见站点设定下，以Macro-F1为主指标，隐藏测试集上Macro-F1为0.57，推理仅637K活跃参数，在58个榜单条目中排名第3。该挑战赛共吸引112名参与者提交1,669次。
AI.conclusion: 语言对齐与多源域参数级合并可有效提升跨域步态严重程度估计的泛化能力，并在低参数量下取得具有竞争力的性能，验证了域泛化策略对临床异质数据的有效性。

title: Who Argues What? Joint Argument-Entity Detection and Classification in Political Debates
summary: Political debates are often analyzed through Argument Mining (AM) to investigate the key arguments that drive them. However, political arguments are rarely interpretable from argumentative spans alone, as claims and premises generally depend on the entities (e.g., people, events, locations, parties) they mention. Existing AM resources and methods typically annotate argumentative spans and roles, but do not provide a paired debate-entity layer for asking which Debate Named Entities (DNE), e.g., actors and events, are invoked within debates. In this work, we address these data and methodological gaps by (i) introducing DNE-ElecDeb, an entity-enriched version of the USElecDeb dataset that adds DNEs in both argumentative and non-argumentative spans and defines Debate Named Entity Recognition (DNER) as the task of detecting DNEs, and (ii) proposing Joint Argument and Entity Tagging (JAET), a generative framework that fine-tunes decoder-only LLMs to insert inline argument and entity tags into debate turns while preserving the original transcript. Under BIO-tagging evaluation, JAET improves relative F1 on the joint AM+DNER task by +27.3%, resp. +41.9%, under the untyped, resp. typed setting over the strongest sequential AM-DNER pipelines, demonstrating that such gains cannot be recovered by composing two independent modules. Notably, similar margins replicate on Persuasive Essays (+26.6%, resp. +52.7%), showing effective generalization to domains orthogonal to political debates. By unifying argumentative and entity-level representations within a single view, our contributions pave the way for richer political debates understanding.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对政治辩论中论点挖掘（AM）忽略实体信息的缺陷，构建了实体增强数据集 DNE-ElecDeb，定义了辩论命名实体识别（DNER）任务，并提出生成式联合框架 JAET，在联合 AM+DNER 任务上相较最强流水线基线显著提升 F1。
AI.motivation: 政治辩论中的论点往往不能仅凭论元跨度理解，其主张与前提通常依赖所提及的实体（人物、事件、地点、政党等）。然而现有 AM 资源只标注论元跨度和角色，缺乏配对的"辩论—实体"层，无法回答哪些辩论命名实体（DNE）在辩论中被调用，因此存在数据与方法的双重空白。
AI.method: (i) 构建 DNE-ElecDeb，即在 USElecDeb 数据集上增强实体标注，在论元与非论元跨度中均加入 DNE，并将检测 DNE 定义为 DNER 任务；(ii) 提出 Joint Argument and Entity Tagging (JAET) 生成式框架，微调 decoder-only LLM，将论元标签与实体标签以内联方式插入辩论轮次文本，同时保持原始转录不变。
AI.result: 在 BIO 标注评估下，JAET 在联合 AM+DNER 任务上，无类型设置下相对 F1 提升 +27.3%，有类型设置下提升 +41.9%，优于最强的 AM-DNER 顺序流水线，表明该增益无法通过组合两个独立模块获得。在 Persuasive Essays 上复现了类似优势（+26.6%、+52.7%），显示出对政治辩论以外领域的有效泛化。
AI.conclusion: 通过在单一视图中统一论元级与实体级表示，该工作弥补了 AM 资源与方法在实体层面的空白，为更深入的政治辩论理解提供了新路径。

title: Politics of Feelings: Emotional Expression and Legislative Effectiveness in the U.S. Congress
summary: Emotions are a pervasive feature of political communication, yet existing research has focused primarily on describing patterns of emotional expression rather than examining whether they are associated with consequential legislative outcomes. We address this gap by investigating the expression and correlates of discrete emotions in more than 1.7 million speeches delivered in the U.S. Congress between 1973 and 2024. Using a transformer-based emotion classifier, we measure eight discrete emotions: anger, fear, disgust, sadness, joy, enthusiasm, pride, and hope. We examine how these emotions vary over time, across policy topics, legislator characteristics, and their relationship with legislative effectiveness. We find that congressional speeches are becoming emotionally expressive over time. Emotional expression also varies systematically across policy domains and ideological positioning of legislators. Notably, the relationship between emotional expression and legislative effectiveness depends on the specific emotions expressed: enthusiasm and pride are positively associated with effectiveness, whereas anger exhibits a negative association. Emotional valence and emotional diversity are positively associated with legislative effectiveness, while emotional intensity is negatively associated with legislative effectiveness. These findings demonstrate that computationally derived measures of discrete emotions can provide insight into affective dimensions of legislative speeches and facilitate our understanding of how legislators communicate, interact, and perform within democratic institutions.

AI.tldr: 该研究用基于Transformer的情感分类器测量美国国会1973–2024年间超170万篇演讲中的八种离散情绪，发现演讲情绪化程度随时间上升，情绪表达随政策领域和意识形态变化，且不同情绪与立法效力的关联方向不同。
AI.motivation: 既有政治传播研究多停留在描述情绪表达模式，较少考察情绪表达是否与实质性立法结果相关。作者旨在填补这一空白，检验美国国会演讲中离散情绪的表达及其与立法效力的关联。
AI.method: 以1973至2024年美国国会超过170万篇演讲为语料，采用基于Transformer的情感分类器，测量愤怒、恐惧、厌恶、悲伤、喜悦、热情、自豪、希望八种离散情绪；分析情绪随时间的演变、跨政策主题与议员特征的差异，以及情绪与立法效力的关系。
AI.result: 国会演讲随时间推移变得更具情绪表达性；情绪表达在政策领域和议员意识形态位置上呈系统性差异。情绪与立法效力的关联因具体情绪而异：热情与自豪同立法效力正相关，愤怒则负相关。情绪效价与情绪多样性同立法效力正相关，而情绪强度与立法效力负相关。
AI.conclusion: 计算得出的离散情绪指标能够揭示立法演讲的情感维度，有助于理解立法者在民主制度中的沟通、互动与表现方式。

title: Through the Looking Glass: Directly Reading and Writing Transformers
summary: How many of a transformer's components decide a token? Counted by the absolute value of each unit's and channel's contribution to the logit, one prediction rests on thousands to hundreds of thousands of them. But contributions are signed, and across eighteen models the mass pushing away from the predicted token is a median of seven times the mass carrying it. Divide by the net and the count is dozens: on the baseline, 53 components carry ninety percent of a prediction, 13 it cannot survive losing, and 8 suffice to produce it alone. Across twelve models trained elsewhere, 124M to 7B parameters, the sufficient set runs from two components to sixteen, and what a prediction draws on, followed all the way back, is one to three percent of the model, a share that does not grow with size. Three quarters of a layer's update is a fixed linear map of the state it received. Everything is read from the model's own parameters and activations, with nothing trained or fitted, and it names a component on both sides: what it writes, from the predictions it drives, reaching close to half of every model; what it reads, from its weights in the frame of its own layer, at 58.9 percent above chance over its eight strongest inputs. Sorting the remainder by upstream source yields grammatical categories the embedding cannot see. A name can be acted on. An association the model does not hold installs into one spare unit, key and value read from the weights, for a quarter of a percent of held-out loss, a fortieth of what a rank-one update costs. An installed attention head and a unit two layers above it make an edit fire only where a token occurred earlier in the context, and a unit the model trained for itself is driven from two layers upstream, 86 percent of the effect passing through it. An order-preserving activation puts a unit's inputs at the instrument's ceiling, at the price of a two-part install.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种无需训练、直接从模型参数与激活中读取的方法,量化Transformer单次预测所依赖的组件数量与结构。核心发现:预测实际依赖的组件仅数十个,且该比例不随模型规模增长;大多数贡献相互抵消。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性研究对"一个预测究竟依赖多少组件"缺乏清晰的定量答案。若仅按贡献绝对值计数,规模达数千至数十万,难以定位关键单元。作者希望用净贡献(带符号)视角重新计数,并进一步从参数和激活中直接读出组件的读/写功能,验证其因果作用与可编辑性。
AI.method: 1. 以每个单元和通道对logit的贡献(带符号)为基础统计净贡献与正负质量之比;2. 移除实验确定最小充分集(可单独产生预测)和不可缺失集;3. 追踪预测依赖的组件回溯路径,测量其占模型参数的比例;4. 分析层更新的线性映射性质;5. 从权重和激活直接命名组件的写入内容(由其驱动的预测)与读取对象(以其所在层坐标系下的权重);6. 通过安装/编辑实验验证因果性;7. 提出保序激活实现两部分安装。
AI.result: 在基线模型上,53个组件承载一次预测90%的贡献,13个是其不可或缺的,8个即可单独产生该预测。跨12个在其他数据上训练的模型(124M至7B参数),充分集为2到16个组件,所依赖部分仅占模型的1%至3%,且该比例不随规模增长。正负质量中位数比约7:1。层更新约四分之三为接收状态的固定线性映射。命名组件的写入覆盖近半模型;读取在其八个最强输入上超随机水平58.9%。按上游来源排序可显现嵌入无法看到的语法类别。安装一个关联仅需一个备用单元,代价为0.25%的留出损失,是秩一更新的四十分之一;安装的注意力头与两层之上的单元可使编辑仅在特定token此前出现时触发,模型自训练的单元效应86%经由其上游单元传递。
AI.conclusion: Transformer的预测虽由海量带符号贡献构成,但净效应可由数十个组件充分承载,且这一稀疏比例与模型规模无关。组件的读/写功能可从权重和激活中直接读出并具备因果效力,支持对模型进行精准定位与轻量编辑。保序激活可将单元输入推至仪器上限,但需两部分安装。整体方法全程无训练、无拟合。

title: UOT-Gap: A Variational Principle for the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models via Unbalanced Optimal Transport
summary: Vision-language models such as CLIP embed images and text in a shared space, where modality-specific distributions often remain separated. Existing accounts connect this modality gap to initialization, contrastive dynamics, and information imbalance, while its distributional and pairwise contributions to retrieval remain unresolved. We introduce UOT-Gap, a training-free variational diagnostic that models frozen image and text embeddings with unbalanced entropic optimal transport (UOT). The UOT optimum separates transport, coupling complexity, and marginal mass variation; a complementary pair-aware residual compares observed image-caption pairs with the UOT soft matching. On Flickr8K and COCO-1K with frozen CLIP, OpenCLIP, and SigLIP encoders, caption degradation reduces Flickr8K Recall@1 from 0.559 to 0.003. Across six dataset-model conditions, the pair-aware residual tracks retrieval degradation with mean absolute Spearman 0.973, compared with 0.392 for the mean gap. The association remains stable across five random COCO-1K subsets at $0.954\pm0.026$, with a minimum of 0.943. UOT barycentric updates reduce the transport objective while degrading retrieval, distinguishing geometric objective descent from task improvement. These results establish UOT-Gap as a diagnostic for caption quality, modality alignment, and retrieval robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练变分诊断工具 UOT-Gap，用非平衡熵最优传输分解冻结的图文嵌入，并通过成对感知残差刻画检索退化，其与Recall@1下降的Spearman相关性达0.973（均值间隔仅0.392）。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉-语言模型将图像与文本嵌入到共享空间，但模态特定分布往往相互分离（模态间隔）。已有工作将间隔归因于初始化、对比学习动力学、信息不平衡，但该间隔的分布性与成对贡献对检索的影响尚未厘清。作者希望区分几何目标下降与任务性能提升，提供可诊断字幕质量、模态对齐与检索鲁棒性的工具。
AI.method: 提出UOT-Gap：一种免训练变分诊断方法。对冻结的图像与文本嵌入用非平衡熵最优传输（UOT）建模，UOT最优解可分离出传输项、耦合复杂度与边际质量变化。另设计成对感知残差（pair-aware residual），将观测到的图文对与UOT软匹配进行对比。在Flickr8K与COCO-1K上，使用冻结的CLIP、OpenCLIP、SigLIP编码器进行评测；并用UOT重心更新进行对照实验。
AI.result: 字幕退化使Flickr8K Recall@1从0.559降至0.003。在六个数据集-模型条件下，成对感知残差追踪检索退化，平均绝对Spearman为0.973，而均值间隔仅0.392。该关联在五个随机COCO-1K子集上稳定，为0.954±0.026（最小0.943）。UOT重心更新降低传输目标却使检索性能下降。
AI.conclusion: UOT-Gap可作为诊断工具，用于评估字幕质量、模态对齐及检索鲁棒性；结果区分了几何目标下降与任务改进，说明优化传输目标并不等价于提升检索性能。

title: $Φ$-Bench: Can Large Language Models Engineer the Infrastructure That Powers Them?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in reasoning and code generation, raising the prospect that they could assist in developing and optimizing the very infrastructure that powers them. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on isolated kernels, predefined operators, or pre-specified optimization targets, and therefore fail to evaluate the ability of LLMs to perform open-ended, long-horizon LLM infrastructure engineering. To address this gap, we present $Φ$-Bench, a benchmark for systematically evaluating LLMs on engineering the LLM infrastructure stack. Derived from optimization problems studied in frontier research and grounded in real-world code repositories, $Φ$-Bench provides broad coverage of the LLM infrastructure stack and spans tasks of varying complexity, ranging from localized kernel-level function completion to long-horizon implementation and end-to-end system optimization. Extensive experiments on frontier LLMs reveal their current capabilities and limitations in engineering complex LLM infrastructure, offering insights into the challenges that remain on the path toward autonomous optimization of future AI infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 提出 Φ-Bench，一个面向 LLM 基础设施栈工程能力的系统评测基准，覆盖从内核级函数补全到长程系统优化的多复杂度任务，实验揭示前沿 LLM 在复杂基础设施工程中的能力与局限。
AI.motivation: LLM 在推理与代码生成上表现优异，具备辅助开发与优化其自身底层基础设施的潜力；但现有基准多局限于孤立内核、预定义算子或预设优化目标，无法评估 LLM 进行开放式、长程 LLM 基础设施工程的能力。
AI.method: 构建 Φ-Bench 基准：问题源自前沿研究的优化问题，并基于真实代码仓库，覆盖 LLM 基础设施栈的广泛范围；任务复杂度分层，从局部化的内核级函数补全，到长程实现与端到端系统优化。
AI.result: 在前沿 LLM 上进行大量实验，揭示了它们当前在工程化复杂 LLM 基础设施方面的能力与局限。
AI.conclusion: Φ-Bench 填补了开放式、长程 LLM 基础设施工程评测的空白，并为未来 AI 基础设施自主优化路径上仍存的挑战提供了洞见。

title: Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for the Detection of Pathologies Related to Lung Cancer through Image Analysis using Convolutional Neural Networks and Data Augmentation: a systematic mapping of the literature
summary: Lung cancer is one of the leading causes of death worldwide, and its early diagnosis is crucial to improving patients prognosis and quality of life. However, the process of interpreting medical images for the detection of lung cancer is complex and requires trained experts. In this context, artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning (DL) emerge as potential tools to automate and optimize image analysis. The objective of this work is to review the most recent and relevant applications of AI and DL in the field of radiology for the detection of lung cancer. To this end, an exhaustive search was carried out in scientific databases such as PubMed,IEEEXPLORE, Scopus and Web of Science, and 96 articles published from 2015 to the present addressing the use of AI and DL in biomedical engineering were selected. Emphasis is placed on the use of convolutional neural networks (CNN) with transfer learning and Data Augmentation as promising techniques to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the image interpretation process. The results show that the use of AI and DL can offer an effective alternative for the early diagnosis of lung cancer, with high sensitivity and specificity. However, current limitations and challenges that must be addressed to guarantee its responsible and safe application in clinical practice are also identified, such as the lack of standardized data, the ex plainability of the models, patient privacy, and the ethical and social implications. It is concluded that the use of AI and DL can have a positive impact on the care of patients with lung cancer, but further research and regulation are required to ensure its quality and reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了2015年以来96篇文献中AI与深度学习在肺癌影像诊断中的应用，重点为CNN结合迁移学习和数据增强，结果显示其具有较高敏感性和特异性，但面临数据标准化、模型可解释性、隐私及伦理等挑战。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球主要致死原因之一，早期诊断对改善预后和生活质量至关重要。然而医学影像解读过程复杂且依赖受过训练的专家，因此需要借助AI和深度学习来自动化并优化影像分析。
AI.method: 在PubMed、IEEEXPLORE、Scopus和Web of Science等科学数据库中进行详尽检索，筛选出2015年至今发表的96篇探讨AI与深度学习在生物医学工程中应用的文献，进行综述性分析。
AI.result: 研究表明，卷积神经网络结合迁移学习和数据增强是提升影像解读准确性与效率的重要技术；AI与深度学习在肺癌早期诊断中可提供高敏感性和高特异性的有效替代方案，同时识别出数据缺乏标准化、模型可解释性不足、患者隐私以及伦理和社会影响等局限与挑战。
AI.conclusion: AI与深度学习可对肺癌患者诊疗产生积极影响，但需进一步研究和监管以保证其质量与可靠性，实现负责任且安全的临床应用。

title: The Answer Path and the Grounding Instruction in LLM Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs
summary: A graph retrieval-augmented generation pipeline chooses which triples to put in the prompt, a syntax to write them in, an order to write them in, and a sentence telling the model what to do with them. We vary all four over six large language models and two knowledge-graph question answering benchmarks. Two of the four choices move the answer and the other two are flat. The first is whether the answer path, the triples needed to reach the answer, is in the prompt at all. Holding the number of triples fixed and replacing every triple that is not on the chain with material from an unrelated entity changes answer accuracy by +0.003 F1, while removing the chain costs most of what the graph was worth. Retrieval budget belongs on recall, and precision in the range we can test buys nothing. There is no retriever here: subgraphs come from gold SPARQL, so precision describes the context we build, not a system setting. The second is the grounding instruction. With no facts in the prompt, telling a model to answer using only the provided facts drops F1 from 0.299 to 0.035, a factor of 8.63. That figure describes an evaluation with an empty context arm rather than a working pipeline, and an experiment that applies the instruction to its context arm but not to its no-context baseline manufactures a spurious finding that graph context hurts at depth. We found one in our own results and retract it. Syntax, triple order and subgraph size produce no effect we can measure at multi-hop depth. The comparison that would price the grounding instruction against correct context is not measurable with a format-sensitive scorer, because the instruction determines the response format; we report it as an open contrast rather than a number.

AI.tldr: 在图检索增强生成（Graph RAG）流水线中，四个可调选择里只有"答案路径是否在提示中"和"是否给出基于事实作答的指令"真正影响答案，语法、三元组顺序与子图规模在多跳深度上无可测效应。
AI.motivation: Graph RAG 流水线包含多个设计选择（选哪些三元组、怎么写、按什么顺序写、给什么执行指令），但先前研究缺乏对这些选择的系统分解，容易把无效变量当成影响因素，甚至因实验设计不对称而产生虚假结论。作者希望明确哪些选择真正影响准确率，并纠正自身及文献中的方法学错误。
AI.method: 在 6 个大型语言模型与 2 个知识图谱问答基准上，独立变动上述四个设计维度。子图由 gold SPARQL 生成而非检索器，故"精确率"描述的是所构建上下文而非系统配置。核心对照包括：固定三元组数量、将非答案链三元组替换为无关实体内容（+0.003 F1），以及移除答案链；并在空上下文与有上下文条件下分别施加 grounding 指令。
AI.result: 答案链是否存在于提示中是主导因素，移除它几乎损失图上下文的全部收益；用无关实体替换非链三元组仅带来 +0.003 F1，表明在可测范围内精确率几乎无增益，召回才是检索预算的着力点。grounding 指令效应巨大：无事实时的空上下文臂上，指令使 F1 从 0.299 降至 0.035（下降 8.63 倍）。语法、三元组顺序与子图规模在多跳深度上均未测出效应。
AI.conclusion: 图上下文的价值几乎全部来自答案链；检索预算应投在召回而非精确率；grounding 指令的破坏性数字来自空上下文评估臂，若只对上下文臂施加指令而对无上下文基线不施加，会人为制造"图上下文在深度上有害"的伪结论，作者据此撤回自身结果中的该发现。将 grounding 指令与正确上下文进行对照比较，因指令决定回答格式、格式敏感评分器无法兼容，只能作为开放式对照报告，暂不给出数值。

title: LiteRAG: Cost-Efficient Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Graph-based retrieval can improve multi-hop question answering, but existing approaches often incur high query-time costs and produce diffuse, oversized contexts that reduce generation efficiency. We present LiteRAG, a graph-based retrieval method that replaces expensive retrieval-time LLM control with query-conditioned algorithmic exploration and reasoning-chain context construction. On DistComp, a benchmark for multi-hop retrieval over distributed-systems papers, LiteRAG attains the highest overall quality among the evaluated methods (0.798) while reducing per-query latency by over 100$\times$ and cost by over 99% relative to GraphRAG Global and DRIFT. On UltraDomain, it matches LinearRAG on overall quality while using about 14$\times$ fewer tokens. An ablation study indicates that LiteRAG's query-adaptive thresholding and community-aware hub penalization are the main drivers of its token-efficiency gains.

AI.tldr: LiteRAG以查询条件化的算法探索与推理链上下文构建替代昂贵的检索时LLM控制，在多跳问答上实现高质量、低延迟、低成本与高令牌效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的检索虽能提升多跳问答，但查询时开销高，且生成的上下文弥散、体量过大，降低生成效率。
AI.method: 提出LiteRAG：用查询条件化的算法式探索与推理链上下文构建，取代检索阶段依赖LLM的控制；包含查询自适应阈值与社区感知的枢纽节点惩罚。
AI.result: 在DistComp上，LiteRAG总体质量最高（0.798），相比GraphRAG Global与DRIFT，单查询延迟降低100倍以上、成本降低99%以上；在UltraDomain上总体质量与LinearRAG持平，令牌用量约减少14倍。消融实验表明查询自适应阈值与社区感知枢纽惩罚是令牌效率提升的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: LiteRAG在保持或提升检索质量的同时，显著降低查询延迟、成本与上下文规模，验证了以算法探索替代检索时LLM控制的有效性。

title: Manifold Projection and Iterative Autoencoder Refinement for Masked Language Modeling
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computational Intelligence (TETCI)
summary: In Transformer-based masked language models, attention is the primary mechanism for context mixing, but there are other ways to mix data across tokens. Recent attention-free mixers replace attention with fixed or hypernetwork-generated MLPs, alternating their dynamic, content-dependent weighting for computational simplicity. We build an alternative that gets the same property from a low-rank bottleneck autoencoder. We replace attention with a stack of autoencoder-based mixing modules, one operating over local neighborhoods, one over the full sequence, and one across attention heads, each compressing and reconstructing its input through a bottleneck, and its width is a hyperparameter rather than a training effect. In masked positions, we introduce an iterative refinement procedure that has two distinct steps. A pulling step that pulls an embedding representation toward a weighted average of its neighbors, and a correcting step that projects the result back to the learned manifold via an autoencoder. Our architecture achieves a significant portion of attention's performance at about $1.9 \times$ fewer FLOPs when pretrained on C4 and evaluated with parameter-matched BERT baselines. Our model equals parameter-matched BERT and TinyBERT baselines on the rarest-token frequency bucket using a frequency-aware training schedule that samples rare tokens more than uniformly for the masking tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于低秩瓶颈自编码器的无注意力混合模块，替代Transformer中的注意力机制，并在掩码位置引入迭代精炼过程，以约1.9倍更少FLOPs达到接近注意力的性能。
AI.motivation: Transformer掩码语言模型中，注意力是主要的上下文混合机制，但存在其他跨token混合数据的方式。近期无注意力混合器用固定或超网络生成的MLP替代注意力，以提升计算简洁性，但本文希望从低秩瓶颈自编码器角度获得同样的动态、内容依赖的加权特性。
AI.method: 用一堆基于自编码器的混合模块替代注意力：分别作用于局部邻域、完整序列和跨注意力头；每个模块通过瓶颈压缩并重建输入，瓶颈宽度是超参数而非训练结果。在掩码位置引入迭代精炼：先通过“拉拽”步骤将嵌入表示拉向邻居的加权平均，再通过“校正”步骤用自编码器将结果投影回学习到的流形。
AI.result: 在C4上预训练并与参数匹配的BERT基线评估时，该架构以约1.9倍更少FLOPs达到注意力性能的显著部分；使用频率感知训练调度（对稀有token比均匀采样更多）后，在稀有token频率桶上达到与参数匹配的BERT和TinyBERT基线相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 低秩瓶颈自编码器混合模块可有效替代注意力，在显著降低计算量的同时保持竞争力；迭代精炼与频率感知训练有助于提升稀有token建模表现。

title: Two-Token Features and Small-Large Ensembles for VLM Hallucination Detection
summary: We present our system for the SHROOM-Visions 2026 shared task on character-level VLM hallucination detection. A small ($4$B-parameter) VLM is fine-tuned as a per-token classifier reading a two-token feature from its own hidden states, and is ensembled with a $\sim$400B zero-shot VLM judge at prediction time. Both components see off-the-shelf OCR of any visible in-image text. We use synthetic hallucination data generated by the large model as a source of ensemble diversity, and use validation to select feature layer, training data and OCR grounding. Our official entry reaches mean Cor $0.487$ / Cor-lbl $0.387$ on the hidden test set, placing $6$th/$28$ (EN), $6$th/$21$ (FR), $8$th/$21$ (IT) and $7$th/$22$ (ZH) on the task's primary Cor-lbl metric.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用于SHROOM-Visions 2026字符级VLM幻觉检测任务的系统：微调4B小模型作为逐token分类器，与约400B零样本VLM评判器集成，均使用现成OCR，官方成绩Cor 0.487 / Cor-lbl 0.387，多语言排名约6-8名。
AI.motivation: 针对字符级VLM幻觉检测任务，需要高精度定位视觉语言模型输出中与图像文本不符的字符，同时兼顾多语言（EN/FR/IT/ZH）场景下的检测性能。
AI.method: 将4B参数的小型VLM微调为逐token分类器，读取其自身隐状态中的两token特征；预测时与约400B参数的零样本VLM评判器进行集成；两组件均接收对图像中可见文本的现成OCR结果；用大模型生成的合成幻觉数据提供集成多样性，并通过验证集选择特征层、训练数据与OCR grounding。
AI.result: 官方提交在隐藏测试集上取得mean Cor 0.487 / Cor-lbl 0.387，在主要指标Cor-lbl上排名EN 6/28、FR 6/21、IT 8/21、ZH 7/22。
AI.conclusion: 通过小模型逐token分类与大模型零样本评判的集成，辅以OCR grounding与合成数据增强，可在字符级VLM幻觉检测任务中取得具有竞争力的多语言排名。

title: DiSCo: A Distribution-First Steering and Cultural Prior Evaluation Framework for Measuring Cultural Preference Bias in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in globally used assistants, yet their default choices in culturally grounded everyday situations can systematically favour some cultures over others, affecting localisation, user trust, and equitable behaviour. Existing cultural benchmarks evaluate accuracy against a single "correct" answer, making it difficult to characterise an LLM's cultural preference prior when multiple culturally grounded responses are all valid; they also conflate default preferences with context-driven adaptation. We propose DiSCo, a distribution-first forced-choice evaluation framework that isolates default cultural priors and tests steerability via a four-level context gradient (C0--C3). Using DiSCo-Bench (304 items) derived from BLEnD spanning 12 cultures, we evaluate six diverse instruction-tuned LLMs. Default priors are heavily concentrated, with UK and US together absorbing approximately 35\% of all selections despite representing only 2 of 12 cultures. Most critically, prompt-based steering consistently widens the selection gap between high- and low-resource cultures, and injecting explicit cultural facts produces negligible distributional disruption, confirming that cultural preference bias cannot be resolved through prompt-based personalisation alone.

AI.tldr: 提出分布优先的强制选择评测框架DiSCo，用四级上下文梯度隔离LLM的默认文化先验并检验可引导性；在覆盖12种文化的DiSCo-Bench上评测6个指令微调LLM，发现默认选择高度集中于英美文化，且提示式引导反而扩大高低资源文化间的选择差距。
AI.motivation: LLM广泛用于全球助手，但其在文化相关的日常情境中的默认选择会系统性偏向某些文化，影响本地化、用户信任与公平性。已有文化基准以单一"正确答案"衡量准确率，难以刻画多个文化有效回应并存时的文化偏好先验，且把默认偏好与上下文驱动的适应混为一谈。
AI.method: 提出DiSCo——分布优先的强制选择（forced-choice）评测框架，隔离默认文化先验并检验可引导性。设计四级上下文梯度（C0–C3），从无上下文到注入显式文化事实，逐步增加文化线索。基于BLEnD构建DiSCo-Bench（304个条目），覆盖12种文化，评测6个多样化的指令微调LLM。
AI.result: 默认文化先验高度集中：英国与美国合计约占全部选择的35%，而二者仅占12种文化中的2种。最关键的是，基于提示的引导（prompt-based steering）持续扩大高资源文化与低资源文化之间的选择差距；注入显式文化事实对选择分布的扰动可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠基于提示的个性化无法解决文化偏好偏差，需要超越提示层面的干预手段。DiSCo以分布视角提供了刻画文化先验与可引导性的评测范式。

title: When Fusion Fails: Corruption-Aware Rebalanced Fusion for Multi-Modal Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Multi-modal medical image segmentation leverages complementary diagnostic information, yet fusion can underperform single-modality baselines when spatially aligned inputs differ in quality. Here, "corruption" primarily denotes resolution-induced degradation rather than misalignment or complete modality absence, while synthetic noise is evaluated only as an auxiliary setting. We identify a critical optimization-inference inconsistency: degraded modalities can receive weak training updates yet substantially affect predictions, indicating active interference with fusion. We attribute this failure to resampling-induced feature corruption and optimization bias, where noisy features propagate through skip connections and encourage unreliable modality selection. We therefore propose CoReFuse-Med, a Corruption-aware Rebalanced Fusion framework that suppresses corruption during feature transmission and rebalances modality contributions during high-level fusion. Experiments on EPVS, BraTS, and WMH, including multiple Z-axis slice-retention ratios and an auxiliary noise test, demonstrate improved accuracy and robustness under modality-quality discrepancies. Our code is available at https://github.com/lrever/CoReFuse.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多模态医学图像分割中空间对齐但质量不一致的输入，提出Corruption-aware Rebalanced Fusion框架CoReFuse-Med，抑制特征传输中的损坏并重新平衡模态贡献，在EPVS、BraTS和WMH上提升了精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 多模态医学图像分割可利用互补诊断信息，但当空间对齐的输入质量不一致（主要由分辨率导致的退化引起）时，融合性能可能低于单模态基线。作者发现一个关键优化-推理不一致：退化模态训练更新弱却在推理中显著影响预测，即主动干扰融合。其归因于重采样引入的特征损坏与优化偏差——噪声特征经跳跃连接传播，导致不可靠的模态选择。
AI.method: 提出CoReFuse-Med，一种Corruption-aware Rebalanced Fusion框架：在特征传输阶段抑制损坏（阻断噪声特征经跳跃连接传播），并在高层融合阶段重新平衡各模态贡献。
AI.result: 在EPVS、BraTS和WMH数据集上，设置多个Z轴切片保留比例，并辅以噪声测试，结果显示在模态质量差异下精度与鲁棒性均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 面向质量不一致的多模态医学图像分割，需同时处理特征传输中的损坏抑制与融合阶段的模态贡献再平衡，才能缓解优化-推理不一致并提升鲁棒性。

title: KVShareArena: KV-Cache Reuse Across Contexts and Model Checkpoints
summary: Reusing key-value (KV) caches speeds up LLM inference by avoiding repeated computation on shared text. Standard prefix caching reuses a KV cache only when the LLM is the same and all preceding text is identical, but real workloads often break both conditions: RAG systems place different documents before the same one, agents with different system prompts read the same file or tool output, multi-agent workflows use specialized LLMs on shared material, and an updated model reads documents cached by its previous version. Because KV caches depend on both the preceding text and the model weights, direct reuse can reduce answer quality. Many methods repair or compress the reused cache, but each paper uses its own tasks, models, and cost measures, and existing benchmarks mainly test long-context processing or reuse of an unchanged prefix. We introduce KVShareArena, a benchmark and open evaluation framework for comparing them under the same conditions. KVShareArena has (1) reuse tests on 2,150 questions from three QA datasets, where the preceding text, the cache-writing LLM, or both change while the answering LLM and input stay fixed; (2) five dense and mixture-of-experts LLMs (4B-30B) and six LLM pairs where one version of an LLM reads caches written by another, for 33 model-dataset settings; (3) 11 repair and compression methods from six method classes; (4) four evaluation perspectives: answer quality, prefill computation, KV-cache memory, and latency; and (5) a common interface for adding new methods and an interactive leaderboard. Experiments yield two findings. First, both the quality loss from reuse and which repairs help depend on the LLM, even between two 8B models. Second, most repairs keep their quality when another LLM version wrote the cache, but a trained repair adapter loses quality in 12 of 18 pair-dataset tests. Code and data: https://github.com/xishi404/KVShare-Arena

AI.tldr: 提出KVShareArena基准，统一评测跨前缀与跨模型KV缓存复用方法，涵盖多模型、多方法及四维指标。
AI.motivation: 标准前缀缓存要求LLM相同且前缀完全一致，但RAG、多智能体、模型更新等真实场景会破坏这两个条件。现有修复/压缩方法各自为政，任务、模型、成本度量不统一，缺乏可比的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建KVShareArena基准与开放评测框架：(1) 基于3个QA数据集2150题的复用测试，变化前文、缓存写入LLM或两者，固定回答LLM与输入；(2) 5个4B-30B稠密与MoE模型及6组跨版本模型对，共33个模型-数据集设置；(3) 覆盖6类方法的11种修复与压缩方法；(4) 从答案质量、预填计算、KV缓存内存、延迟四方面评测；(5) 提供统一接口与交互式排行榜。
AI.result: 两项发现：一是复用导致的质量损失及哪些修复有效依赖于LLM，即便同为8B模型也存在差异；二是多数修复方法在另一LLM版本写入缓存时能保持质量，但训练式修复适配器在18个模型对-数据集测试中有12个质量下降。
AI.conclusion: KVShareArena为跨前缀、跨模型KV缓存复用提供了统一可比的评测平台，揭示了修复效果对模型的强依赖性及跨版本适配的脆弱性。

title: FreqFLD: Towards All-in-One Facial Landmark Detection via Frequency Modulation
summary: Recent progress in deep learning has significantly advanced facial landmark detection. However, most existing methods process features in a spatial-domain manner under a dataset-specific training paradigm, which overlooks the fact that facial landmark detection is inherently geometry-driven and sensitive to frequency variations, thereby limiting cross-dataset generalization under complex scenarios and hindering the development of a facial landmark detection model. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{FreqFLD}, a \textbf{freq}uency-modulated framework towards All-in-One \textbf{f}acial \textbf{l}andmark \textbf{d}etection. Specifically, FreqFLD introduces a Frequency Modulation Module (FreqMoM) to explicitly induce the frequency prior by decoupling and modulating low- and high-frequency components, which is then injected into subsequent feature modeling to enable balanced modeling of global facial structure and local landmark details. Furthermore, FreqFLD employs a Frequency-Modulated Mixture-of-Experts (FreqMoE), with expert selection adaptively conditioned on frequency-modulated priors, enabling flexible modeling of heterogeneous facial landmark patterns under diverse and challenging scenarios. To regularize frequency-consistent modeling under the All-in-One paradigm, we further introduce a Frequency-Consistent Routing (FreqCR) loss, which constrains the routing and assignment of frequency-aware experts to promote balanced expert utilization across diverse facial scenarios, thereby enabling stable expert specialization and achieving robust facial landmark detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed FreqFLD achieves comparable performance on popular datasets. The code is available at: https://github.com/jkj1059657014/FreqFLD.

AI.tldr: 提出FreqFLD频率调制框架，通过频域先验实现All-in-One人脸关键点检测，提升跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有人脸关键点检测方法多采用空间域特征处理与数据集特定训练范式，忽略了该任务本质上是几何驱动的且对频率变化敏感，导致复杂场景下跨数据集泛化能力受限，难以构建统一的检测模型。
AI.method: 1) 频率调制模块(FreqMoM)：通过解耦并调制低频与高频分量显式引入频率先验，注入后续特征建模，平衡全局人脸结构与局部关键点细节建模；2) 频率调制混合专家(FreqMoE)：专家选择以频率调制先验为条件自适应进行，灵活建模多样挑战场景下的异构关键点模式；3) 频率一致性路由损失(FreqCR)：约束频率感知专家的路由与分配，促进跨场景专家利用均衡，实现稳定专家特化。
AI.result: 在主流数据集上取得具有竞争力的性能表现，验证了框架在All-in-One范式下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 频率调制范式可有效兼顾全局结构与局部细节，并通过一致性路由实现稳健的跨数据集人脸关键点检测，为统一模型提供新思路。代码已开源。

title: Isotropic Embedding Perturbations for Robust Vision Language Encoders
summary: Data augmentation is fundamental to training modern deep vision and multimodal models. While individual methods, such as RandAug, CutMix, Mixup, RandErase, and DropPath, offer strong regularization effects, their combined use has saturated in performance due to overlapping functionalities, and aggressive pixel-level manipulations may disrupt delicate cross-modal alignment. This saturation motivates the search for a new augmentation axis within the embedding space rather than the input space. We introduce Aether, a simple plug-in method that applies diffusion-style random perturbations in the embedding space via controlled alpha-mixing, specifically designed to provide isotropic regularization that remains semantically consistent. Inspired by feature-space perturbations in language models and image degradation in generative pretraining, Aether induces mild yet effective perturbations that smooth the representations without compromising the fine-grained structural information required for strong vision-language encoders. Across diverse architectures and across multiple recognition tasks, Aether delivers consistent gains over the advanced recipe combining CutMix, Mixup, DropPath, and RandAug---a level of improvement rarely observed with modern augmentation alternatives. Notably, Aether demonstrates superior effectiveness in multi-modal alignment, succeeding where traditional pixel-space augmentations fail by providing a stable, isotropic regularization signal that respects the integrity of the high-dimensional feature space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Aether——一种在嵌入空间施加扩散式随机扰动的即插即用增强方法，通过受控 alpha 混合实现各向同性正则化，在多架构、多识别任务上稳定优于 CutMix+Mixup+DropPath+RandAug 组合，并更适配多模态对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有数据增强方法（RandAug、CutMix、Mixup、RandErase、DropPath）单独使用虽具强正则效果，但功能重叠导致组合后性能饱和；且激进的像素级操作会破坏跨模态的精细对齐，因此需要从输入空间转向嵌入空间寻找新的增强维度。
AI.method: Aether 是一种简单的即插即用方法，在嵌入空间中通过受控 alpha 混合施加扩散式随机扰动，产生各向同性的正则化信号；其灵感来自语言模型中的特征空间扰动与生成式预训练中的图像退化，扰动温和但有效，可在平滑表示的同时保留强视觉-语言编码器所需的细粒度结构信息。
AI.result: 在多种架构与多个识别任务上，Aether 相对 CutMix、Mixup、DropPath 与 RandAug 组合的先进配方取得一致提升，此类提升在现代增强替代方案中较为罕见；在多模态对齐方面效果尤为突出，弥补了传统像素空间增强的失效。
AI.conclusion: 从输入空间转向嵌入空间的增强是突破当前性能饱和的有效方向；Aether 通过提供稳定、各向同性且语义一致的正则化信号，保护了高维特征空间完整性，从而在多模态对齐上优于像素空间增强方法。

title: GANDR: Claim Auditing for Verifiable Legal Answer Generation
summary: In high-stakes domains such as legal practice, a language-model answer is only useful to the extent that a reader can verify each claim against the source the system cites. Current grounded-generation pipelines score the answer as a whole, so a correct conclusion can rest on fabricated or loosely matched citations and still score well. Closing this gap requires both a system built for per-claim verification and an evaluation that measures it. We introduce GANDR (Grounded ANswer DRafter), a two-agent system in which a Drafter writes an answer in a structured legal-reasoning format and a separate Critic, with the same view as a human verifier, audits each claim against its cited source and emits a per-claim audit trace on every round. We pair it with a strict correctness criterion requiring every citation to resolve to a passage the retriever returned. On a 185-item legal benchmark where all six systems share one backbone, one retrieval surface, and one citation instruction, GANDR ranks first on every primary metric, reaching 70.8% strict accuracy and leading the strongest baseline by 11.3 points (p<0.01). Reverting the protocol-anchored commit rule lowers strict accuracy by 22.7 points, and the strict lead stays positive on three further backbones, at +3.2 to +6.5 points. This lead traces to the Drafter configuration and the protocol-anchored commit, not to rewriting. Against two law-trained annotators the audit flags under-supported claims at F1 0.84 as a binary detector, while its four-way verdict labels agree only weakly and are advisory. Code is available upon request.

AI.tldr: 提出 GANDR 双智能体系统（Drafter + Critic），实现逐条主张的可验证接地生成，并配套严格正确性判据；在法律基准上全面领先基线，且审计模块可高 F1 识别支撑不足的主张。
AI.motivation: 高利害领域（如法律实践）中，答案的可用性取决于读者能否逐条核实主张与所引来源是否一致。现有接地生成流程对整篇答案打分，导致结论正确但引用伪造或弱匹配的答案仍可获高分，缺乏逐主张验证的系统与相应评测。
