AI.method: GANDR（Grounded ANswer DRafter）为双智能体架构：Drafter 以结构化法律推理格式撰写答案；独立 Critic 拥有与人类核验者相同的视图，逐条审计主张与其引用来源的对应关系，并在每一轮输出逐主张审计轨迹。同时引入严格正确性判据：每条引用必须解析到检索器实际返回的段落。评测在 185 条法律基准上进行，六个系统共享同一骨干、同一检索接口与同一引用指令；并做消融（回退基于协议锚定的提交规则）与跨骨干验证，另由两名受过法律训练的标注者评估审计模块。
AI.result: GANDR 在所有主要指标上排名第一，严格准确率达 70.8%，领先最强基线 11.3 个百分点（p<0.01）。回退协议锚定提交规则使严格准确率下降 22.7 个百分点；在另外三个骨干上仍保持正向领先，幅度为 +3.2 至 +6.5 个百分点。该优势来自 Drafter 配置与协议锚定提交，而非文本改写。审计模块作为二元检测器识别支撑不足主张达 F1 0.84，但其四分类裁决标签一致性较弱，仅作参考建议。
AI.conclusion: 逐主张验证需要与之匹配的系统设计与评测标准；GANDR 通过 Drafter–Critic 分工、协议锚定提交与严格引用判据，在法律场景中显著提升可验证准确性，且增益来源可归因、跨骨干稳健。审计轨迹在二元"支撑/未支撑"判定上实用，细粒度裁决标签则仅供辅助参考。

title: The Semantic Bottleneck: Leveraging Semantic Representations for Non-Invasive Speech Decoding
summary: Non-invasive speech decoding remains constrained by the low signal-to-noise ratio of neural recordings, which makes fine-grained reconstruction of phonemes or individual words difficult. Motivated by neuroscientific evidence that high-level semantic representations are distributed across cortical regions and evolve over slower temporal scales, we hypothesize that semantic content may provide a more suitable target for non-invasive decoding than low-level acoustic or lexical features. We introduce Brain2Semantics2Text, a method that reconstructs text through an intermediate semantic embedding space. Our model maps sentence-level MEG responses into a semantic manifold and then inverts the predicted embeddings into natural language. This semantic bottleneck enables recovery of high-level meaning without word-level alignment. We describe the core principles of the approach, its implementation, and the strategies used to mitigate the challenges of learning a reliable neural-to-semantic mapping. Finally, we compare against prior non-invasive Brain2Text methods and show improved sentence-level results.

AI.tldr: 提出Brain2Semantics2Text方法，通过中间语义嵌入空间实现非侵入式脑信号到文本的重建，绕过词级对齐并提升句子级解码效果。
AI.motivation: 非侵入式神经记录信噪比低，导致音素或单个词的细粒度重建困难。基于高层语义表征跨皮层分布且演化时间尺度较慢的神经科学证据，作者假设语义内容比低层声学或词汇特征更适合作为非侵入式解码的目标。
AI.method: Brain2Semantics2Text：将句子级MEG响应映射到语义流形，再将预测的语义嵌入反演为自然语言，构建语义瓶颈。文中阐述该方法的核心原理、实现方式，以及缓解学习可靠神经-语义映射难题的策略。
AI.result: 与先前的非侵入式Brain2Text方法相比，该方法在句子级结果上取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 语义瓶颈无需词级对齐即可恢复高层含义，表明语义表征可作为非侵入式语音解码的有效中间目标。

title: TRACE: Trajectory-robust Admission with Evidence Ordering for Efficient GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents accumulate high-resolution screenshots as the trajectory unfolds, increasing inference latency and memory usage. Training-free visual token pruning can reduce this cost, but cache reuse introduces a fundamental constraint. Once tokens are discarded, the corresponding visual evidence cannot be recovered without re-encoding. Pruning therefore becomes an \textit{irreversible admission decision} that must remain useful for unknown future targets while preserving coverage of operable regions under tight budgets. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{\method{}}, a training-free framework for \emph{\textbf{T}rajectory-\textbf{r}obust \textbf{A}dmission and \textbf{C}overage-aware \textbf{E}vidence ordering}. Specifically, we combine a query-independent layout-derived interaction prior with instruction relevance and feature novelty to rank visual evidence according to both potential future utility and diversity. Then, we reserve part of the budget for native visual tokens distributed across the screen, repairing missing spatial coverage without breaking the ordering. Together, these mechanisms produce a nested token order, allowing retained visual evidence to shrink monotonically across budgets while remaining reusable throughout the trajectory. Finally, our monotone KV contraction incrementally contracts retired frames into compact session state, avoiding repeated visual encoding or pruning. Extensive experiments across six GUI benchmarks and diverse models verify the effectiveness of our proposed \method{} under tight budgets. The source code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架TRACE，通过轨迹鲁棒的准入与覆盖感知证据排序，解决GUI智能体视觉token剪枝的不可逆性问题。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体随轨迹累积高分辨率截图，导致推理延迟与内存开销上升。免训练视觉token剪枝可降低成本，但缓存复用带来根本约束：token一旦丢弃便无法恢复对应视觉证据（除非重新编码），因此剪枝成为不可逆的"准入决策"，必须在紧张预算下对未知未来目标仍具效用，并保持可操作区域的覆盖。
AI.method: TRACE为免训练框架，结合与查询无关的布局衍生交互先验、指令相关性和特征新颖度，依据潜在未来效用与多样性对视觉证据排序；随后预留部分预算给全屏分布的原生视觉token，在不破坏排序的前提下修复空间覆盖缺口；上述机制形成嵌套token顺序，使保留证据能随预算单调收缩且整条轨迹可复用；最后用单调KV收缩将退役帧增量式压缩为紧凑会话状态，避免重复视觉编码或剪枝。
AI.result: 在六个GUI基准和多种模型上的大量实验验证了TRACE在紧张预算下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过嵌套排序、覆盖修复与单调KV收缩，在免训练条件下实现轨迹鲁棒、可随预算单调收缩且可复用的视觉token剪枝，有效缓解GUI智能体的推理延迟与内存开销。

title: SynThermFace: Amplifying Limited Paired Data for Visible-Thermal Face Recognition via Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Face recognition (FR) is a widely used modality for biometric authentication, but conventional models rely on visible-spectrum imagery and degrade when high-quality RGB images cannot be captured. Cross-spectral face recognition addresses this limitation by matching visible images with other modalities such as thermal imagery, enabling more reliable performance in low-light, nighttime, and unconstrained conditions. However, progress is limited by the scarcity of paired visible-thermal data, which is difficult and costly to collect at scale. We propose SynThermFace, a framework that amplifies limited real visible-thermal supervision into larger paired adaptation datasets for cross-spectral face recognition. A diffusion model is first adapted using a limited set of paired visible--thermal images and then used to generate large-scale paired visible--synthetic thermal data from existing real or synthetic visible face datasets. The generated pairs are used to adapt a pretrained visible-spectrum face recognition model into a CFR model. Unlike synthesis-based approaches that require image translation at test time, the proposed method shifts generation to the training stage and performs inference with a single forward pass through the adapted recognition model. Under the same MCXFace real-pair protocol, PACT improves over the evaluated CFR adaptation baselines, isolating the effect of the proposed adaptation objective. Training PACT on larger generated paired datasets provides additional improvements over both the unadapted model and the real-pair PACT configuration. Cross-database evaluation on the Tufts dataset provides evidence that the learned representation transfers to an unseen database. The source code and trained models will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 SynThermFace/PACT 框架，用扩散模型将有限真实可见光-热红外配对数据放大为大规模配对合成数据集，把生成前移到训练阶段，从而将可见光人脸识别模型适配为跨光谱模型，推理仅需单次前向传播。
AI.motivation: 跨光谱人脸识别（CFR）可缓解可见光模型在低光、夜间等条件下性能退化的问题，但配对可见光-热红外数据稀缺、采集成本高，成为该方向进展的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 先用少量真实配对可见光-热红外图像适配一个扩散模型；再利用该模型从已有的真实或合成可见光人脸数据集生成大规模配对的可见光-合成热红外数据；用这些生成配对数据将预训练的可见光人脸识别模型适配为 CFR 模型。与需在测试时做图像翻译的合成类方法不同，该方法把生成过程移至训练阶段，推理时仅通过适配模型一次前向传播完成。
AI.result: 在相同的 MCXFace 真实配对协议下，PACT 优于所评估的 CFR 适配基线，证实了所提适配目标本身的增益；在更大规模生成配对数据上训练 PACT，相比未适配模型和真实配对配置的 PACT 均有进一步提升；在 Tufts 数据集上的跨库评估表明所学表征可迁移到未见数据库。
AI.conclusion: 通过扩散模型合成配对热红外数据来放大有限的真实监督信号，可有效将可见光人脸识别模型适配为跨光谱模型，并在同库与跨库评测中均取得提升；源代码与训练好的模型将公开。

title: RiLM: Parameter-Efficient Language Modeling via Geodesic Decoding
summary: Language models under one million parameters matter for edge deployment, domain adaptation, and reproducible research, yet a two-layer LSTM or Transformer at embedding width d = 128 still spends roughly one third of its capacity on the output matrix W_out in R^(d x |V|). We propose Riemannian Language Models (RiLM), which remove that layer entirely: context unfolds as a trajectory on a Riemannian manifold, and next-token probabilities arise from squared geodesic distance between the current state and vocabulary embeddings. The same embedding map serves input and output -- decoding is geometry. We instantiate the framework on flat R^d (Flat RiLM) and the Poincare ball H^d (HypRiLM) with a shared MLP composition map phi (~290k parameters, d = 128, |V| = 2000). Across five seeds on WikiText-2, HypRiLM reaches 54.2 +/- 0.2 validation perplexity versus 87.6 +/- 0.6 for Flat RiLM; tied and matched LSTM, Transformer, and SSM controls remain at 113-147 PPL on WT-2 -- HypRiLM leads by roughly 2x over the strongest tied recurrent baseline (SSM, 113.0 +/- 3.8). Penn Treebank and a 10k-vocabulary stress test confirm that geodesic decoding transfers across corpora and larger |V|, while hyperbolic curvature helps selectively. We also characterize boundary collapse in naive hyperbolic recurrence and show how Mobius stabilization restores trainability. Claims are scoped to controlled small-model comparisons, not full-vocabulary state of the art.

AI.tldr: 提出Riemannian Language Models (RiLM)，取消输出矩阵W_out，将下一词概率建模为状态与词表嵌入间的测地距离平方；在Poincaré球上的HypRiLM于WT-2取得54.2 PPL，较最优tied循环基线(SSM, 113.0)约领先2倍。
AI.motivation: 百万参数以下的语言模型对边缘部署、领域适配与可复现研究有重要意义，但即便d=128的两层LSTM或Transformer，仍有约三分之一容量耗费在输出矩阵W_out ∈ R^(d×|V|)上，参数冗余严重。作者希望彻底移除该输出层，实现输入输出共享同一嵌入映射，以提升小模型参数效率。
AI.method: 提出RiLM框架：上下文在黎曼流形上展开为轨迹，下一词概率由当前状态与词表嵌入之间的测地距离平方给出，解码即几何。在平坦R^d上实例化为Flat RiLM，在Poincaré球H^d上实例化为HypRiLM，二者共享MLP组合映射phi（约290k参数，d=128，|V|=2000）。针对朴素双曲递归中的边界坍塌问题，采用Möbius stabilization恢复可训练性。
AI.result: WikiText-2五个随机种子下，HypRiLM验证困惑度54.2±0.2，显著优于Flat RiLM的87.6±0.6；参数量对齐的tied LSTM、Transformer与SSM基线仍停留在113–147 PPL，HypRiLM约为最强tied循环基线（SSM，113.0±3.8）的2倍优势。Penn Treebank及10k词表压力测试表明测地解码可跨语料与更大|V|迁移，双曲曲率带来选择性增益。
AI.conclusion: 测地解码可在不设输出矩阵的情况下有效建模语言，双曲几何在小模型区间具有明显优势，并可通过Möbius stabilization缓解边界坍塌。结论限定于受控的小模型对比，不代表全词表规模的SOTA。

title: View-Structured Conformal Prediction for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders novel views in real time, but an uncertainty heatmap does not certify that a rendered view meets a certain prediction coverage. We treat novel-view synthesis as structured regression and ask that, with probability at least $1-α$, RGB prediction boxes cover at least a $1-β$ fraction of pixels in a new view. We propose View-Structured Conformal Prediction (VSCP). It splits the pre-calibration scale into a spatial shape from the renderer and a transferable view-difficulty factor, which predicts the smallest view-wise multiplier that shape needs. A held-out quantile over views (View-CP) then gives finite-sample validity even when transferring to new scenes. The same factorization makes the analysis exact: a conformity score is the ratio of oracle to predicted view difficulty, and excess width separates into a test-side and a calibration-side term. Across 13 real scenes, pixel-pooled calibration reaches 89.9\% marginal pixel coverage but only 61.4\% view-event coverage at a 90\% target, while View-CP reaches 91.7--92.0\%. At matched coverage VSCP cuts width by 22.1\% against a constant scale, and matches a ten-model ensemble's 21.0\% reduction using only one model per scene and four rather than ten rasterization passes per query. VSCP also improves on the closest single-model baseline, the 3DGS-U field, by 4.7 points ($p=0.0225$). The view predictor transfers from bounded source families to all nine unbounded Mip-NeRF~360 scenes. There the full scale beats the constant scale with 20.7\% width saving on all nine scenes. It also keeps an 18.3\% saving under a different densification backbone and runs at 216--280 FPS on an RTX~4090.

AI.tldr: 提出View-Structured Conformal Prediction (VSCP)，将新视角合成视为结构化回归，通过分解尺度与视图级共形分位数，实现具有有限样本有效性的视图级覆盖保证，显著优于像素池化校准。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯溅射(3DGS)能实时渲染新视角，但其不确定性热图无法保证渲染视图满足特定的预测覆盖率。作者希望在新视角合成中实现具有统计保证的覆盖率：以至少1-α的概率，RGB预测框覆盖新视图中至少1-β比例的像素。
AI.method: 将预校准尺度分解为来自渲染器的空间形状和可迁移的视图难度因子，后者预测形状所需的最小视图级乘子。采用视图级留出分位数(View-CP)提供有限样本有效性，即使迁移到新场景也成立。该分解使分析精确：一致性分数为oracle与预测视图难度之比，超额宽度可分离为测试侧和校准侧两项。
AI.result: 在13个真实场景中，像素池化校准在90%目标下达到89.9%边际像素覆盖率但视图事件覆盖率仅61.4%，而View-CP达到91.7–92.0%。在相同覆盖率下，VSCP相比常数尺度缩减宽度22.1%，仅用单模型和4次光栅化（对比十模型集成的10次）达到其21.0%的缩减；优于最接近的单模型基线3DGS-U场4.7个百分点(p=0.0225)。视图预测器从有界源族迁移到全部9个无界Mip-NeRF 360场景，完整尺度在全部9个场景上实现20.7%宽度节省，在不同致密化骨干下仍保持18.3%节省，在RTX 4090上以216–280 FPS运行。
AI.conclusion: VSCP为3DGS新视角合成提供了具有有限样本有效性的视图级覆盖保证，通过尺度分解和视图级共形分位数实现了更窄的预测区间、更强的跨场景迁移能力和实时性能，避免了像素池化校准在视图事件覆盖率上的严重不足。

title: One Loop, Two Gains: Can Active Learning win the Lottery for Free?
summary: The lottery ticket hypothesis posits the existence of winning tickets: sparse subnetworks that, when trained in isolation from their original initialization, match the accuracy of the full dense network. The predominant method for discovering such tickets, iterative magnitude pruning, alternates pruning with full retraining from scratch until convergence over many cycles. Similarly, deep active learning also retrains a model from scratch after each acquisition round as new labels become available. Despite this shared reliance on iterative retraining with a substantial computational overhead, the two paradigms have been studied separately. We observe that the iterative training loop inherent to pool-based active learning already provides the exact computational structure that iterative magnitude pruning exploits, and propose Improve & Prune (I&P), a method that integrates magnitude pruning into each active learning retraining cycle at practically no additional cost. This raises a key empirical question: can iterative magnitude pruning produce winning tickets under the non-stationary data regime of active learning? We investigate this question across multiple acquisition functions, architecture families, and image classification datasets, including an active fine-tuning scenario. Our results demonstrate that I&P yields sparse, deployable models at each active learning iteration. Those match the accuracy of their dense counterparts at sparsities up to 95%, effectively obtaining winning tickets as a byproduct of the active learning pipeline. These per-iteration sparse models can address two computational bottlenecks - per-round model retraining and acquisition scoring over the unlabeled pool - that currently prevent the practical adoption of DAL on large architectures and large unlabeled pools.

AI.tldr: 本文将迭代幅度剪枝（IMP）融入主动学习的每轮重训练循环，提出 Improve & Prune（I&P），在不增加额外成本的前提下获得稀疏可部署模型，在高达95%稀疏度下匹配稠密模型精度，相当于把中奖彩票作为主动学习流程的副产品。
AI.motivation: 中奖彩票假说（LTH）与深度主动学习（DAL）都依赖"迭代重训练"这一计算代价高昂的范式，但此前被分别研究。作者观察到基于池的主动学习的迭代训练循环恰好提供了IMP所需的计算结构，由此提出核心经验问题：在主动学习这种非平稳数据分布下，迭代幅度剪枝能否依然产生中奖彩票？
AI.method: 提出 Improve & Prune（I&P）：在每个主动学习重训练周期中集成幅度剪枝，几乎不产生额外计算开销。在多种采集函数（acquisition functions）、多种架构家族、多类图像分类数据集上验证，并包含一个主动微调（active fine-tuning）场景。
AI.result: I&P 在主动学习的每一次迭代都能产出稀疏且可部署的模型，这些模型在稀疏度高达95%时仍能匹配其稠密对应模型的精度，即把中奖彩票作为主动学习流程的副产品获得。所得逐轮稀疏模型可缓解两个计算瓶颈：每轮模型重训练，以及在无标注池上的采集打分。
AI.conclusion: 迭代幅度剪枝能够在主动学习的非平稳数据机制下产生中奖彩票，将剪枝与主动学习统一在单次迭代循环中，为在大规模架构与大无标注池上实际采用深度主动学习提供了可行路径。

title: Decoupled Self-Forcing Distillation for Streaming Talking Head Generation
summary: Streaming talking-head generation produces each frame as its driving audio arrives, yet fidelity and efficiency have so far pulled in opposite directions: end-to-end methods condition a video diffusion model on audio directly and achieve high quality but only at large scale, while cheaper two-stage methods generate an intermediate motion representation and trail in fidelity. We argue the cost of the former lies in the target of fusion: the video latent is dominated by identity, appearance and background, none of which audio bears on, so coupling audio to every pixel blurs detail and wastes capacity. We instead fuse conditions in a low-dimensional identity-disentangled motion space, routing audio and motion captions by their temporal granularity, and generate motion latents with a small causal autoregressive transformer that a pretrained diffusion renderer turns into video. Conditions thus control video transitively, and high fidelity no longer requires a large backbone. Streaming this decomposition needs both models to be causal, and the exposure-bias problem could be solved by self-forcing given a bidirectional teacher. But there is no such teacher in motion space. Our decoupled self-forcing distillation resolves both models under one frozen teacher: conditioned on motion, it distills the renderer into a block-causal student; unconditionally, it scores rendered rollouts against real videos, supervising motion by the video it produces. This lifts the fidelity ceiling from the motion generator onto the stronger renderer. The two models run as parallel causal streams, reaching 15.4 FPS at 1.3 s latency with no quality degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在低维、身份解耦的运动空间中融合条件，用小规模因果自回归Transformer生成运动潜变量，再由预训练扩散渲染器转为视频，并通过解耦自强制蒸馏同时训练两个模型，实现高保真、实时的流式说话头生成。
AI.motivation: 流式说话头生成中，保真度与效率长期对立：端到端方法直接用音频条件化视频扩散模型，质量高但规模大；两阶段方法较廉价，先产生中间运动表示，但保真度落后。作者认为前者的代价源于融合目标——视频潜变量被身份、外观和背景主导，而音频与这些无关，因此将音频耦合到每个像素会模糊细节并浪费容量。
AI.method: 提出在低维、身份解耦的运动空间中融合条件，按时间粒度路由音频与运动描述，并用小型因果自回归Transformer生成运动潜变量，再由预训练扩散渲染器生成视频。为使该分解可流式运行，要求两个模型均为因果；针对暴露偏差问题，提出解耦自强制蒸馏：在冻结教师下，条件于运动将渲染器蒸馏为块因果学生；无条件地对渲染出的rollout与真实视频打分，从而以其产生的视频监督运动生成。两个模型作为并行因果流运行。
AI.result: 将保真度上限从运动生成器提升到更强的渲染器，两个模型以并行因果流运行，达到15.4 FPS、1.3 s延迟，且无质量退化。
AI.conclusion: 通过在身份解耦的运动空间中进行条件融合，并采用解耦自强制蒸馏，可在无需大规模骨干网络的条件下实现高保真、低延迟的流式说话头生成。

title: On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Model Adaptation, an Effective Paradigm on Low-Quality Multimodal Data
summary: Knowledge distillation offers an efficient route to transfer a task-adapted vision-language teacher to a compact student. The training target in current vision-language distillation methods is typically constructed from the teacher prediction and applied uniformly to all training samples, making it unreliable under class and domain shifts. In this paper, we argue that distillation target construction should be treated as a dynamic training decision rather than a fixed recipe. To this end, we propose OnPoKD, an on-policy distillation framework for vision-language model adaptation. To the best of our knowledge, OnPoKD is the first framework that applies on-policy distillation to vision-language model adaptation by learning target construction as a policy decision. OnPoKD learns a lightweight controller that constructs sample-wise adaptive targets using reliability and disagreement cues from the teacher model, student model, and zero-shot prior. Instead of relying on a fixed teacher prediction, the controller dynamically balances teacher supervision, zero-shot prior guidance, and hard-label anchoring through bounded policy actions, allowing the distillation target to adapt to varying sample reliability and training stages. The policy controller is updated with validation feedback, encouraging target construction to optimize transferability rather than merely fitting the training distribution. Since the controller is only used during training, OnPoKD can be seamlessly integrated into existing vision-language distillation pipelines while preserving the original inference architecture and test-time cost. Extensive experiments on Base-to-novel generalization and Cross-dataset transfer benchmarks show that OnPoKD consistently improves over strong vision-language distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出OnPoKD，将视觉-语言模型蒸馏的目标构建视为动态策略决策，学习轻量控制器自适应生成样本级蒸馏目标，提升泛化与迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉-语言蒸馏方法通常用教师预测构建训练目标，并对所有样本统一应用，在类别偏移和域偏移下不可靠，忽视样本可靠性差异与训练阶段变化。
AI.method: 提出OnPoKD，首个将on-policy蒸馏用于视觉-语言模型适配的框架：学习轻量策略控制器，利用教师、学生与零样本先验的可靠性和分歧线索，通过有界策略动作动态平衡教师监督、零样本先验引导与硬标签锚定；控制器用验证反馈更新，仅训练时使用，不改变推理结构与测试开销。
AI.result: 在Base-to-novel泛化与Cross-dataset迁移基准上，OnPoKD持续优于强视觉-语言蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏目标构建应视为动态训练决策而非固定配方；OnPoKD可无缝集成现有蒸馏流程，在保持推理成本的同时提升迁移与泛化能力。

title: Geometry Without Coordinates: LiDAR Diffusion as a 3D Feature Bridge
summary: Transferring the rich priors of large 2D foundation models to sparse 3D LiDAR remains challenging, as training native 3D foundation models at comparable scale is limited by data and annotation scarcity. We introduce a LiDAR-conditioned diffusion model trained on pseudo-labels from off-the-shelf 2D foundation models. The model supports multiple output modalities, including depth, semantic segmentation and instance prediction, selectable via a textual task prompt. Because the model is conditioned on LiDAR, both its outputs and its intermediate UNet features can be projected back onto the input point cloud, enabling analysis of a 3D representation learned entirely under 2D supervision. We study this representation directly in point-cloud space, explicitly excluding raw spatial coordinates to isolate feature content from projection geometry. Linear probes recover up to ~23% Mean Intersection over Union (MIoU) on 3D semantic classes, compared to ~3.5% for a matched Gaussian-noise control, indicating substantial non-trivial structure. Pairwise cosine similarity across modality-specific feature streams reveals a layered organization. Early encoder layers remain weakly aligned across modalities while individually decodable, intermediate layers converge toward a shared representation, and decoder layers re-specialize toward task-specific outputs. These findings indicate that LiDAR-conditioned diffusion models can induce structured 3D representations from 2D supervision alone, with a modality-dependent manifold that locally unifies near a shared bottleneck. This positions diffusion as a viable mechanism for transferring large-scale 2D priors into sparse 3D domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以LiDAR为条件的扩散模型，仅用现成2D基础模型生成的伪标签训练，即可在多任务输出下学到具有非平凡语义结构的3D点云表征。
AI.motivation: 将大规模2D基础模型的丰富先验迁移到稀疏3D LiDAR颇具挑战：原生3D基础模型的规模化训练受限于数据与标注稀缺。作者希望探索能否在完全2D监督下，经由扩散机制获得有效的3D表征，并直接分析该表征的空间结构。
AI.method: 训练一个以LiDAR点云为条件的扩散模型，监督信号来自现成2D基础模型的伪标签；支持深度、语义分割、实例预测等多种输出，由文本任务提示选择。由于以LiDAR为条件，模型输出与中间UNet特征均可反投影回输入点云。分析在点云空间直接进行，显式剔除原始空间坐标，以将特征内容与投影几何解耦。采用线性探测评估3D语义类别，并以匹配的高斯噪声对照；用模态特定特征流之间的成对余弦相似度刻画层间组织。
AI.result: 线性探测在3D语义类别上取得约23% MIoU，而匹配高斯噪声对照仅约3.5%，说明所学表征具有显著的非平凡结构。成对余弦相似度揭示出分层组织：编码器浅层跨模态对齐弱但各自可解码；中间层收敛到共享表征；解码器层重新特化为任务相关输出。
AI.conclusion: LiDAR条件扩散模型能够仅凭2D监督诱导出结构化的3D表征，其模态相关流形在共享瓶颈附近局部统一。这表明扩散可作为将大规模2D先验迁移到稀疏3D域的有效机制。

title: Reliable Egocentric Action Anticipation via Temporal Reliability Suppression and Compositional Graph Decoding
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Towards Real-time Multimodal Contextual Assistants (Wearable AI Workshop)
summary: Wearable action anticipation systems must remain reliable despite missing frames, masking, and sensor noise, yet existing egocentric anticipation methods largely assume clean observations. We identify two complementary failure modes under temporal corruption: unreliable temporal evidence during encoding and implausible, low-support verb-noun compositions during decoding. We address them with a lightweight framework combining Temporal Reliability Suppression (TRS) and Robust Verb-Noun Graph (RVG) decoding. TRS predicts a per-frame suppression score from the projected input embedding and uses it as a learned key-side attention penalty at every encoder block and to derive reliability-weighted temporal pooling. RVG re-ranks verb-noun pairs using a PMI-based compatibility graph constructed from training labels. Under corruption-augmented training, TRS+CA+RVG reaches 29.1% average corrupted accuracy and 88.2% relative robustness across six corruptions, including three mechanisms absent during training, while reducing rare verb-noun predictions from 15.4% to 1.1%. Multi-seed and diagnostic experiments show that TRS responds to synthetic masking; shuffled-graph and frequency-only controls further indicate that RVG gains depend on genuine pairwise compatibility rather than marginal-frequency effects alone.

AI.tldr: 提出TRS（时序可靠性抑制）与RVG（鲁棒动名词图）解码的轻量框架，解决可穿戴第一视角动作预判在帧缺失、掩码与传感器噪声下的鲁棒性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有第一视角动作预判方法多假设观测干净，在时序损坏下存在两类失效模式：编码阶段时序证据不可靠，解码阶段产生低支持度的不合理动名词组合。系统需在帧缺失、掩码与噪声下保持可靠。
AI.method: 框架含两部分：TRS从投影输入嵌入预测逐帧抑制分数，作为学习到的key侧注意力惩罚作用于每个编码器块，并用于可靠性加权时序池化；RVG基于训练标签构建PMI兼容图，对动名词对重新排序。采用损坏增强训练（CA）。
AI.result: TRS+CA+RVG在六种损坏下达到29.1%平均损坏准确率与88.2%相对鲁棒性（含三种训练中未见的损坏机制），稀见动名词预测从15.4%降至1.1%。多种子与诊断实验显示TRS对合成掩码有响应；打乱图与仅频率对照表明RVG增益依赖真实成对兼容性而非边缘频率效应。
AI.conclusion: TRS与RVG分别从编码可靠性与解码组合合理性两方面互补地提升时序损坏下的动作预判鲁棒性，且增益有明确的机制性来源。

title: Learning to Adapt and Calibrate: Score Distribution Alignment for Few-Shot Uncertainty Prediction in Medical VLMs
summary: Uncertainty estimation for medical vision--language models (VLMs) using conformal prediction has gained increasing attention due to its distribution-free coverage guarantees. However, standard conformal prediction relies on exchangeability between calibration and test data and typically requires a sufficiently large calibration set to obtain reliable coverage. These assumptions are difficult to satisfy in few-shot transfer settings, where only a small labeled support set is available to adapt a pretrained VLM to a new medical task, while an unlabeled query set is used for evaluation. Supervised fine-tuning on the support set changes the model parameters and consequently shifts the nonconformity score distribution, breaking exchangeability between calibration and query samples and leading to unreliable coverage under distribution shift. Existing transductive conformal adaptation methods often preserve validity by avoiding supervised updates. While this helps maintain conformal assumptions, it underutilizes the scarce labeled support data and limits task adaptation, which is the primary objective in few-shot learning. In this setting, conformal prediction should serve as an uncertainty estimation layer that supports the adapted model, rather than preventing adaptation itself. To this end, we propose AlignCP, a framework that reconciles supervised few-shot adaptation with conformal uncertainty estimation under non-exchangeability. AlignCP learns a reweighted calibration distribution that reduces the score-level discrepancy between the labeled support set and the unlabeled query set. By aligning the one-dimensional nonconformity score distributions, AlignCP aims to close the coverage gap induced by adaptation without requiring query labels.

AI.tldr: AlignCP：在少样本迁移中将监督微调与保形不确定性估计统一，通过对齐支持集与查询集的非一致性分数分布来缓解非可交换性导致的覆盖偏差。
AI.motivation: 标准保形预测依赖校准集与测试集的可交换性及足够的校准样本量，这在少样本迁移（仅有小规模有标注支持集，用无标注查询集评估）中难以满足。对支持集进行监督微调会改变模型参数、移动非一致性分数分布，破坏可交换性，导致分布偏移下覆盖不可靠。现有转导式保形自适应方法通过避免监督更新来维持有效性，但浪费了稀缺标注数据、限制任务自适应，而任务自适应恰是少样本学习的核心目标。因此需要让保形预测作为支持已适配模型的不确定性层，而非阻碍适配本身。
AI.method: 提出 AlignCP 框架：在非可交换条件下，学习一个重加权校准分布，以缩小有标注支持集与无标注查询集在分数层面的差异；通过对齐一维非一致性分数分布，在不需要查询标签的前提下弥合适配引起的覆盖差距。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅给出方法层面的预期效果：在不使用查询标签的情况下，缩小由适配引起的覆盖差距，使保形不确定性估计与监督少样本适配得以兼容。
AI.conclusion: AlignCP 将保形预测重新定位为已适配模型之上的不确定性估计层，通过分数分布重加权对齐实现监督少样本适配与保形估计的协调，缓解非可交换性带来的覆盖失效问题。

title: Dimensionality Reduction for Hyperspectral Image Classification
comment: Published in 2024 8th International Conference on Image and Signal Processing and their Applications (ISPA), Biskra, Algeria
summary: This paper addresses the issue of supervised classification in the context of hyperspectral satellite images. It deals with two fundamental aspects: dimensionality reduction of data and the selection of appropriate supervised classification techniques. Firstly, we delve into dimensionality reduction, a critical step in simplifying the management of hyperspectral data. The reduction aims to decrease complexity in terms of memory and computing time. We examine two commonly used methods: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA). Subsequently, we explore the selection of the most suitable supervised classification algorithms for hyperspectral images. We compare the performance of three methods: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Random Forest (RF) using real hyperspectral data. The results highlight that the combination of PCA and RF yields the highest overall accuracy and Kappa coefficient.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高光谱卫星影像监督分类问题，比较了PCA与LDA两种降维方法及KNN、SVM、RF三种分类算法的组合效果，发现PCA结合随机森林（RF）取得最高的总体精度和Kappa系数。
AI.motivation: 高光谱数据波段多、维度高，导致内存与计算时间开销大，需通过降维简化数据处理，同时需为高光谱影像挑选合适的监督分类算法，以提升分类精度。
AI.method: 采用两种降维方法（主成分分析PCA、线性判别分析LDA）对高光谱数据降维，并基于真实高光谱数据比较三种监督分类算法（K近邻KNN、支持向量机SVM、随机森林RF）的性能，评估其组合效果。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，PCA与随机森林（RF）的组合获得最高的总体精度（overall accuracy）和Kappa系数，优于其他方法组合。
AI.conclusion: 在高光谱卫星影像监督分类中，采用PCA降维并配合随机森林分类器是较优方案，可在降低数据复杂度的同时取得最高分类精度。

title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
summary: Plane geometry remains a significant challenge in AI, requiring the integration of visual perception and mathematical reasoning. While Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) naturally handle visuo-linguistic inputs, they are often computationally intensive and opaque. We demonstrate that a pure Large Language Model (LLM), when equipped with specialized modules, can rival state-of-the-art LMMs on complex geometry problems. Our framework integrates a Geometric Vision Parser, which translates diagrams into symbolic form, with a Symbolic Solver that performs formal deductions, thereby mitigating hallucinations and promoting interpretable reasoning. To enable rigorous evaluation, we curate a benchmark of challenging problems from the 2025 Chinese Zhongkao examinations, ensuring data novelty and testing deeper deductive skills. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Pro while delivering clearer, human-like solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种纯LLM框架，通过几何视觉解析器将图形转为符号表示，再以符号求解器进行形式化推理，在2025年中考几何题基准上取得与Gemini 2.5 Pro相当的性能，并生成更清晰、类人化的解题过程。
AI.motivation: 平面几何是AI的重要挑战，需要融合视觉感知与数学推理。现有多模态大模型虽能处理图文输入，但计算开销大且推理过程不透明，因此需要一种更可解释、更高效的方案。
AI.method: 框架集成了几何视觉解析器（Geometric Vision Parser），将几何图形转化为符号形式；再结合符号求解器（Symbolic Solver）执行形式化演绎推理，从而抑制幻觉并提升推理可解释性。同时构建了基于2025年中国中考难题的评测基准，以保证数据新颖性并考察更深层的演绎能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法的性能与Gemini 2.5 Pro相当，同时能给出更清晰、类人化的解题过程。
AI.conclusion: 纯LLM在配备专门模块后，可在复杂几何问题上媲美最先进的多模态大模型，并兼具可解释性与较低的计算负担。

title: VectorHarness: Recovering Editable, Relation-Preserving Structure from Scientific Graphics
summary: Converting scientific graphics into editable representations remains a challenging problem for image-to-code generation because of their heterogeneous elements and complex layouts. Recent multi-agent reconstruction systems have advanced this line of work, but often follow a copy-paste paradigm: the reconstructed image closely resembles the original, while complex regions remain effectively uneditable. We instead formulate a different objective, raster-to-authoring reconstruction, which aims to recover an authoring representation that supports native, customized editing rather than mere visual replication. To this end, we present VectorHarness, a multi-agent framework for raster-to-authoring reconstruction that recovers heterogeneous components using type-appropriate native representations. Text, formulas, shapes, connectors, icons, charts, and tables are reconstructed as natively editable objects, while intrinsically image-based regions remain raster content. To systematically evaluate reconstruction quality, we introduce VectorHarness-Bench, which jointly assesses rendering fidelity, raster fallback coverage, executable object edits, and relation-preserving edits. Experiments show that VectorHarness improves executable edit success and relation preservation, reduces avoidable raster fallback, and maintains high visual fidelity across heterogeneous graphics.

AI.tldr: 提出栅格到创作重构新目标与多智能体框架 VectorHarness，按类型恢复原生可编辑对象，并构建联合评测基准 VectorHarness-Bench。
AI.motivation: 科学图形含异构元素与复杂布局，现有多智能体重构系统遵循“复制-粘贴”范式，虽视觉上接近原图，但复杂区域实际难以编辑，缺乏可定制的创作表示。
AI.method: 将任务重新定义为 raster-to-authoring reconstruction，即以支持原生定制化编辑为目标；提出多智能体框架 VectorHarness，对文本、公式、形状、连接线、图标、图表、表格等采用类型适配的原生表示重构为可编辑对象，仅对本质为图像的区域保留栅格内容；并构建 VectorHarness-Bench 基准。
AI.result: VectorHarness-Bench 联合评估渲染保真度、栅格回退覆盖率、可执行对象编辑与关系保持编辑；实验表明 VectorHarness 提升可执行编辑成功率与关系保持能力，减少可避免的栅格回退，并在异构图形上保持高视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 以“创作表示”而非视觉复刻为目标的重构路径可行且有效，为图像到代码生成提供了兼顾编辑性与保真度的新范式与评测协议。

title: Beyond One-Size-Fits-All: Sample-Adaptive Strategy Routing for Vision Token Pruning in MLLMs
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures. Code will be released soon
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) process hundreds or thousands of visual tokens per image, incurring prohibitive inference costs. While existing vision token pruning methods mitigate this overhead, they implicitly assume that a single fixed pruning strategy can be applied uniformly across all inputs. Our analysis further reveals that ranking pruning methods by average benchmark accuracy conceals substantial sample-wise complementarity: although the average-best strategy excels overall, alternative strategies prove superior on a significant fraction of individual samples. To harness this diversity, we propose VIP-Router, a lightweight VIsion Pruning Router that adaptively selects the pruning strategy predicted to be best suited to each input at a specified pruning level. Conditioned on low-cost visual and textual features, VIP-Router identifies the most suitable candidate strategy while retaining full-token inference as an option when pruning is predicted to be unfavorable. Evaluated on a curated suite of pruning-sensitive visual perception benchmarks, VTC-Bench Group A, VIP-Router consistently outperforms the best fixed strategy baseline across all reduction ratios, achieving a 26.9% relative improvement in average accuracy, and a 22.0% relative increase in average utility after accounting for realized token cost. Crucially, VIP-Router operates in a plug-and-play manner without modifying underlying pruning algorithms or model weights, introducing trainable parameters equivalent to merely 0.017\% of the backbone. Furthermore, VIP-Router proves effective across various MLLM backbones and yields consistent gains on unseen benchmarks, highlighting the potential of sample adaptive routing for visual token pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VIP-Router，一种轻量级视觉 token 剪枝路由器，能根据每个输入样本自适应选择最优剪枝策略，从而显著提升多模态大模型的推理效率与准确率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）每张图像需处理数百至数千个视觉 token，推理成本高昂。现有视觉 token 剪枝方法隐式假设可用单一固定剪枝策略统一处理所有输入，但作者发现按平均基准准确率对剪枝方法排序会掩盖显著的样本级互补性：虽然平均最优策略整体表现最好，但在相当一部分个体样本上其他策略反而更优。
AI.method: 提出 VIP-Router（VIsion Pruning Router），一种轻量级视觉剪枝路由器，针对给定剪枝比例，基于低成本的视觉与文本特征预测并自适应选择最适合当前输入的候选剪枝策略；当预测剪枝不利时，保留全 token 推理作为可选项。该方法即插即用，无需修改底层剪枝算法或模型权重。
AI.result: 在剪枝敏感的视觉感知基准套件 VTC-Bench Group A 上，VIP-Router 在所有缩减比例下均优于最佳固定策略基线，平均准确率相对提升 26.9%，计入实际 token 成本后的平均效用相对提升 22.0%。可训练参数量仅为主干的 0.017%。该方法在多种 MLLM 主干上均有效，并在未见基准上取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 样本自适应路由为视觉 token 剪枝提供了巨大潜力：通过为每个输入动态选择最优剪枝策略，VIP-Router 在不改动底层算法与权重的前提下，以极低参数开销实现准确率与效用的显著提升，并具备良好的泛化性。

title: Why Is Video Still So Expensive? A Survey of Inference-Efficiency Mechanisms in Video and Audiovisual LLMs
summary: Video understanding has rapidly evolved toward video large language models (VideoLLMs): systems that couple video representations with pretrained large language models and condition generation on a textual prompt. Their strong performance on captioning, question answering, retrieval and temporal grounding comes at a computation and memory cost that grows with frame count and context length, limiting deployment in real-time, mobile and resource-constrained settings. This survey covers inference-efficiency mechanisms for visual and audiovisual VideoLLMs that report concrete reductions in parameter count, FLOPs per input, latency, memory, or visual and audio token count. We analyze bottlenecks across frame sampling, modality encoding, connector-level token reduction, and LLM prefilling and decoding. We organize methods by the pipeline stage at which they act, covering VideoLLMs developed since late 2022 together with earlier frame-sampling and vision-encoder mechanisms that remain components of current pipelines. We assemble literature-reported accuracy--cost comparisons under shared host models and input protocols wherever available, distinguish them from heterogeneous cross-paper evidence, and identify gaps in audiovisual efficiency and standardized evaluation. We maintain a repository at https://github.com/momentslab/awesome-efficient-videollm.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于视频大语言模型（VideoLLMs）推理效率的综述，按流水线阶段梳理可降低参数量、FLOPs、延迟、内存及视觉/音频token数的方法，并整理精度—成本对比，指出音视频效率与标准化评测的空白。
AI.motivation: VideoLLMs在字幕生成、问答、检索和时间定位等任务上表现强劲，但其计算与内存开销随帧数和上下文长度增长，限制了在实时、移动端及资源受限场景中的部署，因此需要系统梳理推理效率机制。
AI.method: 综述聚焦于能带来参数量、单输入FLOPs、延迟、内存或视觉/音频token数量实际下降的视觉与音视频VideoLLM推理效率机制；分析帧采样、模态编码、连接器级token缩减、LLM预填充与解码等环节的瓶颈，并按方法作用的流水线阶段进行组织，覆盖2022年末以来的VideoLLMs及更早的帧采样与视觉编码器机制。
AI.result: 汇总了文献报告的精度—成本对比，在可获取时限定于共享宿主模型与输入协议，并将其与跨论文的异质性证据相区分；同时识别出音视频效率与标准化评测方面的研究空白。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为VideoLLMs推理效率提供了按流水线阶段组织的系统性梳理与精度—成本证据，并维护开源仓库，但音视频效率与统一评测仍有待进一步研究。

title: Spot-the-shift: Evaluating Grounded Image Difference Captioning of Long-term Changes
summary: Long-term change understanding from images of the same place revisited over time is a challenging task with applications in map maintenance and urban infrastructure monitoring. Prior work addresses it either through pixel-level prediction or difference captioning, neither of which is sufficient to reliably measure how well models detect and describe such changes. We introduce SPOT-THE-SHIFT, a human-verified benchmark for grounded image difference captioning of long-term changes in real-world driving scenes. Our benchmark provides natural language captions and spatial masks for structural changes across each image pair. We further propose an evaluation protocol that reliably assesses models' captioning ability, validated through human studies. Benchmarking state-of-the-art MLLMs, we find that models struggle with the fine-grained multi-image spatial capability required for this task. Finally, we develop a synthetic data generation pipeline that improves an off-the-shelf MLLM without sacrificing general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SPOT-THE-SHIFT，一个经人工验证的、用于真实驾驶场景长期变化的有依据图像差异描述基准，包含自然语言描述与空间掩码，并提出经人类研究验证的评估协议；实验表明当前多模态大模型在该任务上表现不足，同时提出合成数据生成流程以在不损失通用能力的前提下提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 长期变化理解在例如地图维护与城市基础设施监测等应用中具有重要意义，但现有研究要么采用像素级预测，要么采用差异描述，二者都不足以可靠衡量模型检测与描述此类变化的能力，因此需要一个更严谨的基准与评估方法来支撑该任务。
AI.method: 作者构建了 SPOT-THE-SHIFT 基准，对每对图像提供自然语言描述与结构性变化的空间掩码，并提出一套评估协议，且通过人类研究对该协议进行验证；同时提出一个合成数据生成流程用于微调现成的多模态大模型。
AI.result: 对当前最先进的多模态大模型进行基准测试后发现，模型在完成该任务所需的细粒度多图像空间能力方面表现不佳；同时，所提出的合成数据生成流程能在不牺牲通用能力的情况下提升现成 MLLM 的表现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过引入带有人工验证的 grounded 图像差异描述基准与可靠评估协议，弥补了既往像素级预测与差异描述评估的不足，并指出了 MLLM 在长期变化理解上的能力瓶颈，同时提供了一种可行的数据驱动改进方向。

title: SceneHI: High-Resolution 3D-Consistent Scene Texturing with Controllable Illumination
summary: SceneHI is a framework that lifts high-resolution, illumination-aware priors from 2D diffusion models to perform 3D texture synthesis. It is the first to demonstrate that high-resolution textures, previously limited to 2D synthesis, can be generated directly on 3D objects without model fine-tuning or optimization. Designed for complex, multi-object environments, SceneHI uniquely combines 3D-consistency, high-resolution fidelity, and physically plausible baked shadows within a single generative pipeline. To enforce strict geometric coherence, we introduce an exact analytical pixel-to-texel mapping that aligns diffusion trajectories across multiple viewpoints. We utilize High-Resolution Latent Textures (HRLTs) as a persistent canvas for gradually denoised textures, while camera views perform the denoising steps in latent pixel space. This ensures a shared base texture that can be subsequently refined to high resolution without compromising multi-view consistency. Finally, a light-aware generative pass embeds realistic geometry-consistent shadows directly into the atlases, bridging the gap to production workflows. SceneHI achieves high visual fidelity while reducing generation time by 80% compared to existing scene-level methods.

AI.tldr: SceneHI 将 2D 扩散模型的高分辨率、光照感知先验提升到 3D 纹理合成，首次实现无需微调或优化即可直接在 3D 物体上生成高分辨率纹理，并在场景级任务中将生成时间降低 80%。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率纹理生成此前主要局限于 2D 合成；将此类先验迁移到复杂多物体 3D 场景时，需同时兼顾 3D 一致性、高分辨率保真度与物理合理的烘焙阴影，而现有方法难以在单一生成流程中统一这些目标。
AI.method: 提出 SceneHI 框架：引入精确的解析像素到纹素（pixel-to-texel）映射，跨多视角对齐扩散轨迹以保证几何一致性；使用高分辨率潜在纹理（HRLTs）作为持续画布，相机视角在潜在像素空间执行去噪；随后进行可精炼的高分辨率提升；最后通过光照感知生成通道，将几何一致的阴影直接嵌入纹理图集。
AI.result: 在保持高视觉保真度的同时，相比现有场景级方法将生成时间减少 80%，并实现 3D 一致性、高分辨率与烘焙阴影的统一。
AI.conclusion: SceneHI 证明高分辨率纹理可直接在 3D 物体上生成，无需模型微调或优化，为场景级 3D 纹理合成提供了兼顾一致性、分辨率与光照真实感的生成式流程，并贴近生产工作流。

title: AVSRBench: A Multi-Condition AVSR Benchmark
summary: While AVSR has achieved sub-1% word error rates on the standard LRS3 benchmark, its reliance on broadcast speech obscures whether this reflects true generalization or just domain adaptation. To investigate this gap, we evaluate three AVSR architectures across six conditions: controlled broadcast speech, fixed-grammar utterances, hyper-articulated Lombard speech, read speech from professional lipspeakers and non-professional speakers, and spontaneous multi-party video conversations. We find that visual-only performance deteriorates rapidly beyond broadcast domains, and audio-video fusion mainly benefits Lombard speech environments. Visual understanding degrades sharply at 90° profile views, with multimodal systems relying largely on acoustic fallback. Additionally, speaker articulation proves more critical than minor camera shifts, and LLM-based architectures suffer from poor out-of-domain generalization. Our work highlights a significant generalization gap in current AVSR research. To address this, we also introduce RoomReader-AV as a new benchmark for AVSR and release a unified data preprocessing pipeline to make comprehensive multi-condition evaluation accessible.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示当前AVSR在LRS3等广播域基准上的低错误率并不代表真正泛化能力，并通过多条件评测指出显著泛化差距，同时提出RoomReader-AV基准与统一预处理流程。
AI.motivation: 现有AVSR在标准LRS3基准上词错误率已低于1%，但该基准依赖广播语音，难以判断性能提升是真实泛化还是单纯的领域适配，因此需要跨域系统评测以厘清泛化差距。
AI.method: 评估三种AVSR架构，覆盖六类条件：受控广播语音、固定语法话语、超发音Lombard语音、专业与非专业唇读者朗读语音、以及多人自发视频对话，并对视角、融合方式、发音清晰度与LLM架构等因素进行对比分析。
AI.result: 纯视觉性能在广播域之外迅速下降；音视频融合主要在Lombard语音环境中带来收益；90°侧脸视角下视觉理解显著退化，多模态系统主要依赖音频回退；说话人发音清晰度比轻微摄像头位移更关键；基于LLM的架构域外泛化较差。
AI.conclusion: 当前AVSR研究存在显著泛化差距，论文提出RoomReader-AV新基准并开源统一数据预处理流程，以支持可访问的多条件综合评测。

title: Beyond Weak Labels: Prompt-Guided Local Refinement for Weakly Supervised Water Segmentation in High-Resolution Multispectral Imagery
comment: Accepted for presentation at ICIP Workshop 2026 and to be published as part of the conference proceedings
summary: High-resolution water mapping supports environmental monitoring and related applications, but accurate pixel-level labels are difficult and costly to produce. Official hydrographic vectors provide scalable weak supervision, but they contain artifacts like boundary noise, temporal mismatch, and omissions of small water structures. We propose a two-stage framework for weakly supervised water segmentation in high resolution multispectral imagery. Stage 1 learns initial masks from rasterized vector pseudo-labels, and Stage 2 converts these masks into structured component-wise prompts for localized refinement. On a manually corrected validation set, refinement improves SegFormer-B0 from 0.9509 to 0.9535 IoU and U-Net from 0.9408 to 0.9486 IoU, with corresponding F1 gains from 0.9749 to 0.9762 and 0.9695 to 0.9736. It leads to sharper shorelines, reduced boundary spillover, and better thin-structure delineation. The results indicate that prompt-guided refinement can improve pseudo-label-based water segmentation by targeting local errors that are poorly captured by global training supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段弱监督水体分割框架：第一阶段用栅格化矢量伪标签学习初始掩膜，第二阶段将掩膜转为结构化组件提示进行局部精化，在两模型上取得IoU与F1提升并改善岸线细节。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率水体制图对环境监测等应用很重要，但像元级精确标注成本高、难度大。官方水文矢量可提供可扩展的弱监督，但存在边界噪声、时相不匹配以及小型水体结构遗漏等伪标签伪影问题。
AI.method: 两阶段弱监督高分辨率多光谱影像水体分割框架。第一阶段从栅格化的矢量伪标签学习初始掩膜；第二阶段将这些掩膜转换为结构化、组件级的提示（prompts），用于局部化精化。
AI.result: 在人工校正的验证集上，精化使SegFormer-B0的IoU从0.9509提升至0.9535，U-Net从0.9408提升至0.9486；对应F1分别从0.9749提升至0.9762、从0.9695提升至0.9736。表现为岸线更锐利、边界外溢减少、细薄结构刻画更好。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明提示引导的精化能够通过针对全局训练监督难以捕捉的局部误差，改进基于伪标签的水体分割效果。

title: PACE: Perceived-Latency-Aware Cascading Service Routing and Filler Control for QoE-Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Dialogue Serving
summary: We present the PACE, a framework for retrieval-augmented dialogue serving that formalizes Perceived Time-to-First-Response (PTFR) as a QoE objective and minimizes it under quality/cost constraints. Unlike prior work on cascaded routing, semantic caching, or adaptive retrieval, PACE jointly controls which answer source composes the response and what fills the waiting window. Deployed on a humanoid-robot sales service, it combines three mechanisms: a load-adaptive cascading router, a joint path-filler controller, and volatility-aware cache admission. On 75k CarQA requests, the cascade halves pure-LLM PTFR at P95 (0.29 vs 0.53s at c16). The adaptive controller reaches 0.41s P95, outperforming RAG by 2.4 times at high load with equal quality. The filler controller cuts calls by 94% with zero conflict. Volatility-aware admission reduces stale answers from 86% to 0%. A gating rule ensures the controller never worse than the baseline, with exposure bounded by one hold period. This is the first quantification of filler-answer conflict risk in deployed services.

AI.tldr: 提出PACE框架，将感知首响时间（PTFR）形式化为QoE目标，在质量/成本约束下联合优化回答源选择与等待窗口填充，并在人形机器人销售服务中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有级联路由、语义缓存、自适应检索等工作未联合控制"由哪个源生成回答"与"等待窗口如何填充"，导致首响体验与质量/成本难以兼顾。
AI.method: PACE包含三个机制：负载自适应级联路由器（决定回答源）、联合路径填充控制器（填充等待窗口）、波动感知缓存准入。
AI.result: 在75k CarQA请求上，级联使纯LLM的P95 PTFR减半（c16下0.29s vs 0.53s）；自适应控制器达0.41s P95，高负载下优于RAG 2.4倍且质量相当；填充器减少94%调用且零冲突；波动感知准入将过期回答从86%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 门控规则保证控制器不劣于基线，曝光期有界于一个保持周期；首次量化了部署服务中填充回答的冲突风险。

title: Shape-guided Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View X-ray 3D Reconstruction
comment: Accepted at: Off-Grid: 1st Workshop on Continuous Representations and Grid-Free Methods in Medical Imaging, MICCAI 2026
summary: Sparse-view X-ray 3D reconstruction is essential for reducing radiation exposure, but recovering a density field from a handful of X-ray projections is severely ill-posed. Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting has achieved state-of-the-art performance in sparse-view reconstruction by representing the volume using explicit, optimized primitives, but it requires dozens of projected views. With fewer views, reconstruction quality degrades severely since the explicit primitives are optimized freely without any anatomical information. Anatomical structures, in contrast, share similar geometry and density across a population. Their variations are bounded within a limited range that statistical shape models can capture. This paper proposes a shape-guided Gaussian splatting framework for sparse-view X-ray 3D reconstructions. Our contribution lies in driving Gaussian positions toward anatomically valid configurations, alongside atlas-based density regularization. Our method ensures anatomically consistent reconstruction and improves PSNR by 2.83 dB over a state-of-the-art Gaussian splatting baseline with as few as 5 views. Code Available: https://github.com/polyshape-lab/ShapeGuidedGaussian

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种形状引导的高斯泼溅框架，用于稀疏视角X射线3D重建。通过将高斯位置约束到解剖学有效配置并结合基于图谱的密度正则化，方法在仅5个视角下较最先进高斯泼溅基线PSNR提升2.83 dB。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角X射线3D重建可降低辐射暴露，但从少量投影恢复密度场是严重病态问题。现有3D高斯泼溅虽在稀疏视角重建中表现最优，却需数十个视角；视角过少时，显式基元自由优化且缺乏解剖先验，导致重建质量急剧下降。而解剖结构在人群中具有相似几何与密度、变化范围有限，可由统计形状模型刻画，因此有潜力作为先验弥补信息不足。
AI.method: 提出形状引导高斯泼溅（shape-guided Gaussian splatting）框架：一是驱动高斯位置向解剖学有效的配置收敛；二是引入基于图谱（atlas-based）的密度正则化。二者结合使重建具备解剖一致性。
AI.result: 在少至5个视角的条件下，相较最先进的高斯泼溅基线，PSNR提升2.83 dB，并实现解剖学一致的重建。代码已开源：https://github.com/polyshape-lab/ShapeGuidedGaussian。
AI.conclusion: 将统计形状先验融入高斯泼溅的显式基元优化，可有效缓解稀疏视角X射线3D重建的病态性，在极少视角下显著提升重建质量与解剖合理性。

title: Data-Driven Risk Fields for Safer End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Safety is a fundamental requirement for autonomous driving, yet existing end-to-end driving models still lack explicit risk-aware learning capacities. Existing rule-based risk models provide interpretable safety priors, yet their absolute risk scores depend on handcrafted functions, coefficients, and thresholds. Learning-based risk representations reduce part of this manual design, but their supervision often relies on occupancy-derived labels or heuristic cost values, which may not capture ego-conditioned planning risk. In this paper, we propose DRiF, a data-driven risk-field framework for safer end-to-end autonomous driving. DRiF learns a shared BEV feature with static map segmentation, dynamic risk prediction, and vehicle planning. For dynamic risk learning, DRiF converts rule-based safety priors into pairwise risk labels, and trains the risk field to preserve relative risk ordering instead of regressing handcrafted absolute scores. Experiments on Bench2Drive show that DRiF achieves competitive overall performance, with consistent improvements in driving score, success rate, and collision-related metrics. These results establish relative risk supervision as an effective way to connect explicit safety structure with end-to-end planning. The data and code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出DRiF数据驱动风险场框架，用规则先验生成的成对风险标签训练相对风险序，实现更安全的端到端自动驾驶。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶缺乏显式风险感知学习能力；规则模型依赖人工函数、系数和阈值，绝对风险分数不可靠；学习式风险表征的监督多来自占用标签或启发式代价，难以刻画自车条件下的规划风险。
AI.method: DRiF学习共享BEV特征，同时支持静态地图分割、动态风险预测与车辆规划；将规则式安全先验转化为成对风险标签，训练风险场保持相对风险排序，而非回归人工设计的绝对分数。
AI.result: 在Bench2Drive上取得有竞争力的整体表现，驾驶分数、成功率及碰撞相关指标均有一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 相对风险监督是将显式安全结构与端到端规划有效连接的方式，数据与代码将公开。

title: Enhanced Deformable Convolution with Center-invariant Offset and Edge-aware Mask
comment: The authors have identified issues that require substantial revision and have therefore decided to withdraw the current version
summary: Deformable convolution networks have recently become popular for many computer vision tasks, especially for semantic segmentation, because of their exceptional capabilities in dynamic spatial modeling. However, due to the dense deformable offsets and the lack of longer-range dependencies, they can not fully adopt proper and precise deformations for feature representations. To tackle the issues, in this paper, we propose Enhanced Deformable ConvNets (EDCN) for semantic segmentation. Specifically, a novel Enhanced Deformable Convolution (EDC) is exploited in the decoder, which integrates the Center-invariant Offset Module (COM) and Edge-aware Mask Module (EMM). The COM employs larger kernels and eliminates deformations at the kernel center, obtaining offsets that are more in line with the target from richer spatial information. Concurrently, the EMM obtains the significance of image content via Sobel edge detection, then selectively applies deformations based on the content significance, minimizing unnecessary deformations associated with relatively less important information, thereby avoiding impact from less informative regions. Experiments show that EDC outperforms state-of-the-art deformable convolution variants, including Deformable ConvNets V1-V4 and Entire Deformable ConvNets, across mainstream segmentation datasets with various decoder settings. Moreover, ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each component. In addition, visualizations illustrate that EDC enhances spatial adaptation and target focus. We further analyze the extendibility of EDC to larger kernels on the image classification benchmark. Code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出增强可变形卷积网络（EDCN）用于语义分割，通过中心不变偏移模块（COM）和边缘感知掩码模块（EMM）改进可变形卷积，提升空间建模与目标聚焦能力。
AI.motivation: 现有可变形卷积网络虽在动态空间建模方面表现优异，但存在密集可变形偏移及缺乏长距离依赖的问题，导致无法充分采用恰当且精确的形变进行特征表示。
AI.method: 在解码器中引入增强可变形卷积（EDC），集成COM与EMM。COM使用更大卷积核并消除核中心形变，从而基于更丰富空间信息获得更贴合目标的偏移；EMM通过Sobel边缘检测获取图像内容重要性，并据此选择性地施加形变，减少非重要区域的不必要形变。
AI.result: 在主流分割数据集及多种解码器设置下，EDC优于Deformable ConvNets V1-V4、Entire Deformable ConvNets等最先进可变形卷积变体；消融实验验证各组件有效性；可视化显示EDC增强了空间适应性与目标聚焦；并在图像分类基准上分析了EDC向更大卷积核的扩展性。
AI.conclusion: EDC是一种有效的可变形卷积改进方案，通过COM与EMM缓解偏移密集与长距离依赖不足的问题，在语义分割任务中表现优越，并具备向更大卷积核及分类任务扩展的潜力。

title: Candor-LR: A Dyadic Conversational Dataset for Audio-Visual Speech Recognition
summary: Current audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) benchmarks, like LRS3, rely heavily on clean, scripted and rehearsed speech. They fail to reflect the complexity of natural conversation, which involves overlapping speech, spontaneous turn-taking, unscripted vocabulary and variable acoustic conditions. To shift the field toward realistic dialogue, we introduce Candor-LR, a conversational benchmark derived from the CANDOR corpus of 1,656 natural dyadic videoconferences. Our custom data preparation pipeline yields 713.5, 10.1, and 60.1 hours of training, validation, and test data, respectively. Evaluating pretrained AVSR models on Candor-LR reveals that audio-only accuracy drops sharply compared to LRS3, but visual cues compensate effectively, driving much larger performance gains on Candor-LR than on LRS3. Furthermore, training on this corpus significantly improves cross-domain robustness under both clean and noisy conditions, as its realistic conversational data captures broader audio-video features. We open-source our pipeline to ensure reproducibility, establishing Candor-LR as a challenging benchmark for conversational AVSR.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Candor-LR，一个基于CANDOR语料库构建的对话式音视频语音识别（AVSR）基准，旨在弥补现有基准（如LRS3）过度依赖干净、脚本化语音的缺陷。Candor-LR包含713.5/10.1/60.1小时训练/验证/测试数据，实验表明预训练AVSR模型在Candor-LR上音频精度显著下降，但视觉线索补偿效果更强，且训练于此语料能提升跨域鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有AVSR基准（如LRS3）依赖干净、脚本化、排练过的语音，无法反映自然对话中的重叠语音、自发轮流发言、非脚本化词汇和可变声学条件等复杂性，因此需要推动领域向真实对话场景发展。
AI.method: 从含有1,656段自然双人视频会议的CANDOR语料库中，通过自定义数据准备流程构建对话式基准Candor-LR，产出713.5小时训练数据、10.1小时验证数据和60.1小时测试数据，并开源该流程以保证可复现性。
AI.result: 在Candor-LR上评估预训练AVSR模型发现：与LRS3相比，纯音频准确率大幅下降；视觉线索能有效补偿，在Candor-LR上的性能提升远大于LRS3；在该语料上训练可显著提升干净和噪声条件下的跨域鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Candor-LR作为一个具有挑战性的对话式AVSR基准，能够更真实地反映自然对话的复杂性，并通过其现实对话数据捕获更广泛的音视频特征，提升模型跨域鲁棒性，同时开源流程确保可复现性。

title: Rosetta at AlexandriaX-2026: LoRA-Adapted NileChat for Context-Aware Dialectal Arabic Dialogue Translation
comment: 5 pages, 3 tables, accepted to the AlexandriaX 2026 Shared Task at ArabicNLP 2026 (co-located with EMNLP)
summary: This paper describes the Rosetta system for Subtask 1 (Context-Aware English-to-Dialectal Arabic Dialogue Translation) of the AlexandriaX shared task, participating in both constrained and unconstrained tracks. The approach fine-tunes a LoRA adapter on NileChat-3B using structured system/user prompts that condition generation on dialect and dialogue context. For the unconstrained track, the adapter is additionally pretrained on MADAR and PADIC. Rosetta ranked 4th in the constrained track (spBLEU 26.10) and 5th in the unconstrained track (spBLEU 25.09). The experimental results demonstrate that external pretraining helps only two of thirteen dialects while slightly hurting overall performance, suggesting negative transfer.

AI.tldr: Rosetta 系统参加 AlexandriaX 子任务1（上下文感知的英语-方言阿拉伯语对话翻译），采用在 NileChat-3B 上微调 LoRA 适配器的方法，约束赛道排名第4（spBLEU 26.10），非约束赛道排名第5（spBLEU 25.09）。
AI.motivation: 参加 AlexandriaX 共享任务的上下文感知英语到方言阿拉伯语对话翻译子任务，探索通过结构化提示与外部语料预训练提升方言对话翻译性能。
AI.method: 在 NileChat-3B 上微调 LoRA 适配器，使用结构化的 system/user 提示，将方言类型与对话上下文作为生成条件；非约束赛道额外在 MADAR 与 PADIC 语料上预训练适配器。参加约束与非约束两个赛道。
AI.result: 约束赛道排名第4，spBLEU 26.10；非约束赛道排名第5，spBLEU 25.09。实验表明，外部预训练仅在13种方言中的2种上带来提升，整体性能略有下降。
AI.conclusion: 外部预训练对多数方言无益甚至有害，呈现负迁移（negative transfer）现象，说明直接引入外部方言语料未必能改善上下文感知的方言对话翻译。

title: Retrofitting Code Using LLMs to Support Exceptional Behavior
summary: Exception Related Code (ERC), which includes throw statements, conditions (if statements) that guard those throw statements, and try/catch blocks, is an essential component of software systems, allowing developers to detect and handle exceptional states that deviate from the expected program behavior. However, manually writing ERC across large codebases is tedious. We propose a novel task: retrofitting existing code with ERC. Namely, given code (without ERC) and Exceptional Behavior Tests (EBTs) (e.g., check if method throws InvalidArgumentException if null is given as the value to the argument) we aim to automatically generate missing ERC, such that the given tests pass. We design and implement Exception Coder (EXCODER) that performs context engineering to help Large Language Models (LLMs) tackle this task. EXCODER integrates static and dynamic program analysis with LLMs by providing the extracted contextual information to the LLMs. To evaluate EXCODER, we build a benchmark constructed from GitHub Java repositories, where we systematically remove ERC in 304 methods from 75 projects. Our results demonstrate that EXCODER provides an effective, though imperfect, solution to this problem in automated code generation, offering developers the first way to implement ERC following test-driven development. When combined with Qwen 2.5 Coder 32b, EXCODER achieves pass@1, 5, and 10 rates of 85.92% (12.56 percentage points over baseline), 86.18% (12.82 p.p. over baseline), and 86.51% (13.15 p.p. over baseline), respectively, on developer-written test suites. Our manual inspection of the generated code further reveals limitations of EXCODER, pointing to directions for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"异常相关代码（ERC）回填"新任务：给定不含ERC的代码与异常行为测试（EBT），自动生成缺失的ERC使测试通过。作者设计了EXCODER，通过上下文工程为LLM提供静态与动态程序分析信息。在304个方法、75个项目的基准上，EXCODER结合Qwen 2.5 Coder 32b在开发者测试套件上取得85.92%的pass@1，较基线提升12.56个百分点，并揭示其局限性。
AI.motivation: 异常相关代码（含throw语句、守卫throw的if条件、try/catch块）是软件系统的重要组成，但跨大型代码库手工编写ERC极为繁琐。现有代码生成研究较少关注在已有代码上自动回填缺失的异常处理逻辑这一实际需求。
AI.method: 提出并实现EXCODER：整合静态程序分析与动态程序分析，提取上下文信息并将其提供给大语言模型（LLM），通过上下文工程（context engineering）引导LLM完成ERC生成。同时构建了基准数据集：从GitHub Java仓库中系统性地移除75个项目、304个方法中的ERC，并结合Exceptional Behavior Tests（EBT）进行评测。
AI.result: 在开发者编写的测试套件上，EXCODER结合Qwen 2.5 Coder 32b取得的pass@1、pass@5、pass@10分别为85.92%（较基线+12.56个百分点）、86.18%（+12.82 p.p.）、86.51%（+13.15 p.p.）。对生成代码的人工审查进一步揭示了EXCODER的局限性。
AI.conclusion: EXCODER为自动生成ERC提供了一个有效但尚不完美的解决方案，首次让开发者能够以测试驱动开发（TDD）方式实现ERC；人工审查发现的局限也为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Can Foundation Models Moderate Online Content? Evaluating Instruction- vs. Example-Driven Policy Operationalization
summary: The growing complexity of content moderation policies presents a critical challenge for their consistent operationalization. While foundation models possess the basic capabilities needed to confront this challenge, whether they can reliably moderate online content remains an unanswered question. In this paper, we systematically compare two competing paradigms for Vision-Language Model (VLM) guidance: an instruction-driven approach where models reason from policy precepts, and an example-driven approach where they generalize from prior precedents. We ground this investigation in ModerationBench, a new benchmark of 4,000 manually annotated, in-the-wild posts from the Bluesky platform. Our experiments reveal that foundation models can substantially outperform Bluesky's deployed moderation system, nearly tripling its $F_1$ score (0.60 vs. 0.22) on Random Posts in the benchmark, with both instruction- and example-driven paradigms achieving comparable peak effectiveness. Our findings thus chart a path toward reliable and adaptable policy operationalization at scale.

AI.tldr: 论文比较了视觉语言模型（VLM）在内容审核中的两种指导范式：指令驱动（基于政策原则推理）与示例驱动（基于既往先例泛化），并基于新基准ModerationBench（4,000条Bluesky真实帖子）进行评估。结果显示基础模型显著优于Bluesky部署的审核系统，F1从0.22提升至0.60，两种范式峰值效果相当。
AI.motivation: 内容审核政策日益复杂，其一致性落地执行面临关键挑战。基础模型虽具备应对该挑战的基本能力，但其能否可靠地审核在线内容尚无定论；同时，指令驱动与示例驱动两种VLM指导范式孰优孰劣缺乏系统比较。
AI.method: 构建ModerationBench基准，包含来自Bluesky平台的4,000条人工标注的真实（in-the-wild）帖子；系统对比两种VLM指导范式：(1) 指令驱动——模型从政策原则出发进行推理；(2) 示例驱动——模型从既往先例中泛化。
AI.result: 基础模型大幅超越Bluesky已部署的审核系统，在基准的Random Posts上F1分数接近三倍提升（0.60 vs. 0.22）；指令驱动与示例驱动两种范式均能达到可比的峰值效果。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型可用于可靠且可扩展的政策落地执行；指令驱动与示例驱动路径均有效，为大规模、可适配的内容审核政策操作化指明了方向。

title: Do speech foundation models really learn words?
summary: Self-supervised speech foundation models are now used in a wide array of downstream applications, including traditional speech recognition and as the basis for tokens in speech-aware language models. Attempts to understand their usefulness have largely focused on probing their representations' ability to discriminate phonemes and words. However, discriminative ability for words need not imply specialized representation of words per se. Good discrimination of words may be explained by good encoding of word form (phonemes) rather than form-independent word representations encoding identity or syntactic/semantic properties. By partialling out phoneme information using residualization, we show that, in later layers, HuBERT and wav2vec 2.0 do in general learn representations which encode words with reasonable fidelity independently of local phonetic content. We show that this simple approach to disentanglement can enhance higher-order linguistic information in word discovery tasks.

AI.tldr: 通过残差化剔除音素信息后发现，HuBERT 和 wav2vec 2.0 的较高层仍能独立于局部语音内容、以较好保真度编码单词表示，且该解耦方法可增强词发现任务中的高阶语言信息。
AI.motivation: 自监督语音基础模型广泛用于下游任务，但对其表征能力的理解多集中于音素与单词的区分能力。然而，单词的区分能力未必意味着模型学到了单词层面的专门表征——良好的单词区分也可能仅源于对词形（音素）的良好编码，而非编码身份或句法/语义属性的、与词形无关的单词表征。因此需要区分二者。
AI.method: 采用残差化（residualization）方法，从表征中偏回归掉音素信息，从而将词汇层面的信息与局部语音（音素）内容解耦，并在 HuBERT 与 wav2vec 2.0 的各层表征上进行检验。
AI.result: 在模型的较高层中，HuBERT 与 wav2vec 2.0 总体上确实学到了独立于局部语音内容、且以较好保真度编码单词的表征。此外，这种简单的解耦方式能够在词发现任务中增强高阶语言信息。
AI.conclusion: 单词区分能力不能等同于专门的单词表征；通过残差化解耦音素信息，可揭示自监督语音模型高层中形式无关的词汇表征，并有助于词发现任务中高阶语言信息的提取。

title: ConvMem: Convolutional Memory for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities, they often struggle with extremely long contexts due to fixed context limits. To address this, sequential approaches like MemAgent extend the effective context by reading text in segments and iteratively updating a fixed-size memory. However, this sequential paradigm suffers from high latency and requires costly reinforcement learning (RL) training, which can lead to overfitting on specific datasets. To overcome these limitations, we propose ConvMem, a training-free, highly parallelizable framework that reformulates long-context reasoning as a hierarchical convolution. Inspired by CNNs, ConvMem treats an LLM prompted with a specific query as a convolutional kernel. This kernel summarizes text segments hierarchically, shortening the reasoning path from a linear chain into a logarithmic tree. Specifically, ConvMem integrates \textit{Configurable Strides} and \textit{Skip Connections} to ensure robust evidence capture and propagation, while employing \textit{Multi-Kernel Convolution} to decompose complex queries into disentangled semantic channels. This design not only mitigates error accumulation but also enables massive parallelization across both text segments and reasoning threads. Experiments on RULER-HotpotQA and RULER-2WikiMultiHopQA demonstrate that ConvMem outperforms training-free baselines and avoids the risk of overfitting to parametric priors often observed in RL-trained models on out-of-distribution tasks.

AI.tldr: ConvMem将长上下文推理重构为层次化卷积，用LLM作为卷积核，无需训练且可高度并行。
AI.motivation: LLM受固定上下文长度限制难以处理超长上下文。已有顺序方法（如MemAgent）虽通过分段读取与迭代更新固定大小记忆来扩展有效上下文，但存在高延迟、需昂贵RL训练、易过拟合特定数据集的问题。
AI.method: 提出ConvMem，一种免训练、高度可并行的框架，将长上下文推理建模为层次化卷积。借鉴CNN思想，把带特定query的LLM视为卷积核，对文本片段进行层次化摘要，将推理路径从线性链压缩为对数树。引入可配置步长（Configurable Strides）与跳跃连接（Skip Connections）保障证据的鲁棒捕获与传播，并采用多核卷积（Multi-Kernel Convolution）将复杂query分解为解耦的语义通道。
AI.result: 在RULER-HotpotQA与RULER-2WikiMultiHopQA上，ConvMem优于免训练基线，并避免了RL训练模型在分布外任务上常见于参数先验的过拟合风险。
AI.conclusion: 该设计既能缓解误差累积，又能在文本片段与推理线程两个维度实现大规模并行，为长上下文推理提供了免训练、可并行的新范式。

title: Building Multilingual Bridges: Data Mixing as the Pillar of Generalization for In-Language Reasoning
summary: Reasoning language models have made substantial advances on a variety of complex tasks, yet their capabilities remain overwhelmingly English-centric: models primarily reason in English regardless of the language they are prompted in. This is inaccessible for non-English-speaking users, risks losing the intent of the original question, and forgoes knowledge more readily expressed in the target language. In this work, we advance L2 reasoning, the ability of a model to reason consistently in the language of the user's prompt, thus building an in-language bridge between the prompt and the answer. We approach this problem from a data-centric angle, investigating how to optimize data composition and scheduling in SFT for reasoning generalization. Building Tiny Aya L2-Thinker at 3.35B scale, we achieve an L2 reasoning rate above 93% across 60 languages on 6 benchmarks spanning math, commonsense reasoning, instruction following, open-ended generation, and cultural reasoning while keeping performance strong. We show the path to generalizing L2 reasoning to held-out languages goes through broader language coverage, readily available multilingual non-reasoning data, and a sufficient English reasoning backbone. These findings indicate that reasoning is a language-agnostic behavior that can be transferred across typologically diverse languages through careful data mixing and without requiring reasoning supervision in every target language. We release our model weights and multilingual reasoning data to support further research on accessible, in-language reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出并实现"L2推理"——模型用提示语言进行推理的能力，通过数据为中心的SFT数据配比与调度优化，训练出3.35B规模的Tiny Aya L2-Thinker，在60种语言、6类基准上取得超过93%的L2推理率，并证明推理是可跨语言迁移的语言无关行为。
AI.motivation: 现有推理语言模型虽在复杂任务上表现优异，但能力高度英语中心化：无论提示何种语言，模型都以英语推理。这导致非英语用户难以使用、可能丢失原问题意图、且无法利用目标语言更易表达的知识。因此需要构建提示与答案之间的"语言内"桥梁，即使用户语言推理（L2推理）。
AI.method: 从数据为中心的角度出发，研究SFT中数据配比与调度策略对推理泛化能力的影响；训练3.35B规模的Tiny Aya L2-Thinker模型，并系统考察语言覆盖范围、现成多语言非推理数据以及英语推理骨干能力对L2推理泛化的作用。
AI.result: 在数学、常识推理、指令遵循、开放式生成与文化推理等6个基准、60种语言上，L2推理率超过93%，同时整体性能保持强劲。研究显示，将L2推理泛化到未见过语言的关键在于：更广泛的语言覆盖、易获取的多语言非推理数据、以及充足的英语推理骨干。
AI.conclusion: 推理是一种语言无关的行为，可通过精心设计的数据混合在类型学差异显著的语言间迁移，而无需每种目标语言的推理监督数据。研究发布了模型权重与多语言推理数据，以支持可访问的语言内推理的后续研究。

title: Advanced Brain Tissue Imaging with Data-Consistent Diffusion Priors in Laminographic X-Ray Nanoimaging
summary: Nanoscale imaging of mammalian brains is critical for connectomics. X-ray laminography enables high-throughput imaging of extended, plate-like biological specimens. However, the tilted acquisition geometry leads to incomplete Fourier-space coverage, giving rise to a missing-cone of information. Conventional reconstruction methods cannot recover unmeasured information within the cone, resulting in artifacts that distort fine brain structures. While resolving these requires modeling 3D structure, direct 3D deep learning approaches are limited by data scarcity and computational cost. Here we introduce LUCID (Laminography with Unified Consistent Diffusion), a framework that combines multi-view diffusion priors with projection-domain data consistency. LUCID integrates complementary 3D structural information while enforcing strict alignment with the laminography forward model. On simulated datasets, LUCID substantially improves spatial fidelity and restores missing Fourier components, outperforming baseline methods. Applied to experimental laminography data, LUCID generalizes robustly despite being trained exclusively on fully sampled tomographic volumes, and effectively recovers unmeasured Fourier information.

AI.tldr: LUCID：结合多视角扩散先验与投影域数据一致性的X射线层析成像重建框架，用于解决倾斜采集导致的缺失锥问题，恢复脑组织精细结构。
AI.motivation: 哺乳动物脑的纳米级成像对连接组学至关重要，X射线层析成像可实现高通量、板状生物样本成像；但倾斜采集几何导致傅里叶空间覆盖不完整，形成缺失锥。传统重建方法无法恢复锥内未测量信息，产生伪影，扭曲精细脑结构；而直接三维深度学习受数据稀缺和算力成本限制。
AI.method: 提出LUCID（Laminography with Unified Consistent Diffusion）框架，将多视角扩散先验与投影域数据一致性相结合，在整合互补三维结构信息的同时，强制与层析成像前向模型保持严格对齐。
AI.result: 在模拟数据集上，LUCID显著提升空间保真度并恢复缺失的傅里叶分量，优于基线方法；应用于实验层析成像数据时，尽管仅在完全采样的断层体积上训练，仍表现出稳健的泛化能力，有效恢复未测量的傅里叶信息。
AI.conclusion: LUCID通过扩散先验与投影域一致性约束的结合，为层析成像缺失锥问题提供了有效解决方案，具备向真实实验数据泛化的潜力。

title: Semigroup-JEPA: Latent Dynamics Consistency for Zero-Shot Physics Generalization
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models learn a compact latent representation of the world that supports prediction and planning, but their capability to learn physics and generate physically realistic dynamics remains hitherto untested. In this work, we introduce SemiGroup-JEPA (SG-JEPA), which extends the LeWorldModel framework by supplying the parameter governing the physics to the temporal model via action-conditioning and jointly training an encoder and predictor through an autoregressive latent rollout. To evaluate the model's ability to generalize out of distribution, we design dynamical tasks under different gravitational fields that, despite obeying the same physical law, exhibit qualitatively different dynamics, ranging from floating motion in weak gravitational fields to rapid bouncing in strong ones. In contrast to DINO-WM, SG-JEPA reduces open-loop prediction error by up to 2 times on two-dimensional datasets, and increases control success rate up to 2.5 times for three-dimensional robotic datasets, for which we train independent diffusion policies. To explain this advantage, we develop a linear feature model that separates local law-conditioned error from its recursive amplification under rollout. Guided by this model, we find that back-propagating the multi-step rollout loss into the representation trains the encoder to keep the features that the predictor can carry forward, and that those are the features the dynamics depend on, so most of the gain comes from the encoder learning better features rather than from the predictor learning better dynamics. See project page at https://sg-jepa.github.io.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 SemiGroup-JEPA（SG-JEPA），在 LeWorldModel 框架上通过动作条件化将物理参数注入时序模型，并以自回归潜空间 rollout 联合训练编码器与预测器，从而显著提升世界模型学习物理规律与分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: JEPA 类世界模型虽能学习紧凑潜表征以支持预测与规划，但其学习物理规律、生成物理真实动力学的能力此前尚未被系统检验；尤其在分布外（不同引力场）条件下能否泛化仍是未知问题。
AI.method: 提出 SG-JEPA：在 LeWorldModel 基础上将控制物理的参数通过动作条件化输入时序模型，并用自回归潜空间 rollout 联合训练编码器与预测器。设计不同引力场下的动力学任务（从弱引力漂浮到强引力快速弹跳）以评估分布外泛化，并建立线性特征模型，将局部“定律条件误差”与 rollout 中的递归放大分离。
AI.result: 相比 DINO-WM，SG-JEPA 在二维数据集上开环预测误差最多降低 2 倍；在三维机器人数据集上（另训独立扩散策略）控制成功率最多提升 2.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将多步 rollout 损失反传至表征，可促使编码器保留预测器能够前向携带、且动力学所依赖的特征；因此性能提升主要来自编码器学到更好的特征，而非预测器学到更好的动力学。

title: AgroVisNet: A lightweight Convolutional Network and the BD-PlantDX Expert-Validated Benchmark for Radish, Potato and Pointed Gourd Disease Classification
summary: Automated plant disease diagnosis is increasingly deployed on farmer-held devices in regions where agronomic expertise is scarce and network connectivity is unreliable. Three obstacles limit its practical value: public benchmarks are dominated by a small set of non-native crops, region-specific datasets are rarely validated by domain experts, and the architectures that reach competitive accuracy carry parameter budgets that are unsuited to low-cost hardware. We propose AgroVisNet, a compact convolutional network trained from scratch, together with BD-PlantDX, an expert-validated benchmark of 12,432 field images spanning 12 classes of radish, potato and pointed gourd in healthy and diseased states, collected across the Bogura and Nilphamari districts of Bangladesh. AgroVisNet couples grouped bottleneck residual blocks carrying sequential channel and spatial attention with multi-scale depthwise blocks and a dual-pooling classification head, reaching 290,572 trainable parameters. On BD-PlantDX the model attains 99.52% test accuracy and 99.52% weighted F1, exceeding all six ImageNet-pretrained lightweight backbones evaluated under an identical protocol while using 8.7 to 16.8 times fewer parameters and 1.3 to 8.5 times fewer multiply-accumulate operations. Exported for deployment, the model quantises to a 0.46 MB full-integer network at a 0.22 percentage-point accuracy cost and classifies an image in 8.40 ms on a single CPU. Across five random seeds accuracy remains at 99.57 +- 0.10%, a ten-variant ablation isolates the contribution of each component, and the same architecture transfers without redesign to two independently collected datasets at 98.71% and 99.05% accuracy. Grad-CAM evidence indicates that predictions rest on lesion-bearing leaf regions rather than on background cues.

AI.tldr: 论文提出轻量卷积网络 AgroVisNet 与孟加拉国田间病害基准 BD-PlantDX（12,432 张图像、12 类），模型仅 29 万参数即达 99.52% 准确率与加权 F1，量化后 0.46 MB、单 CPU 推理 8.40 ms，并通过消融、跨数据集迁移与 Grad-CAM 验证。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化植物病害诊断在农户设备上应用受三重制约：公开基准以少数非本地作物为主，区域数据集缺乏领域专家校验，而高精度架构参数量过大、不适配低成本硬件。
AI.method: 构建经专家校验的 BD-PlantDX 基准（12,432 张田间图像，涵盖孟加拉国 Bogura 与 Nilphamari 两地区萝卜、马铃薯、尖瓜的健康与病害状态共 12 类）；提出从零训练的紧凑卷积网络 AgroVisNet，融合分组瓶颈残差块（含串行通道与空间注意力）、多尺度深度可分离块及双池化分类头。
AI.result: BD-PlantDX 上测试准确率与加权 F1 均为 99.52%，参数量比六个 ImageNet 预训练轻量骨干少 8.7–16.8 倍，乘加运算少 1.3–8.5 倍；量化后为 0.46 MB 全整型网络，精度仅损失 0.22 个百分点，单 CPU 单图推理 8.40 ms；五随机种子准确率 99.57±0.10%，十变体消融明确各组件贡献，架构无需改动即迁移至两个独立采集数据集，准确率分别达 98.71% 与 99.05%；Grad-CAM 显示预测依据病斑叶片区域而非背景线索。
AI.conclusion: AgroVisNet 以极小参数量与计算量在本地化、专家校验的田间病害基准上实现高精度与可解释性，量化后适合低成本农户设备部署，并具备跨数据集迁移能力。

title: A Comprehensive Review of One-Pixel Attack: Research Status, Taxonomy, Applications, Regulation Policy and Future Directions
summary: One-Pixel Attacks (OPAs) represent one of the most extreme demonstrations of adversarial fragility in deep learning, where modifying a single pixel can reliably induce high-confidence misclassification across domains such as medical diagnosis, autonomous driving, biometrics, and quantum communication. Despite their conceptual simplicity, OPAs remain underexamined in existing adversarial-attack surveys, which provide only fragmented or cursory coverage. This PRISMA-guided review synthesizes high-quality studies from 2017 to 2026 and delivers a unified, multi-axis taxonomy of OPA research spanning algorithmic foundations, black-box evolutionary optimization, emerging hybrid and program-synthesis attacks, defence mechanisms, interpretability tools, and domain-specific vulnerabilities. Our analysis reveals the dominance of Differential Evolution-based strategies, the rise of efficiency-optimized and saliency-guided methods, and persistent gaps in dataset diversity, transferability, and standardized evaluation. We summarized and assess defence paradigms including pixel restoration, anomaly detection, input-space transformations, and robust training highlighting their trade-offs in robustness, imperceptibility, and computational overhead. Building on these insights, we outline future research priorities involving selective pixel recovery, transformer-specific vulnerability analysis, saliency-driven optimization, and real-world domain-adaptive defences. We further propose a regulatory framework emphasizing robustness testing, incident disclosure, and AI security governance. This review establishes a comprehensive foundation for understanding, evaluating, and mitigating ultra-sparse adversarial threats in contemporary AI systems.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇PRISMA指导的综述，系统梳理了2017–2026年One-Pixel Attack（OPA）研究，提出多维度分类体系，涵盖算法基础、黑盒进化优化、混合/程序合成攻击、防御机制、可解释性工具与领域漏洞，并总结防御范式权衡、未来方向及监管框架。
AI.motivation: OPA是深度学习对抗脆弱性的极端体现——仅修改单个像素即可高置信度致误分类，涉及医疗诊断、自动驾驶、生物识别、量子通信等领域。然而现有对抗攻击综述对OPA覆盖零散、简略，缺乏系统化整理，因此需要一篇统一、深入的综述。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA指导的综述方法，筛选2017–2026年的高质量研究，构建覆盖算法基础、黑盒进化优化、新兴混合与程序合成攻击、防御机制、可解释性工具及领域特定漏洞的统一多轴分类法，并对防御范式进行归纳与评估。
AI.result: 分析表明：差分进化（Differential Evolution）类策略占据主导；效率优化与显著性引导方法兴起；在数据集多样性、迁移性与标准化评估方面仍存在持续空白。同时评估了像素恢复、异常检测、输入空间变换和鲁棒训练等防御范式，揭示其在鲁棒性、不可感知性与计算开销之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出未来研究方向：选择性像素恢复、面向Transformer的脆弱性分析、显著性驱动优化及真实场景的领域自适应防御；并建议以鲁棒性测试、事件披露和AI安全治理为核心的监管框架。该综述为理解、评估与缓解当代AI系统中的超稀疏对抗威胁奠定了全面基础。

title: Artificial Intelligence Literacy and Sustainable Development: An Ethical Governance and Development Goals Framework
summary: AI literacy provides foundational competencies that support ethical, transparent, and sustainable technological development, although higher-order capabilities such as governance, critical evaluation, and strategic decision-making extend beyond basic literacy into advanced levels of AI competency. This study positions AI literacy as a governance capacity that complements and strengthens all 17 SDGs. It introduces a six-level taxonomy of artificial intelligence reasoning and ethics that extends traditional learning models by incorporating ethical judgement and strategic foresight. This taxonomy forms the foundation of an integrated framework linking education, governance, and sustainable development. A survey of 300 participants from diverse professional backgrounds within a national context which reveals strong technical awareness but limited ethical and governance readiness, highlighting critical gaps in public capacity to manage artificial intelligence responsibly. Findings show that ethical reasoning and reflective thinking are the strongest predictors of sustainable and trustworthy artificial intelligence use. The study proposed to embed literacy-based competencies into curricula, institutional policies, and governance mechanisms to accelerate equitable and responsible progress toward sustainable development goals

AI.tldr: 该研究将AI素养定位为一种治理能力，提出六层级的AI推理与伦理分类体系，并构建连接教育、治理与可持续发展的整合框架；基于300名参与者的调查发现技术意识较强但伦理与治理准备不足，伦理推理与反思性思维是可持续、可信AI使用的最强预测因素。
AI.motivation: AI素养提供支撑伦理、透明与可持续技术发展的基础能力，但治理、批判性评估与战略决策等更高阶能力已超出基础素养范畴，进入更高层次的AI胜任力。研究动机在于将AI素养从基础能力提升为治理能力，并使其与全部17项可持续发展目标（SDGs）形成互补与强化关系，同时弥补传统学习模型在伦理判断与战略前瞻方面的缺失。
AI.method: 研究提出一个六层级的AI推理与伦理分类体系（taxonomy），在传统学习模型基础上纳入伦理判断与战略前瞻；以此分类体系为基础构建连接教育、治理与可持续发展的整合框架。随后在一国范围内对300名来自不同职业背景的参与者开展问卷调查，考察其技术意识、伦理与治理准备度，并分析伦理推理与反思性思维对可持续、可信AI使用的预测作用。
AI.result: 调查结果显示参与者具备较强的技术意识，但伦理与治理准备度有限，表明公众在负责任地管理AI方面存在关键能力缺口。进一步分析表明，伦理推理与反思性思维是可持续且可信AI使用的最强预测因素。
AI.conclusion: 研究主张将基于素养的能力嵌入课程体系、机构政策与治理机制中，以加速朝向可持续发展目标的公平且负责任的进展。AI素养应被理解为一种治理能力，与全部17项SDGs相互补充与强化。

title: IBIB: A Protocol for Measuring Enterprise AI Systems by Serving Route, Not Model Identifier
summary: Enterprises deploy systems, not checkpoints. Usable capability depends jointly on weights, serving route, precision, output contract, and harness, yet all 18 audited benchmarks score advertised model identifiers. We treat this as measurement error and give a protocol that makes it reportable. It has three parts. A gold-blind capability-binding preflight verifies that a route can execute the evaluation contract before any task reaches it; a reliability-inclusive first-pass scoring rule keeps failure in the score while keeping unsupported capability out; and adjudication is structurally score-blind. We call the protocol IB2 and release its algorithms, classification tables, request contract, and manifest schemas. Its reference instantiation, 128 locked tasks and 987 assertions over document, spreadsheet, chart, tool and database work, stays sealed: the procedure is the artifact, not the corpus. Across eleven systems, four results. Capability availability is measurable: two complete single-route runs on identical weights later failed distinct predicates of the finalized binding gate, while a third passed that gate before a fresh run. The advertised identifier exposed neither limit. Discrimination is not uniform: four of seven suites saturate under a six-system band, with the spread almost entirely from governed database work and multi-tab joins, so we report interval-backed resolution groups, not ranks; two of the nominal five-label output's four cuts fail multiplicity adjustment. Serving-arm choice moved one declared revision and precision from 77.38 to 82.54, paired interval [0.11,10.60], though the arms differ in access mode, harness generation, and the serving tool-call parser, and harness generation is a property of our evaluator, not any endpoint. Excluding failed responses from denominators changes the point ordering, so reliability inclusion changes a conclusion, not its wording.

AI.tldr: 论文将"企业部署系统而非检查点"的可用能力差异视为测量误差，提出IB2协议（gold-blind能力绑定预检、含可靠性的首轮评分、结构上分数盲的裁决），并发布算法、分类表、请求契约与清单模式；参考实例（128个锁定任务、987条断言）密封不公开。在11个系统上得出四项结果：能力可用性可测、区分度不均匀（应报告区间支持的解析分组）、服务臂选择使声明修订与精度从77.38升至82.54（配对区间[0.11,10.60]）、排除失败响应会改变点序。
AI.motivation: 现有18个被审计的基准均只对"广告宣传的模型标识符"打分，但企业实际部署的是系统，可用能力同时取决于权重、服务路由、精度、输出契约与harness。将这一差距视为测量误差，需要使其可被报告。
AI.method: 提出IB2协议，含三部分：(1) gold-blind能力绑定预检，在任何任务到达前验证路由能否执行评估契约；(2) 含可靠性的首轮评分规则，使失败保留在分数中而将不受支持的能力排除在外；(3) 结构上分数盲的裁决。发布算法、分类表、请求契约与清单模式。
AI.result: 在11个系统上取得四项结果：(1) 能力可用性可测——同一权重上两次完整单路由运行后来未通过最终绑定门的不同谓词，第三次在全新运行前通过该门，广告标识符未暴露任一限制；(2) 区分度不均匀——7个套件中4个在六系统带下饱和，差异几乎全部来自受治理的数据库工作与多标签页连接，故报告区间支持的解析分组而非排名，名义五标签输出的四个切分中有两个未通过多重性校正；(3) 服务臂选择使一个声明修订与精度从77.38变为82.54，配对区间[0.11,10.60]，但各臂在访问模式、harness代际与serving tool-call解析器上不同，且harness代际是评估器而非端点的属性；(4) 将失败响应排除出分母会改变点排序，故可靠性纳入改变的是结论而非措辞。
AI.conclusion: 可用能力取决于整个部署系统而非模型标识符，基准应报告这一测量误差。IB2通过预检、可靠性纳入评分与分数盲裁决使该差异可报告；程序本身即产物，参考语料密封不公开。结论层面，可靠性纳入与方法（服务臂、harness代际）会实质改变评估结论，因此应报告区间支持的解析分组而非单点排名。
