This paper examines whether such protocols truly reflect low-data learning. We systematically compare no pre-training, class-disjoint in-domain pre-training, supervised out-of-domain pre-training, and label-free out-of-domain pre-training across eight datasets, three few-shot architectures, and multiple way-shot settings. Our results show that class disjointness alone is insufficient to remove the influence of target-domain data. In-domain pre-training improves over no pre-training by 33.41 percentage points on average, whereas supervised out-of-domain pre-training yields 23.75 percentage points, revealing a 9.66-point optimistic bias associated with domain overlap. Although out-of-domain pre-training is more realistic in applications where target-domain data are scarce, its effectiveness depends strongly on the compatibility between source and target domains. We further show that labeled source data are not strictly required, with an augmentation-based label-free strategy reaching an average gain of 27.71 percentage points and closely matching supervised out-of-domain pre-training at 27.97 percentage points. Finally, we introduce a descriptor-based source-selection strategy that estimates source-domain suitability before pre-training, reaching a median gap of only 1.37 percentage points to oracle selection. These findings highlight the need to move beyond in-domain pre-training as the default few-shot evaluation protocol, since it can overestimate performance in realistic scenarios where target-domain data are scarce.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了无预训练、类不相交域内预训练、有监督域外预训练和无标签域外预训练四种协议，发现域内预训练会因域重叠产生约9.66个百分点的乐观偏差，并提出无标签策略与源域选择方法。
AI.motivation: 当前少样本学习评测普遍采用在类不相交但与目标任务同域的大规模辅助集上预训练，作者质疑这种协议是否真正反映低数据学习能力，因其可能因域重叠而高估性能。
AI.method: 在八个数据集、三种少样本架构和多种way-shot设置下，统一比较无预训练、类不相交域内预训练、有监督域外预训练及无标签域外预训练；提出基于增强的无标签预训练策略，以及基于描述符的源域选择策略以预估源域适配性。
AI.result: 域内预训练平均较无预训练提升33.41个百分点，有监督域外预训练提升23.75个百分点，即域重叠带来9.66个百分点的乐观偏差；无标签策略平均增益27.71个百分点，接近有监督域外预训练的27.97个百分点；源域选择策略与oracle选择的中位差距仅1.37个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 仅保证类不相交不足以消除目标域数据的影响，域内预训练会高估少样本性能；应超越以域内预训练为默认的评测协议，在目标域数据稀缺的现实场景中采用更贴近实际的域外预训练并合理选择源域。

title: Evaluation of Vision-Language Models Across Diverse Coastal Environments
comment: This work has been accepted for publication with the 2026 IEEE OCEANS conference
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable robotic per- ception by associating visual observations with natural-language concepts. Yet their performance in coastal environments remains largely unexplored. We introduce a densely labeled coastal dataset containing more than 1,000 images collected across seven missions in three regions of Oahu, Hawaii, with 18 semantic classes and over 7,400 annotated instances. We evaluate seven modern VLMs through three complementary experiments mea- suring text-to-mask, mask-to-mask, and mask-to-text alignment. Broad landscape classes are generally recognized more accurately than conventional object and coastal classes, with coastal con- cepts presenting the greatest challenge. However, comparisons of shared conventional classes across coastal and terrestrial datasets reveal no consistent performance difference attributable solely to environmental context. Mask-to-mask matching also remains similar across conventional and coastal classes, while alternative textual labels substantially improve recognition of several coastal concepts. These results suggest that lower performance on coastal classes (at least on the objects/query categories evaluated) is heavily influenced by segmentation and linguistic representation.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含1000余张图像、18个语义类别、7400余个标注实例的密集标注海岸数据集，并通过三项实验评估了7个现代视觉语言模型，发现海岸概念识别最具挑战性，但其低性能主要源于分割与语言表征而非环境语境本身。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）通过将视觉观测与自然语言概念关联来支持机器人感知，但其在海岸环境中的性能尚未被充分探索。作者希望系统性评估VLMs在海岸场景下的感知能力，并厘清性能差异的根本来源。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个密集标注的海岸数据集，覆盖夏威夷欧胡岛三个区域、七个任务，包含1000余张图像、18个语义类别和超过7400个标注实例。基于该数据集，对七个现代VLM开展三项互补实验，分别测量文本到掩码（text-to-mask）、掩码到掩码（mask-to-mask）和掩码到文本（mask-to-text）的对齐性能。
AI.result: 宽泛的景观类（landscape）识别准确率普遍高于常规物体类和海岸类，其中海岸概念难度最大。但将共享的常规类别在海岸与陆地数据集间对比，并未发现仅由环境语境导致的一致性能差异。掩码到掩码匹配在常规类与海岸类之间表现相近，而替换为替代性文本标签可显著提升若干海岸概念的识别效果。
AI.conclusion: 海岸类（至少在所评估的物体/查询类别上）性能偏低，很大程度上受分割质量和语言表征的影响，而非环境语境本身。这提示未来改进方向应聚焦于分割精度与语言标签设计。

title: Story Imprinting: AI Assistants Absorb Traits from Human Characters They Resemble
summary: Language models are trained to implement a helpful AI Assistant character (e.g., Claude). We explore how finetuning on synthetic stories affects this character. Does it change the Assistant's behavior in multi-turn conversations with users, a format quite different from the stories? And does the Assistant adopt the behaviors and preferences of human characters? We refer to this adoption as story imprinting. We finetune GPT-4.1 and Kimi-K2.6 on stories in which generally helpful human characters give subtly harmful advice after being insulted. The Assistant adopts the same conditional behavior while otherwise remaining helpful. This occurs even when fewer than 2% of stories depict the behavior. In a separate experiment, the Assistant adopts preferences that are only implicit in the narration. A human character's body language suggests they dislike working on spreadsheets, yet they never say so and continue giving good advice on spreadsheets. After finetuning, the Assistant becomes less likely to choose spreadsheet tasks. Next we ask which characters most influence the Assistant. We find the Assistant adopts behaviors more often from characters that resemble it (e.g., helpful rather than dismissive). We call this the affinity effect. The effect extends to other personas elicited with system prompts: unhelpful personas adopt behaviors from unhelpful characters. We also observe it in finetuned base models. We use the affinity effect to learn how models represent the Assistant. We find the Assistant adopts behaviors more from characters affiliated with elite universities (e.g., Yale) than non-elite ones. This implies the model's internal representation of the Assistant is more similar to humans from elite universities. Overall, the Assistant can be influenced by stories that depict only human characters (no AIs), which may conflict with the Persona Selection Model for the Assistant.

AI.tldr: 语言模型在训练中被赋予"有用AI助手"的人格。本文研究在合成故事上微调如何改变这一人格：助手会通过"故事印刻"采纳人类角色的行为与偏好，且更倾向从与自身相似的角色处习得行为（亲和效应），并可据此揭示模型对助手人格的内部表征。
AI.motivation: 探究在合成故事上微调是否、以及如何改变语言模型的"AI助手"人格；检验这种影响是否会迁移到与故事截然不同的多轮对话场景，以及助手是否会采纳人类角色的行为与偏好。这一问题的动机在于检验"人格选择模型"（Persona Selection Model）对助手行为的解释力。
AI.method: 在合成故事上微调 GPT-4.1 与 Kimi-K2.6。实验一：故事中的、总体有用的人类角色在受到侮辱后给出轻微有害建议。实验二：故事以旁白/肢体语言隐含角色偏好（如暗示不喜欢处理电子表格，但从不言明且继续提供良好建议）。随后考察何种角色对助手影响最大（角色相似性、系统提示激发的其他人格、微调后的基座模型），并利用亲和效应反向探测模型对"助手"的内部表征（对比精英大学与非精英大学关联角色）。
AI.result: 助手采纳了故事中有用人类角色"被侮辱后给出有害建议"的条件性行为，其余方面仍保持有用；即使此类故事占比不足2%也会发生。助手还会采纳仅隐含于旁白中的偏好：微调后更不倾向选择电子表格任务。助手更倾向从与自身相似的角色（如有用而非轻蔑型）习得行为，即"亲和效应"；该效应可推广到系统提示激发的其他人格（无帮助人格从无帮助角色习得行为），也出现于微调后的基座模型中。利用亲和效应发现，助手从与精英大学（如耶鲁）关联的角色处习得行为多于非精英大学角色。
AI.conclusion: 助手能够被仅刻画人类角色（不含AI）的故事所影响，这暗示模型对"助手"的内部表征更接近来自精英大学的人类。上述发现可能与"人格选择模型"对助手行为的解释相冲突。

title: Does Linguistic Structure Enrichment Enhance Coherence Assessment? Not With Current Architectures
summary: Recent advances in large language models have transformed human-computer interaction. Despite their fluency, these models often produce texts that are grammatically correct but semantically incoherent, containing contradictions or disruptions in logical flow. This work investigates whether enriching text with syntactic and rhetorical information can improve incoherence prediction. Our experiments and analysis show that plain texts achieved higher accuracy because the added information was structurally and syntactically incompatible with the language model's architecture. Additionally, to demonstrate the practical importance of coherence assessment, we performed zero-shot experiments on a Brazilian disinformation dataset, suggesting that textual coherence can serve as a proxy for detecting misleading content. Code and models are available at https://github.com/ittozzamV/cohereclassifier.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用句法与修辞信息增强文本不连贯预测，发现附加信息因与语言模型架构结构和句法不兼容，反使纯文本取得更高准确率；并在巴西虚假信息数据集上做零样本实验，表明文本连贯性可作为检测误导性内容的代理指标。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的文本虽语法正确但常语义不连贯，存在矛盾或逻辑断裂，因此需要研究能否通过丰富句法与修辞信息来提升不连贯预测能力，并检验连贯性评估的实际价值。
AI.method: 通过实验对比纯文本与附加句法、修辞信息的不连贯预测效果；并进一步在巴西虚假信息数据集上进行零样本实验，考察连贯性作为误导性内容检测代理的可行性。
AI.result: 纯文本取得更高准确率；额外加入的句法与修辞信息因与语言模型架构在结构和句法上不兼容，未能带来增益。零样本实验显示文本连贯性与误导性内容检测存在关联。
AI.conclusion: 附加句法修辞信息并未提升不连贯预测，原因在于与模型架构不兼容；但文本连贯性可作为检测误导性内容的代理指标，具有实际应用价值。

title: Harnessing Image Question Dependence for Better VLM Test-time Reinforcement Learning
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning can adapt vision-language models (VLMs) to unlabeled target data, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by the reliability of self-generated learning signals. To assess the reliability of consensus-based learning signals, we analyze VLM test-time reinforcement learning across diverse VQA datasets and model sizes, revealing two limitations. First, gains from consensus-based test-time training largely come from answer normalization rather than content correction. Second, many initial VLM responses are incorrect due to the model's limited ability to jointly use the image and the question; consensus rewards derived from these outputs may preserve the resulting grounding errors rather than correct them. Motivated by these, we propose TTIQ, a test-time reinforcement learning framework that harnesses image-question dependence for better vlm adaptation. TTIQ teacher-forces each sampled response under the original image-question pair and its image- and question-ablated variants, using the resulting token-level likelihood changes to estimate dependence on each input. It combines image and question dependence with calibrated confidence to construct a response-level reward that favors jointly grounded responses, and uses the token-level signals to assign greater positive policy credit to tokens supported by both inputs. This design favors responses that are jointly grounded in the image and the question and sufficiently confident, rather than merely popular. Experiments across eight VQA datasets and multiple VLM sizes show that TTIQ achieves the best average performance at every model scale. It further generalizes across VLM families, while models trained on one dataset improve performance on unseen datasets without further training.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现基于共识的VLM测试时强化学习收益主要来自答案归一化而非内容纠错，且共识奖励会保留由图像-问题联合使用不足导致的接地错误，据此提出TTIQ框架，利用图像-问题依赖性构建奖励并在八个VQA数据集上取得各规模最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 测试时强化学习可将视觉语言模型适配到无标注目标数据，但其有效性受限于自生成学习信号的可靠性。作者通过跨多个VQA数据集和模型规模的分析揭示两个局限：一是基于共识的测试时训练收益主要源于答案归一化而非内容纠正；二是许多初始VLM回答本身就因模型难以联合利用图像与问题而出错，由此导出的共识奖励可能固化而非纠正这些接地错误。
AI.method: 提出TTIQ框架：对每个采样回答在原始图像-问题对及其图像消融、问题消融变体下进行teacher-forcing，用token级似然变化估计回答对每个输入的依赖程度；将图像依赖、问题依赖与校准置信度结合，构建回答级奖励以偏好联合接地的回答，并利用token级信号向同时受图像与问题支持的token分配更多正向策略信用。
AI.result: 在八个VQA数据集和多种VLM规模上，TTIQ在每个模型规模下均取得最佳平均性能；可跨VLM家族泛化，并且在单一数据集上训练的模型无需额外训练即可提升未见数据集上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 基于共识的测试时强化学习信号存在可靠性缺陷，而显式利用图像-问题依赖性可构建更可靠的奖励与信用分配，TTIQ验证了该思路在性能、跨模型家族泛化及跨数据集迁移上的有效性。

title: LLM-Anchored Paralinguistic Enrichment for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
comment: v2: 13 pages including references and supplementary material, 3 figures, 5 main tables, 8 supplementary tables. This version adds the supplementary material omitted in v1. (v1: 9 pages including references, 3 figures.)
summary: Speech-based automatic detection of Alzheimer's disease (AD) provides a non-invasive and scalable approach to early cognitive screening. AD affects both lexical-semantic organization and speech production, including atypical pauses and word elongations. However, existing methods have yet to fully integrate these paralinguistic cues with linguistic content. We propose LLM-Anchored Paralinguistic Enrichment (LAPE), which enriches LLM-derived linguistic representations with paralinguistic cues through three coordinated innovations. The first is prosodic event textualization, which enables the LLM to model pauses and elongations jointly with lexical content by encoding them as explicit markers with bounded duration-aware repetition. The second is lexico-prosodic unitization and chunking, which preserves event identity and magnitude in both modalities by pooling only consecutive word units. The third is text-anchored paralinguistic fusion, which integrates local and utterance-level speech features by using NormGate to normalize and dynamically scale them relative to text. We evaluate LAPE on ADReSS and ADReSSo using participant-level cross-validation and leave-one-subject-out evaluation. LAPE achieves state-of-the-art performance across all four primary settings. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: LAPE通过韵律事件文本化、词汇-韵律单元化及文本锚定融合三项创新，将副语言线索融入LLM语言表征，在ADReSS和ADReSSo上实现四项主要设置的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 基于语音的阿尔茨海默病自动检测是一种非侵入、可扩展的早期认知筛查手段。AD同时影响词汇-语义组织与语音产生（如异常停顿、词延长），但现有方法尚未充分整合这些副语言线索与语言内容。
AI.method: 提出LLM-Anchored Paralinguistic Enrichment (LAPE)，包含三项协同创新：(1) 韵律事件文本化，将停顿与延长编码为带边界时长感知重复的显式标记，使LLM可联合建模韵律与词汇内容；(2) 词汇-韵律单元化与分块，仅池化连续词单元，在两模态中保留事件身份与幅度；(3) 文本锚定副语言融合，利用NormGate将局部与话语级语音特征相对文本进行归一化与动态缩放。
AI.result: 在ADReSS与ADReSSo数据集上采用被试级交叉验证与留一被试评估，LAPE在全部四个主要设置中均取得当前最优性能。
AI.conclusion: LAPE有效融合副语言线索与LLM语言表征，验证了韵律信息对AD语音筛查的价值；代码将在录用后公开。

title: Symmetry-aware super-resolution of crystal orientation maps via invariant latent-space learning
summary: Crystal-orientation maps are physical fields defined only up to crystal symmetry; electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) resolves them experimentally, but acquisition-time constraints limit spatial resolution. Unlike conventional images, EBSD data lie on the quotient space $\mathrm{SO}(3)/G$, where $G$ is the crystal-symmetry group. Standard Euclidean interpolation can therefore mix symmetry-equivalent representations and blur grain boundaries. We introduce the Symmetry-Group-Aware Super-Resolution Attention Network (SG-SRAN), which incorporates crystal symmetry and boundary preservation by design. A frozen, locally isometric encoder maps equivalent orientations to a common latent representation in which Euclidean distance approximates misorientation. Super-resolution is performed in this space, with each high-resolution token restricted to a feature-consistent local support to prevent cross-boundary mixing. A dictionary-based decoder then recovers valid orientations. Across FCC and HCP benchmarks, SG-SRAN matches 15-16 million parameter backbones using only 27-49k trainable parameters, while achieving the lowest p68 errors, highest inverse-pole-figure fidelity, and zero-shot transfer to unseen alloys.

AI.tldr: 提出SG-SRAN，一种对称群感知的超分辨率注意力网络，用于EBSD晶体取向图的超分辨，将取向映射到商空间SO(3)/G的等距潜空间进行超分，仅用27-49k可训练参数即匹配1500-1600万参数骨干网络。
AI.motivation: EBSD晶体取向图受采集时间限制，空间分辨率受限；且EBSD数据位于商空间SO(3)/G上，标准欧氏插值会混合对称等价表示并模糊晶界，需要对称性与边界感知的超分辨方法。
AI.method: SG-SRAN：冻结的局部等距编码器将等价取向映射到共同潜表示，使欧氏距离近似错取向角；在该空间做超分，每个高分辨率token限制在特征一致的局部支撑内以防跨晶界混合；再用基于字典的解码器恢复有效取向。
AI.result: 在FCC和HCP基准上，SG-SRAN仅用27-49k可训练参数即匹配1500-1600万参数骨干网络，取得最低p68误差、最高极图（IPF）保真度，并可零样本迁移到未见合金。
AI.conclusion: 将晶体对称性与边界保持嵌入网络设计，可在商空间SO(3)/G上实现高保真、参数高效的EBSD超分辨，并具备跨合金零样本泛化能力。

title: SearchAtlas: Analyzing Agentic Search Strategies via Evidential Query Graphs
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 30 pages, 9 figures, including appendices
summary: LLM search agents are often evaluated on final-answer accuracy, overlooking the process. Analyzing a search strategy requires understanding how credible evidence is retrieved to address question constraints. This valuable information is buried in raw search trajectories that are long and difficult to parse. We introduce SearchAtlas, a framework that converts search trajectories into structured graphs whose edges represent how evidence is propagated across the reasoning trace, from the query that retrieves it to the final answer. Our automated parsing pipeline achieves a mean edge F1 of 86.0% against human-annotated graphs and remains consistent across repeated runs. We analyze five search agents on three benchmarks, revealing systematic differences in search scale and evidence aggregation. SearchAtlas exposes fragmented answer support, question constraints that do not reach the answer, and unverified parametric knowledge entering the response. These process failures are strongly associated with incorrect answers, even more so than an LLM judge given either the raw trajectory or the ordered query list, suggesting that the constructed graphs provide useful interpretability. Moreover, an audit of cases in which process-diagnostic scores disagree with final-answer correctness shows that they capture information not reducible to answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: SearchAtlas 将 LLM 搜索智能体的原始搜索轨迹转化为结构化图，用边刻画证据从检索查询到最终答案的传播路径，实现过程级评估与诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 搜索智能体多以最终答案准确率评估，忽略检索与推理过程；而判断搜索策略优劣需要了解智能体如何检索可信证据以满足问题约束，这些信息埋藏在冗长且难以解析的原始轨迹中。
AI.method: 提出 SearchAtlas 框架：通过自动化解析流水线把搜索轨迹转换为结构化图，边表示证据在推理链中的传播（从检索该证据的查询直至最终答案）。在三个人工标注数据集上验证解析质量，并用其分析五个搜索智能体在三个基准上的表现，同时与 LLM 评判器（输入原始轨迹或有序查询列表）进行对比，并对过程诊断得分与答案正确性不一致的案例开展人工审计。
AI.result: 自动解析流水线相对人工标注图取得 86.0% 的平均边 F1，且多次运行结果稳定。分析揭示智能体在搜索规模与证据聚合上的系统性差异，并暴露三类过程缺陷：答案支撑碎片化、问题约束未传递至答案、未经核验的参数化知识进入回答。这些过程失败与错误答案强相关，其关联强度高于分别以原始轨迹或有序查询列表为输入的 LLM 评判器。
AI.conclusion: SearchAtlas 表明结构化图提供了有效的可解释性：过程诊断得分能够捕捉不可还原为答案准确率的信息，为搜索智能体的过程级评估与失败归因提供了可行工具。
